lore: 'For a couple o'pins,' says Troll, and grins, / 'I'll eat thee too, and gnaw thy shins. / A bit o' fresh meat will go down sweet!'

title: Stout and Sturdy
gametext: Maneuver or Skirmish: Heal a Hobbit.
lore: 'You have a stout heart, little hobbit, but your courage alone will not save you.'

title: A Talent for Not Being Seen
gametext:
Stealth. To play, exert a Hobbit. Plays to your support area.
Each time the fellowship moves, spot 2 Hobbit companions to make the Shadow number -1 (or spot 4 to make it -2).
lore: With their small size, Hobbits use any hole to hide in, and their trail is difficult to detect.

title: There and Back Again
gametext:
Tale. Bearer must be a Hobbit companion.
Maneuver: Discard this condition to make each Hobbit companion strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'So there I was – at the mercy of three monstrous trolls....'

title: Thrór's Map
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Fellowship or  Regroup: Exert 2 Hobbits and discard Thrór's Map to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).
lore: Bilbo still keeps a map of Erebor, the Lonely Mountain, as a memento of his journey with the Dwarves many years ago.

title: Bag End
gametext: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play The Gaffer from your draw deck.

title: East Road
gametext: Each companion's twilight cost is +2.

title: Farmer Maggot's Fields
gametext: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play Merry or Pippin from your draw deck.

title: Green Dragon Inn
gametext: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play Sam from your draw deck.

title: Green Hill Country
gametext: The twilight cost of each Hobbit is -1.

title: The Prancing Pony
gametext: Fellowship: Add a burden to play Aragorn from your draw deck.

title: Shire Lookout Point
gametext: Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to play Gandalf's Cart from your draw deck.

title: Westfarthing
gametext: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play a companion or ally; that character's twilight cost is -1.

title: Bree Gate
gametext: While you can spot a ranger, the move limit is +1 for this turn.

title: Bree Streets
gametext: The roaming penalty for each Nazgûl you play to Bree Streets is -2.

title: Breeland Forest
gametext: Forest. Stealth events may not be played.

title: Buckleberry Ferry
gametext: River. While only Hobbits are in the fellowship, there are no assignment and skirmish phases at Buckleberry Ferry.

title: Ettenmoors
gametext: Plains. Skirmish: Exert your companion or minion to make that character strength +2.

title: Midgewater Marshes
gametext: Marsh. Each time a Hobbit moves to Midgewater Marshes, that Hobbit must exert.

title: Midgewater Moors
gametext: Plains. Each time a minion is played, the Free Peoples player discards a card from hand.

title: Trollshaw Forest
gametext: Forest. Each time you play a possession or artifact on your companion, draw a card.

title: Weatherhills
gametext: Each Nazgûl's twilight cost is -1.

title: Weathertop
gametext: Each Nazgûl at Weathertop is fierce.

title: Council Courtyard
gametext: Sanctuary. When the fellowship moves from Council Courtyard, remove (2).

title: Ford of Bruinen
gametext: River. Sanctuary. The twilight cost of the first Nazgûl played to Ford of Bruinen each turn is -5.

title: Frodo's Bedroom
gametext: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play a Hobbit to draw a card.

title: Rivendell Terrace
gametext: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play a Man to draw a card.

title: Rivendell Valley
gametext: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play an Elf to draw a card.

title: Rivendell Waterfall
gametext: Forest. Sanctuary. While you can spot a ranger at Rivendell Waterfall, the move limit is +1 for this turn.

title: Balin's Tomb
gametext: Underground. Maneuver: Discard your tale from play or from hand to heal your companion.

title: Dwarrowdelf Chamber
gametext: Underground. When the fellowship moves to Dwarrowdelf Chamber, Gimli or 2 other companions must exert.

title: Mithril Mine
gametext: Underground. Shadow: Remove (1) to play a Shadow weapon from your discard pile.

title: Moria Lake
gametext: Marsh. When the fellowship moves to Moria Lake, Frodo or 2 other companions must exert.

title: Moria Stairway
gametext: Underground. Each companion and minion bearing a hand weapon is damage +1.

title: Pass of Caradhras
gametext: Mountain. Shadow: Spot an [isengard] minion to play a weather card from your draw deck (limit 1 per turn).

title: The Bridge of Khazad-dûm
gametext: Underground. Shadow: Play The Balrog from your draw deck or hand; The Balrog's twilight cost is -6.

texts: Play The Balrog from your draw deck

title: Dimrill Dale
gametext: Sanctuary. The twilight cost of the first [moria] Orc played each Shadow phase is -2.

title: Galadriel's Glade
gametext: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Exert an Elf to look at an opponent's hand.

title: Lothlórien Woods
gametext: Forest. Sanctuary. Each ally whose home is site 6 is strength +3.

title: Anduin Confluence
gametext: River. When the fellowship moves to Anduin Confluence, discard every ally.

title: Anduin Wilderland
gametext: Forest. River. While the fellowship is at Anduin Wilderland, skip the archery phase.

title: Silverlode Banks
gametext: River. When the fellowship moves to Silverlode Banks without a ranger, every companion must exert.

title: Anduin Banks
gametext: River. For each companion in the fellowship over 4, add 2 to the minion archery total.

title: Brown Lands
gametext: River. For each minion archer at Brown Lands, the minion archery total is +1 (limit +4).

title: Pillars of the Kings
gametext: River. Fellowship: Discard a [gondor] card from hand to heal a [gondor] companion.

title: Shores of Nen Hithoel
gametext: River. Shadow: Spot 5 Orc minions to prevent the fellowship from moving again this turn.

title: Emyn Muil
gametext: Maneuver: Exert your minion to make that minion fierce until the regroup phase.

title: Slopes of Amon Hen
gametext: The twilight cost of each [isengard] minion is -1.

title: Summit of Amon Hen
gametext: When the fellowship moves to Summit of Amon Hen, each Shadow player may draw a card for each burden.

title: Tol Brandir
gametext: River. Shadow: Play up to 3 trackers from your discard pile; end your Shadow phase.

title: Gandalf
gametext: Fellowship: Exert Gandalf to play a companion who has the Gandalf signet. The twilight cost of that companion is -2.
lore: ...his long white hair, his sweeping silver beard, and his broad shoulders, made him look like some wise king of ancient legend.
subtitle: The Grey Wizard

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Ranger.
At the start of each of your turns, you may heal another companion who has the Aragorn signet.
lore: 'He turned from that path a long time ago. He has chosen exile....'
subtitle: King in Exile

title: Beneath the Mountains
gametext:
Tale. Plays to your support area.
Fellowship: Discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to play a [dwarven] weapon from your discard pile.
lore: 'There forged was blade, and bound was hilt; / The delver mined, the mason built.'

effects.text: Discard 3 cards from the top of your draw deck to play a [dwarven] weapon from discard.

title: Disquiet of Our People
gametext: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to make that Dwarf defender +1 (or defender +2 if you spot an Orc) until the regroup phase.
lore: 'Ah, alas!... When will the day come of our revenge?'

title: Dwarven Bracers
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, discard this possession to prevent that wound.
lore: Dwarven-smiths forge bracers for fit and agility.

title: Endurance of Dwarves
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make bearer strength +1.
lore: 'Dwarves too can go swiftly, and they do not tire sooner than Orcs.'

title: Flurry of Blows
gametext: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +4 and damage +1 if bearing 2 hand weapons).
lore: With a second axe, a warrior of Erebor can parry on either flank and counter quickly.

title: Frór
gametext:
To play, spot a Dwarf.
While skirmishing an Uruk-hai, Frór is strength +3.
lore: It appeared that amid the splendour of their works of hand the hearts of the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain were troubled.
subtitle: Gimli's Kinsman

title: Glóin
gametext: For each [dwarven] tale you can spot, Glóin is strength +1 (limit +4).
lore: 'But what then would happen, if the Ruling Ring were destroyed, as you counsel?'
subtitle: Friend to Thorin

title: Golden Light on the Land
gametext:
To play, spot a Dwarf. Plays to your support area.
At a site which is not underground, each [moria] Orc's twilight cost is +2. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
lore: 'The Orcs will not, maybe, come out till after dusk, but we must be far away before nightfall.'

title: Great Works Begun There
gametext:
Tale. Plays to your support area.
Each time you play a Dwarf, you may discard the top 2 cards from your draw deck to take a [dwarven] event into hand from your discard pile.
lore: 'Moria! Moria!... Long have its vast mansions lain empty since the children of Durin fled.'

title: Hand Axe
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon.
Archery: Discard this weapon to make the fellowship archery total +1.
lore: Their captain rallied two other orcs to attack. In answer, Gimli's side axe brought him down.

title: Make Light of Burdens
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf companion and discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to discard either a Shadow condition from a Dwarf or a weather condition.
lore: A Dwarf does not readily notice the weight on his back, or in his heart.

title: Realm of Dwarrowdelf
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Skirmish: Discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to make a Dwarf strength +1 (limit +3) and, if underground, damage +1 (limit +3).
lore: 'There must have been a mighty crowd of dwarves here... and every one of them busier than badgers....'

title: Tidings of Erebor
gametext: Regroup: Spot a Dwarf to draw 3 cards. Any Shadow player may remove (3) to prevent this.
lore: '...we have so far been fortunate, though we do not escape the shadow of these times.'

effect.text: Would you like to remove (3) to prevent drawing of 3 cards?

title: Till Durin Wakes Again
gametext:
Tale. Plays to your support area.
Each time a Dwarf companion moves from an underground site, you may heal that Dwarf.
lore: Gimli was silent. Having sung his song, he would say no more.

title: What Are We Waiting For?
gametext: Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf to make an opponent draw 2 cards. That player then chooses to either discard 2 Shadow cards from hand or skip his or her next Shadow phase.
lore: 'It is not despair, for despair is only for those who see the end beyond all doubt.'

title: A Blended Race
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf. Plays to your support area.
Each Uruk-hai is strength -2 and loses all damage bonuses. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
lore: '...he has been doing something to them.... For these Isengarders are more like wicked Men.'

title: Dismay Our Enemies
gametext: Response: If an Elf archer wins a skirmish, make an opponent choose a minion to discard. That opponent may remove (3) to prevent this.
lore: Reeling from the bite of an arrow, the Cave Troll became enraged trying to strike the nimble Elf.

effect.text: Would you like to remove (3) to prevent discarding a minion?

title: Hosts of the Last Alliance
gametext:
Tale. Plays to your support area.
While you can spot an Elf companion, the minion archery total is -1.
Response: If an Elf is about to take a wound, discard this condition to prevent that wound.
lore: '...many great princes and captains were assembled.'

title: Release the Angry Flood
gametext: Maneuver: Exert an Elf to wound each Nazgûl once (or twice if at a river).
lore: The three Riders that were still in the midst of the Ford were overwhelmed.... Their piercing cries were drowned in the roaring of the river as it carried them 'away.

title: Secret Sentinels
gametext: Maneuver: Exert an Elf ally to discard a condition (or 2 conditions if you spot an Orc).
lore: 'Yet so little faith and trust do we find now in the world beyond Lothlórien... that we dare not by our own trust endanger our land.'

true.text: Would you like to spot an Orc?

title: Erland
gametext:
To play, spot Gandalf.
Shadow players may not look at or reveal cards in your hand.
lore: 'They are good folk the Bardings. The grandson of Bard the Bowman rules them, Brand son of Bain son of Bard.'
subtitle: Advisor to Brand

title: Gandalf's Staff
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
The twilight cost of each [gandalf] spell is -1.
Skirmish: Exert Gandalf twice to cancel a skirmish involving him.
lore: As the wizard passed on ahead up the great steps, he held his staff aloft, and from its tip there came a faint radiance.

title: Gandalf's Wisdom
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
The twilight cost of each possession or artifact played on Gandalf or a character who has the Gandalf signet is -1.
lore: Now as the companions sat or walked together they spoke of Gandalf, and all that each had known and seen of him came clear before their minds.

title: Hugin
gametext:
To play, spot Gandalf.
Fellowship: Exert Hugin to reveal a Free Peoples card from your discard pile and place it beneath your draw deck.
lore: Several wise Bardings were sent to Elrond to tell of the Dark Lord's new offer.

effect.text: Choose card to reveal and put beneath your deck

subtitle: Emissary from Laketown

title: Járnsmid
gametext:
To play, spot Gandalf.
Each time you play a shield, armor, helm, or hand weapon, its twilight cost is -1.
lore: The Men of Dale freely traded with the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain for fine metalwork.
subtitle: Merchant from Dale

title: Speak "Friend" and Enter
gametext: Fellowship or Regroup: Spot Gandalf to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary). Draw a card if you play an underground site.
lore: Picking up his staff he stood before the rock and said in a clear voice: Mellon!

title: Staff Asunder
gametext:
Spell.
Skirmish: Discard a staff Gandalf is bearing and then exert him twice to discard a minion he is skirmishing.
lore: At that moment Gandalf lifted his staff, and crying aloud he smote the bridge before him.

title: Wielder of the Flame
gametext:
Spell.
Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to make a companion defender +1 until the regroup phase. Any Shadow player may remove (3) to prevent this.
lore: The Balrog made no answer. The fire in it seemed to die, but the darkness grew.

effect.text: Remove (3) to prevent giving companion Defender +1

title: Wizard Staff
gametext:
Bearer must be a Wizard.
Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to make a minion strength -3.
lore: 'We must have power – power to order things as we will for that Good which only the Wise can see.'

title: You Cannot Pass!
gametext:
Spell.
Maneuver: Spot Gandalf bearing a staff to prevent a minion from being fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: The Balrog fell back and its sword flew up in molten fragments. The wizard swayed on the bridge, stepped back a pace, and then again stood still.

title: Blood of Númenor
gametext:
To play, exert a [gondor] companion. Plays to your support area.
Each [sauron] Orc comes into play exhausted.
Skip the archery phase. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
lore: 'I do not know what strength is in my blood, but I swear to you – I will not let the White City fall....'

title: Flaming Brand
gametext:
Bearer must be a Man.
This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon.
Bearer is strength +2 and damage +1 while skirmishing a Nazgûl.
lore: ...a glimpse of Strider leaping out of the darkness with a flaming brand of wood in either hand.

title: Flee in Terror
gametext: Response: If a [gondor] companion wins a skirmish, discard an exhausted Orc. That minion's owner may remove (3) to prevent this.
lore: Aragorn smote to the ground the captain that stood in his path, and the rest fled in terror of his wrath.

effect.text: Choose exhausted Orc
Remove (3) to prevent discarding exhausted {chosenOrc}

title: Gondor Will See It Done
gametext: Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, exert a [gondor] companion to prevent that wound.
lore: 'Boromir!... Go after those two young hobbits, and guard them at the least, even if you cannot find Frodo.'

title: Natural Cover
gametext:
To play, spot a ranger. Plays to your support area.
While the fellowship is at a forest, the minion archery total is -2.
lore: The tree, the bough, the leaf. To a ranger, these are all defenses against the enemy.

title: No Mere Ranger
gametext: Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make another companion strength +2 (or +3 if that companion has the Aragorn signet).
lore: 'If by my life or death, I can protect you, I will....'

title: Sentinels of Númenor
gametext: Skirmish: Make a [gondor] companion strength +2 (or +4 if in a fierce skirmish).
lore: ...they still preserved through the suns and rains of forgotten years the mighty likenesses in which they had been hewn.

title: Shield of Boromir
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] companion.
The minion archery total is -1.
If bearer is Boromir, each minion skirmishing him does not gain strength bonuses from weapons.
lore: Boromir bore the heirlooms of the Steward's house with pride.

title: Beyond the Height of Men
gametext: Maneuver: Exert an Uruk-hai to discard an armor possession, helm possession, or shield possession (or all such Free Peoples possessions if you can spot 6 companions).
lore: 'Whom do you serve?'

title: Demands of the Sackville-Bagginses
gametext:
To play, spot an [isengard] minion. Plays to your support area.
Each time a [shire] ally exerts, add (1).
lore: In the middle of the commotion, the Sackville- Bagginses arrived.

title: Evil Afoot
gametext: Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai and spot X burdens to shuffle X minions from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lore: 'It is not the Eastern Shore I am worried about. A shadow and a threat has been growing in my mind. Something draws near, I can feel it.'

title: Goblin Man
gametext:
Discard this minion if underground.
Shadow: Exert this minion to look at the Free Peoples player's hand.
lore: 'He looks more than half like a goblin.'

title: Lurtz's Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be Lurtz.
He is damage +1.
Each time Lurtz wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must discard the top 2 cards of his or her draw deck.
lore: The Uruk giant laid down his bow and drew a broad-bladed weapon.

title: No Business of Ours
gametext:
To play, spot an [isengard] minion. Plays to your support area.
The Free Peoples player may not look at or reveal cards in any Shadow player's hand.
lore: 'Goblins? Cobblers! Far-off tales and children's stories, that's all that is!'

title: Too Much Attention
gametext: Response: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot an [isengard] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard the top 5 cards of his or her draw deck.
lore: 'A little more caution from you – that is not a trinket you carry.'

title: Uruk Captain
gametext:
Damage +1.
Shadow: Remove (1) and exert Uruk Captain to play an Uruk-hai from your discard pile.
lore: The captains marched the Uruk-hai to the great river without halting.

title: Uruk Scout
gametext:
Tracker. Damage +1.
The roaming penalty for each [isengard] minion you play is -1.
Response: If an event is played that spots or exerts a ranger, exert this minion to cancel that event.
lore: Forward Uruk troops caught the fellowship unaware.

title: Wizard Storm
gametext:
Spell. Weather. To play, exert an [isengard] minion. Plays on a site. Limit 1 per site.
When the fellowship moves from this site, every companion must exert. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.
lore: There was a black look in the sky, and the sun was wan. The wind had gone now round to the north-east.

title: Archer Commander
gametext:
Archer.
Each other [moria] archer is strength +2.
lore: Their commander led the Goblin bowmen to the highest rise across the gap.

title: The Balrog's Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be The Balrog.
It is damage +1.
This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon.
lore: In its right hand was a blade like a stabbing tongue of fire....

title: The Balrog
gametext:
Damage +1. Fierce.
While you can spot The Balrog, discard all other minions. Skip the archery phase.
Discard The Balrog if not underground.
lore: 'Indeed I saw upon the bridge that which haunts our darkest dreams....'
subtitle: Durin's Bane

title: The Balrog
gametext:
Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot a [moria] Orc. Discard The Balrog if not underground.
Shadow: Exert The Balrog and remove (2) to play a [moria] Orc from your discard pile.
lore: ...suddenly it drew itself up to a great height, and its wings were spread from wall to wall....
subtitle: Flame of Udûn

title: Cave Troll's Chain
gametext:
Bearer must be Cave Troll of Moria.
The Free Peoples player may choose for the archery phase to be skipped.
Each time Cave Troll of Moria takes a wound during the archery phase, you may wound an archer companion.
lore: 'They have a Cave Troll!'

effect.text: Would you like to skip the Archery phase?

title: Dark Fire
gametext:
To play, spot The Balrog. Plays on Gandalf.
Each time the fellowship moves, Gandalf must exert.
lore: ...he seemed small, and altogether alone: grey and bent, like a wizened tree before the onset of a storm.

title: Dark Places
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each unique [moria] minion is strength +1.
Shadow: Spot an opponent's site to replace it with your marsh or underground site of the same number.
lore: 'There is some new devilry here... devised for our welcome, no doubt.'

effect.text: Choose opponent's site

title: Fill With Fear
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
While you can spot The Balrog, skip the archery phase.
Maneuver: Exert The Balrog to discard a ranged weapon.
lore: He drew, but his hand fell, and the arrow slipped to the ground. He gave a cry of dismay and fear.

title: Final Cry
gametext: Response: If a skirmish that involved The Balrog bearing Whip of Many Thongs is about to end, wound a companion in that skirmish twice.
lore: ...it swung its whip, and the thongs lashed and curled about the wizard's knees, dragging him to the brink.

title: Foul Tentacle
gametext:
Tentacle.
When you play this minion, you may play a tentacle from your draw deck. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.
lore: Its fingered end had hold of Frodo's foot, and was dragging him into the water.

title: Foul Things
gametext: Shadow: Play a [moria] minion from your discard pile.
lore: 'Something has crept, or has been driven out of dark waters under the mountains.'

title: Goblin Bowman
gametext: Archer.
lore: The crude arrows of the Goblins served notice of the dangers of Moria.

title: Goblin Flankers
gametext: When you play this minion, you may add (3) if the fellowship has moved more than once this turn.
lore: 'There are Orcs, very many of them.... And some are large and evil....'

title: Goblin Pursuer
gametext: If the fellowship has moved more than once this turn, this minion is strength +3.
lore: Had the fellowship remained in Dimrill Dale, pursuers from Moria would have overwhelmed them.

title: Goblin Reinforcements
gametext: When you play this minion, you may heal a [moria] minion.
lore: 'We don't have a moment! Come nightfall these hills will swarm with Orcs!'

title: Goblin Scrabbler
gametext:
When you play this minion, you may discard an [elven] condition.
The roaming penalty for each [moria] Orc you play is -1.
lore: Orcs were as keen as hounds on a scent, it was said, but they could also climb.

title: Goblin Spearman
gametext: While bearing a Goblin Spear, this minion is damage +2.
lore: ...with the speed of a striking snake, he charged into the Company and thrust with his spear....

title: Huge Tentacle
gametext:
Tentacle. Damage +1.
When you play this minion, you may play Watcher in the Water from your draw deck.
This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.
lore: Out from the water a long sinuous tentacle had crawled; it was pale-green and luminous and wet.

title: Moria Archer Troop
gametext:
Archer.
While you can spot another [moria] archer, add 1 to the minion archery total.
lore: Most of the Goblin arrows flew harmlessly into the chasm, but there were so many!

title: Must Do Without Hope
gametext: Maneuver: Exert The Balrog to add a burden.
lore: His enemy halted again, facing him, and the shadow about it reached out like two vast wings.

title: Old Differences
gametext: Skirmish: Make an Elf or Dwarf skirmishing a [moria] Orc strength -1 (or -3 if you spot an Elf and a Dwarf).
lore: 'I'll be dead before I see the Ring in the hands of an Elf!'

title: Power and Terror
gametext: Shadow: Reveal any number of [moria] Orcs from your hand to play The Balrog. Its twilight cost is -2 for each Orc revealed.
lore: The ranks of the orcs had opened, and they crowded away, as if they themselves were afraid.

title: Throw Yourself in Next Time
gametext:
To play, spot a [moria] Orc. Plays on a Hobbit companion.
Bearer may be exerted only by Shadow cards.
lore: 'This is a serious journey, not a hobbit walking- party.... Now be quiet!'

title: Troubled Mountains
gametext: Shadow: Exert a [moria] minion and spot X burdens to add (X) (limit (5)).
lore: 'The Dimrill Dale is full of vapour and clouds of smoke.... There are noises in the deeps of the earth.'

title: Watcher in the Water
gametext:
Damage +1.
While you can spot Watcher in the Water, discard all other minions (except tentacles).
Each tentacle is strength +2 and damage +1. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.
lore: The dark water boiled... there was a hideous stench.
subtitle: Keeper of Westgate

title: Whip of Many Thongs
gametext:
Bearer must be The Balrog.
Skirmish: Exert The Balrog to discard a helm, shield, or armor borne by a character The Balrog is skirmishing.
lore: It raised the whip, and the thongs whined and cracked.

title: Bill Ferny
gametext:
Nazgûl are not roaming.
The Free Peoples player may not assign a character to skirmish Bill Ferny. Discard Bill Ferny if underground.
lore: '...as for Ferny, he would sell anything to anybody; or make mischief for amusement.'
subtitle: Swarthy Sneering Fellow

title: Helpless
gametext:
To play, spot Frodo and a Nazgûl. Plays on Sam.
Sam's game text does not apply.
lore: He heard Frodo's voice, but it seemed to come from a great distance, or from under the earth, crying out strange words.

title: His Terrible Servants
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Response: If a twilight Nazgûl is about to take a wound, remove (1) to prevent that wound.
lore: '...in the dark they perceive many signs and forms that are hidden from us: then they are most to be feared.'

title: It Wants to be Found
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a twilight Nazgûl to add a burden.
lore: ...perhaps it had tried to reveal itself in response to some wish or command that was felt in the room.

title: Resistance Becomes Unbearable
gametext: Maneuver: Exert a twilight Nazgûl to exert the Ring-bearer. If the Ring-bearer is then exhausted, he puts on The One Ring until the regroup phase.
lore: Not with the hope of escape, or of doing anything, either good or bad: he simply felt that he must take the Ring and put it on his finger.

title: Stricken Dumb
gametext: Maneuver: Exert The Witch-king to discard a tale or weapon.
lore: He felt his tongue cleave to his mouth and his heart labouring. His sword broke and fell out of his shaking hand.

title: They Will Find the Ring
gametext: Maneuver: Exert 2 Nazgûl and spot X burdens to exert X companions.
lore: ...to the dismay of Frodo and his friends out from the trees and rocks away on the left four other Riders came flying.

title: Úlairë Attëa
gametext:
Twilight.
When you play Úlairë Attëa, you may wound an ally.
lore: 'They had words with Harry at Westgate on Monday.... He was white and shaking when they left him.'
subtitle: The Easterling

title: Úlairë Enquëa
gametext:
Twilight.
Each time Úlairë Enquëa wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer once (or twice if you can spot 5 burdens).
lore: In their white faces burned keen and merciless eyes....
subtitle: Ringwraith in Twilight

title: Úlairë Nelya
gametext:
Twilight.
While you can spot 2 burdens or 2 wounds on the Ring-bearer, Úlairë Nelya is fierce and damage +1.
lore: Over the lip of the little dell, on the side away from the hill, they felt, rather then saw, a shadow rise, one shadow or more than one.
subtitle: Ringwraith in Twilight

title: The Witch-king
gametext:
Twilight.
Return to Its Master may not be played.
Each time The Witch-king wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer twice.
lore: 'A great king and sorcerer was he of old, and now he wields a deadly fear.'
subtitle: Lord of the Nazgûl

title: Wraith-world
gametext: Skirmish: Spot a twilight Nazgûl and the Ring-bearer wearing The One Ring to add 3 burdens.
lore: 'He is passing into the shadow world, he will soon become a wraith like them.'

title: The Eye of Sauron
gametext: Shadow: Exert a [sauron] Orc and spot X burdens to draw X cards (limit 5).
lore: '...he has indeed arisen again and left his hold in Mirkwood and returned to his ancient fastness in the Dark Tower of Mordor.'

title: Memory of Many Things
gametext: Maneuver: Exert a [sauron] Orc to discard an ally (or 2 [elven] allies).
lore: 'But my memory reaches back even to the Elder Days.... I have seen three ages in the West of the world, and many defeats, and many fruitless victories.'

title: Orc Scout
gametext:
Tracker.
The roaming penalty for each [sauron] minion you play is -1.
Response: If an event is played that spots or exerts a ranger, exert or discard this minion to cancel that event.
lore: 'Orc!... Not very near, and yet too near, it seems.'

title: Orc Taskmaster
gametext: Shadow: Exert this minion to add (1).
lore: An Orc acts when the taskmaster promises reward or the whip.

title: Southern Spies
gametext: Response: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot a [sauron] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard his or her hand.
lore: 'They will know all the news now, for they have visited Bill Ferny; and probably that Southerner was a spy as well.'

title: Spies of Mordor
gametext:
Search. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc. Plays to your support area.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may draw a card (or 2 cards if you can spot a [sauron] tracker).
lore: 'Mordor Orcs patrol the Eastern Shore. We must wait for the cover of darkness.'

title: Tower Assassin
gametext: Maneuver: Exert Tower Assassin to wound an ally.
lore: A Ring of Power would not stop the blade of an assassin lying in wait.

title: Verily I Come
gametext:
To play, exert a [sauron] Orc. Plays on the Ring-bearer.
Each time the Free Peoples player draws a card (or takes a card into hand) during the fellowship phase, add a burden.
lore: There was an eye in the Dark Tower that did not sleep. He knew that it had become aware of his gaze.

title: Vile Blade
gametext:
Bearer must be a [sauron] Orc.
Bearer is strength +2 while skirmishing a Man or Elf.
lore: The blood of enemies slain that day blackened the edge of the commanders blade.

title: Bilbo
gametext: Fellowship: Exert Bilbo and discard a tale to discard a Shadow condition from an opponent's support area.
lore: ...as Mr. Baggins was generous with his money, most people were willing to forgive him his oddities and his good fortune.
subtitle: Well-spoken Gentlehobbit

title: Consorting With Wizards
gametext:
Tale. Bearer must be Bilbo.
Bilbo may not take wounds (except during the archery phase).
Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Bilbo or discard this condition to remove (1).
lore: 'He wasn't always this peculiar! When I were a lad, old Bilbo was a most respectable Hobbit.'

title: Dear Friends
gametext: Fellowship: Exert a companion to place a Free Peoples card from your discard pile beneath your draw deck (or 2 Free Peoples cards if that companion has the Frodo signet).
lore: He pressed him for news of himself and of the wide world... and they stayed up far into the night.

title: Deft in Their Movements
gametext:
Stealth.
Regroup: Spot 2 Hobbits to make each site's Shadow number -2 until the end of the turn.
lore: They possessed from the first the art of disappearing swiftly and silently, when large folk who they do not wish to meet come blundering by.

title: Fearing the Worst
gametext:
Stealth. To play, exert 2 Hobbits. Plays to your support area.
The twilight cost of each search card and each tracker is +2.
lore: 'Even if we are allowed to leave Bree unhindered, we can hardly hope now to leave it unnoticed.'

title: Filibert Bolger
gametext: Skirmish: Exert a Hobbit companion twice to cancel a fierce skirmish involving that Hobbit.
lore: Filibert knows paths and tracks that few have trodden. He is not adventurous by nature, but his escapades often require rapid departures.
subtitle: Wily Rascal

title: Frodo
gametext:
Ring-bearer (resistance 10).
The cost of each artifact, possession, and [shire] tale played on Frodo is -1.
lore: 'I am not made for perilous quests. I wish I had never seen the Ring! Why did it come to me? Why was I chosen?'
subtitle: Reluctant Adventurer

title: Hobbit Sword-play
gametext: Maneuver: Exert a Hobbit bearing a weapon to wound a minion. That minion's owner may remove (3) to prevent this.
lore: Boromir sensed that a blade in a Halfling's hand would surprise a larger foe.

effect.text: Choose minion to wound
Would you like to remove (3) to prevent wounding {chosenMinion}

title: Merry
gametext: Fellowship: Exert Merry to play Farmer Maggot from your draw deck.
lore: 'Ow... I think I've broken something.'
subtitle: Horticulturalist

title: Mithril-coat
gametext:
Bearer must be Frodo.
The minion archery total is -1.
Each minion skirmishing Frodo does not gain strength bonuses from weapons and loses all damage bonuses.
lore: '...its worth was greater than the value of the whole Shire and everything in it.'

title: Nice Imitation
gametext:
Stealth. Plays to your support area.
Response: If a Hobbit is about to take a wound, discard this condition to prevent that wound.
lore: 'Very life-like!... But what will happen when they have penetrated the disguise?'

title: Not Feared in Sunlight
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Hobbits. Plays to your support area.
Each Nazgûl is strength -4. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
lore: '...our shapes cast shadows in their minds, which only the noon sun destroys....'

title: O Elbereth! Gilthoniel!
gametext:
Tale. Bearer must be the Ring-bearer.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to take off The One Ring or to cancel a skirmish involving the Ring-bearer and a Nazgûl.
lore: With a last effort Frodo... slipped the Ring from his finger and closed his right hand tight upon it.

texts: Cancel a skirmish involving the Ring-bearer and a Nazgul

title: Orc-bane
gametext: Maneuver: Spot Sting or Glamdring and exert its bearer X times to wound X Orcs or X Uruk-hai.
lore: Glamdring shone with a pale light, and Sting glinted at the edges.

cost.text: Choose Sting or Glamdring bearer to exert
Choose how many times to exert {weaponBearer}

title: Pippin
gametext: Fellowship: Play Gandalf or Aragorn; his twilight cost is -2.
lore: Pippin was evidently much enjoying the attention he was getting, and had become quire forgetful of their danger.
subtitle: Mr. Took

title: Practically Everyone Was Invited
gametext: Fellowship: Exert Bilbo to play a Hobbit from your draw deck.
lore: Thank you, I shall certainly come.

title: A Promise
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
While you can spot Frodo and Sam and neither is exhausted, each is strength +1.
lore: 'But I'm glad, Sam. I cannot tell you how glad. Come along! It is plain that we were meant to go together.'

title: Red Book of Westmarch
gametext:
Tale. Plays to your support area.
Each time you play a tale, you may spot Bilbo to draw a card.
lore: 'Don't adventures ever have an end? I suppose not. Someone else always has to carry on the story.'

title: Sam
gametext:
Maneuver: Exert Sam twice to make him defender +1 until the regroup phase.
Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
lore: 'First he was a conspirator, now he's a jester. He'll end up by becoming a wizard – or a warrior!'
subtitle: Proper Poet

title: Hobbiton Party Field
gametext: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play Bilbo from your draw deck.

title: Hobbiton Woods
gametext: Forest. Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play your site 2 (replacing opponent's site if necessary).

title: Town Center
gametext: Fellowship: Play a [shire] ally to draw a card.

title: Great Chasm
gametext: Underground. The twilight cost of the first [moria] archer played each Shadow phase is -2.

title: Hollin
gametext: Plains. Uruk-hai are not roaming.

title: Valley of the Silverlode
gametext: River. Sanctuary. When the fellowship moves to Valley of the Silverlode, each Hobbit companion may heal.

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each underground site's Shadow number is -2.
lore: 'In the ruins of the Dwarves, a dwarf's head will be less easy to bewilder than Elves or Men or Hobbits.'
subtitle: Dwarf of the Mountain-race

title: Gandalf
gametext: At the start of each of your turns, you may draw a card.
lore: 'When evening in the Shire was grey / his footsteps on the Hill were heard; / before the dawn he went away / on journey long without a word.'
subtitle: The Grey Pilgrim

title: Book of Mazarbul
gametext:
Tale. Bearer must be a Dwarf.
At the start of each fellowship phase when the fellowship is at site 4 or higher, you may draw a card for each Dwarf companion.
lore: 'It seems to be a record of the fortunes of Balin's folk....'

title: Gimli's Pipe
gametext:
Bearer must be Gimli.
Fellowship: Exert Gimli to add 1 to the number of pipes you can spot.
lore: 'And certainly it was from Bree that the art of smoking the genuine weed spread in the recent centuries among Dwarves and such other folk....'

title: Mines of Khazad-Dûm
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each time you play a [dwarven] tale, you may heal a Dwarf companion.
lore: 'Moria! Moria! Wonder of the Northern world!'

title: A Royal Welcome
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Regroup: Exert a Dwarf ally to heal a Dwarf companion.
lore: 'There is even a chance that Dwarves are there, and that in some deep hall of his fathers, Balin son of Fundin may be found.'

title: Song of Durin
gametext:
Tale. To play, exert a Dwarf. Plays to your support area.
The twilight cost of each [moria] weapon is +2.
Fellowship: Discard this condition to discard up to 2 [moria] conditions.
lore: No harp is wrung, no hammer falls: / The darkness dwells in Durin's halls....

title: Storm of Argument
gametext: Fellowship: Reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Shuffle up to X [dwarven] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: 'I will be dead before I see the Ring in the hands of an Elf!'

title: Arwen
gametext:
Ranger.
Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, discard 3 cards from hand to prevent that wound.
lore: 'If I can cross the river, the power of my people will protect him.'
subtitle: Elven Rider

title: Arwen
gametext: While you can spot 3 [elven] allies whose home is site 3, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -3.
lore: Queenly she looked, and thought and knowledge were in her glance, as of one who has known many things that the years bring.
subtitle: Lady Undómiel

title: Beren and Lúthien
gametext:
Tale. Plays to your support area.
Skirmish: Exert an [elven] ally to discard the bottom card of your draw deck. If that card is an [elven] card, make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -1.
lore: 'Tinúviel! Tinúviel! / He called her by her elvish name; / And there she halted listening.'

title: Calaglin
gametext:
Archer.
Regroup: Exert Calaglin to wound a minion.
lore: 'We have been keeping watch on the rivers, ever since we saw a great troop of Orcs going north toward Moria....'
subtitle: Elf of Lórien

title: Cast It Into the Fire!
gametext: Maneuver: Spot an Elf to make each opponent discard a card from his or her hand. Draw a card for each card discarded in this way.
lore: 'It should have been cast then into Orodruin's fire nigh at hand where it was made.'

title: Dínendal
gametext:
Archer.
Regroup: Exert Dínendal to remove (2).
lore: He was almost certain that he could hear stealthy movements.... Not Elves; for the woodland folk were altogether noiseless in their movements.
subtitle: Silent Scout

title: Elrond
gametext:
At the start of each of your turns, you may spot an ally whose home is site 3 and heal that ally up to 2 times.
Regroup: Exert Elrond twice to heal a companion.
lore: Venerable he seemed as a king crowned with many winters, and yet hale as a tried warrior....

effect.text: Choose an ally to heal up to 2 times
Choose how many times to heal {healingAlly}

subtitle: Herald to Gil-galad

title: Erestor
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
Response: If an Elf is about to take a wound from a [sauron] minion or [sauron] event, exert Erestor to prevent that wound.
lore: 'Then there are but two courses... to hide the Ring for ever, or to unmake it.'
subtitle: Chief Advisor to Elrond

title: Forests of Lothlórien
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot 3 [elven] allies to wound a minion.
lore: 'Alas for Lothlórien that I love! It would be a poor life in a land where no mallorn grew.'

title: Friends of Old
gametext: Fellowship: Reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Heal X [elven] allies, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: 'You have been summoned here to answer the threat of Mordor.'

title: Galadriel
gametext:
At the start of each of your turns, you may heal an Elf.
Fellowship: Exert Galadriel to play the fellowship's next site if it is a forest (replacing opponent's site if necessary).
lore: 'There is in her and in this land no evil, unless a man bring it hither himself. Then let him beware!'
subtitle: Lady of the Golden Wood

title: Galdor
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
Regroup: Exert Galdor and spot a minion to return that minion to its owner's hand.
lore: 'My heart tells me that Sauron will expect us to take the western way, when he learns what has befallen. He soon will.'
subtitle: Councilor From the West

title: Gift of the Evenstar
gametext:
To play, spot Arwen. Bearer must be Aragorn.
Skirmish: Exert Aragorn or discard 2 cards from hand to make a minion skirmishing Aragorn strength -1.
lore: 'It is mine to give to whom I will... like my heart.'

title: Golradir
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
Skirmish: Exert Golradir to make an Orc strength -1.
lore: Their stay at Rivendell provided the Fellowship with counsel from many sources.
subtitle: Councilor of Imladris

title: Long-knives of Legolas
gametext:
Bearer must be Legolas.
Each Orc or Uruk-hai skirmishing Legolas is strength -2.
lore: Sharp, bone-handled knives defend the Elves of Mirkwood at close quarters.

title: Master of Healing
gametext: Fellowship or Regroup: Spot Elrond (or 2 [elven] allies) to heal a companion or ally.
lore: 'Elrond has cured you: he has tended you for days, ever since you were brought in.'

title: Nenya
gametext:
Bearer must be Galadriel.
At the start of each regroup phase, you may discard up to 2 cards from hand to draw the same number of cards.
lore: 'Verily it is in the land of Lórien upon the finger of Galadriel that one of the Three remains. This is Nenya, the Ring of Adamant, and I am its keeper.'

title: Phial of Galadriel
gametext:
To play, exert an Elf. Bearer must be the Ring-bearer.
Bearer's resistance is +2.
lore: 'May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out. Remember Galadriel and her Mirror!'

title: Saelbeth
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
Skirmish: Exert Saelbeth to make an Uruk-hai strength -1.
lore: The wisdom of Saelbeth prepared the Company for the dangers they would face.
subtitle: Elven Councilor

title: Something Draws Near
gametext: Fellowship or Maneuver: Exert an Elf to discard an [isengard] possession or [isengard] artifact.
lore: 'We have hunted and slain many Orcs in the woods....'

title: Vilya
gametext:
Bearer must be Elrond.
Maneuver: Exert Elrond twice and spot a Shadow condition to return that condition to its owner's hand.
lore: Upon his finger was a ring of gold with a great blue stone, Vilya, mightiest of the Three.

title: Voice of Nimrodel
gametext:
Tale.
Skirmish: Exert an Elf at a river or forest to cancel a skirmish involving that Elf.
lore: 'Beside the falls of Nimrodel, / By water clear and cool, / Her voice as falling silver fell / Into the shining pool.'

title: Betrayal of Isengard
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each time an opponent draws a card (or takes a card into hand) during the Shadow phase, you may remove (1).
Maneuver: Exert Gandalf to wound Saruman twice.
lore: 'There is only one Lord of the Ring.'

title: Deep in Thought
gametext:
Spell.
Maneuver: Spot Gandalf and 4 twilight tokens to discard all Shadow conditions.
lore: He was... trying to recall every memory of his former journey in the Mines, and considering anxiously the next course that he should take....

title: Depart Silently
gametext:
Stealth.
Maneuver: At sites 1 to 5, spot Gandalf to prevent Hobbits from being assigned to skirmishes until the regroup phase. At any other site, spot Gandalf to make a Hobbit strength +3 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'Be careful, both of you.'

title: Fireworks
gametext:
Spell.
Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to shuffle up to 2 [gandalf] or up to 2 [shire] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lore: 'The finest rockets ever seen: / they burst in stars of blue and green....'

texts: Shuffle up to two GANDALF cards
Shuffle up to two SHIRE cards

title: His First Serious Check
gametext: Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. You may add (X) to discard that card, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: ...a false turn now might be disastrous.

true.text: Would you like to add twilight to discard {revealedCard}

title: Narya
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
At the start of each of your turns, you may add (3) to remove a burden.
lore: 'For this is the Ring of Fire, and with it you may rekindle hearts in a world that grows chill.'

title: Trust Me as You Once Did
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Skirmish: Exert Gandalf to make a companion strength +1 for each companion with the Gandalf signet you can spot (limit +3).
lore: 'Do not take me for some conjurer of cheap tricks! I am not trying to rob you. I am trying to help you.'

title: Unknown Perils
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, spot 4 twilight tokens and exert Gandalf to prevent that wound.
lore: Suddenly he stopped as if listening. Frodo became aware that all was very quiet, inside and outside.

title: Answering the Cries
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Skirmish: Discard a [gondor] tale from hand to make a [gondor] companion strength +2.
lore: Drawing his bright sword and crying Elendil! Elendil! he crashed through the trees.

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Ranger.
Each time the fellowship moves during the fellowship phase, remove (2).
lore: '...his hood was cast back, and his dark hair was blowing in the wind, a light was in his eyes: a king returning from exile in his own land.'
subtitle: Heir to the White City

title: Banner of the White Tree
gametext:
Tale.
Maneuver: Exert a [gondor] companion to make that companion strength +3 and defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'Many Elves and many mighty Men, and many of their friends, had perished in the war.'

title: Citadel of Minas Tirith
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
You may heal a [gondor] companion at the end of each turn during which no companion or ally lost a skirmish.
lore: 'One day our paths will lead us there, and the Tower guards shall take up the call – The Lords of Gondor have returned.'

title: Gondor Bowmen
gametext:
Tale. Plays to your support area.
Archery: Exert a [gondor] companion and discard this condition to make the fellowship archery total +2.
lore: Arrows of the Last Alliance brought death to Sauron's forces.

title: Horn of Boromir
gametext:
Bearer must be Boromir.
Maneuver: Exert Boromir and spot an ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
lore: On a baldric he wore a great horn tipped with silver....

effect.text: Choose ally to have it participate in archery and skirmishes

title: Might of Númenor
gametext:
Tale.
Maneuver: Spot a [gondor] companion to reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Heal X companions, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: 'But the lords of Minas Tirith still fight on....'

title: The Shards of Narsil
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Fellowship: Stack a [gondor] card from hand here.
Fellowship: Add (1) to take a card stacked here into hand.
lore: '...Narsil was broken and its light extinguished, and it had not yet been forged again.'

effects.text: Stack a GONDOR card from hand here
Add (1) to take a card from here

effect.text: Choose a card to take into hand

title: Some Who Resisted
gametext:
Tale.
Maneuver: Spot a [gondor] companion to make the twilight cost of each maneuver event +2.
lore: 'In the South the realm of Gondor long endured; and for a while its splendour grew....'

title: Still Sharp
gametext: Skirmish: Spot The Shards of Narsil to make a [gondor] companion strength +3 and damage +1.
lore: 'The shards of Narsil... the blade that cut the Ring from Sauron's hand.'

effect.text: Choose GONDOR companion to strengthen

title: Voice of Rauros
gametext: Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to make each companion with the Aragorn signet damage +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: As he ran the cries came louder, but fainter now and desperately the horn was blowing.

title: We Must Go Warily
gametext: Response: If the fellowship moves in the regroup phase, exert a [gondor] companion twice to make each minion's twilight cost +1 until the next regroup phase.
lore: 'This is the lawn of Parth Galen: a fair place in the summer days of old. Let us hope that no evil has yet come here.'

title: Abandoning Reason for Madness
gametext: Shadow: Spot an [isengard] minion to discard up to 3 cards from hand and draw an equal number of cards.
lore: 'And why not, Gandalf?... Why not? The Ruling Ring? If we could command that, then the power would pass to us.'

title: Can You Protect Me From Yourself?
gametext: Maneuver: Spot an [isengard] minion to exhaust Aragorn. The Free Peoples player may add 2 burdens to prevent this.
lore: 'Where is the Ring?'

effect.text: Would you like to add 2 burdens to prevent exhausting Aragorn?

title: Coming for the Ring
gametext: Regroup: Reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Heal X [isengard] minions, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: 'This evil cannot be concealed by the power of the Elves....'

title: A Fell Voice on the Air
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Shadow: Exert Saruman to play an [isengard] weather condition from your discard pile. Its twilight cost is -2.
lore: 'He's trying to bring down the mountain!'

title: Hate and Anger
gametext: Shadow: Spot an Uruk-hai and a [moria] minion to draw 3 cards.
lore: The frenzy of Uruks is born of the fear of the very Goblins that work the pits.

title: Hollowing of Isengard
gametext:
To play, spot an [isengard] Orc. Plays to your support area.
Shadow: Discard this condition to add (3).
lore: 'Rip them all down!'

title: Isengard Axe
gametext:
Bearer must be an [isengard] Orc.
When you play this weapon, add (1).
lore: Axes eat into the forests of Isengard as well as the victims of Saruman's Orcs.

title: Isengard Forger
gametext: Shadow: Exert this minion to add (1).
lore: 'I looked on it and saw that, whereas it had once been green and fair, it was now filled with pits and forges.'

title: Isengard Retainer
gametext: Regroup: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lore: '...the Eagles of the mountain went far and wide, and they saw many things: the gathering of wolves and the mustering of Orcs....'

title: Isengard Servant
gametext: Regroup: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lore: The servants of Isengard worked tirelessly to spread the influence of their master.

title: Isengard Shaman
gametext: Response: If an [isengard] Orc is about to take a wound, remove (2) to prevent that wound.
lore: 'Over all his works a dark smoke hung and wrapped itself about the sides of Orthanc.'

title: Isengard Smith
gametext: Regroup: Exert this minion to discard a weapon (or all Free Peoples possessions if you can spot 5 companions).
lore: 'No other folk make such a trampling....'

title: Isengard Warrior
gametext:
While you can spot another [isengard] Orc, no player may use archery special abilities.
Regroup: Exert this minion and spot 3 wounds on the Ring-bearer to exert every companion.
lore: 'There is evil afoot in Isengard, and the West is no longer safe.'

title: Isengard Worker
gametext: Regroup: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lore: 'They were Elves once. Taken by dark powers – tortured and mutilated....'

title: One of You Must Do This
gametext: Maneuver: Exert an [isengard] minion to make the Free Peoples player exert X companions, where X is the number of these races you can spot in the fellowship: Dwarf, Elf, Man, and Wizard.
lore: 'And if we fail, what then? What happens when Sauron takes back what is his?'

title: Orc Commander
gametext:
Each other [isengard] Orc is strength +1.
Regroup: Exert Orc Commander to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lore: 'It seems their delight to slash and beat down growing things that are not even in their way.'

title: Orc Overseer
gametext: Regroup: Exert Orc Overseer twice to exhaust a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lore: 'What orders from Mordor, my Lord? What does the Eye command?'

title: Orthanc Berserker
gametext:
Damage +1.
Maneuver: Spot 5 burdens and exert Orthanc Berserker twice to exhaust a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lore: The voice of Saruman compels his minions to stop at nothing to earn his favor.

title: The Palantír of Orthanc
gametext:
To play, spot an [isengard] minion. Plays to your support area.
Shadow: Spot an [isengard] minion and remove (1) to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Place that card on top of that player's draw deck.
lore: 'Seven stars and seven stones....'

title: Saruman
gametext:
Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish.
Uruk-hai are fierce.
Response: If an Uruk-hai is about to take a wound, exert Saruman to prevent that wound.
subtitle: Keeper of Isengard

title: Saruman
gametext:
Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish.
Assignment: Exert Saruman to assign an [isengard] minion to a companion (except the Ring-bearer). That companion may exert to prevent this.

effect.preventText: Would you like to exert {assignedCompanion} to prevent it being assigned to {assignedMinion}

subtitle: Servant of the Eye

title: Servants to Saruman
gametext: Skirmish: Make an [isengard] Orc strength +2 (or +3 if you have fewer than 3 cards in hand).
lore: 'This is grievous news concerning Saruman... for we trusted him and he is deep in all our counsels.'

title: Tower of Orthanc
gametext:
To play, spot an [isengard] minion. Plays to your support area.
Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot an exhausted companion to add (3).
lore: 'It was not made by Saruman, but by the men of Númenor long ago; and it is very tall and has many secrets; yet it looks not to be a work of craft.'

title: Trapped and Alone
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each character skirmishing an [isengard] Orc loses all damage bonuses from weapons.
lore: '...I had no chance of escape, and my days were bitter.'

title: The Trees Are Strong
gametext: Regroup: Discard X [isengard] Orcs to make the Free Peoples player wound X companions.
lore: 'Their roots go deep.'

title: Uruk Raider
gametext:
Damage +1.
While an ally is in the dead pile, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.
lore: There is no safety where Saruman's emblem is shown.

title: Uruk Ravager
gametext:
Damage +1.
When you play this minion, you may spot Saruman to add (2).
lore: '...a ruined and terrible form of life.'

title: Dangerous Gamble
gametext: Shadow: Spot a [moria] minion to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Add (X), where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: Almost they began to hope that they would escape.

title: Depths of Moria
gametext:
To play, spot a [moria] Orc. Plays to your support area.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, add (2).
lore: ...a great fissure had opened. Out of it a fierce red light came, and now and again flames licked at the brink.... Wisps of dark smoke wavered in the hot air.

title: Hide and Seek
gametext:
Search.
Skirmish: Spot 2 [shire] companions to make a [moria] minion damage +1.
lore: 'Which way shall we go?'

title: Malice
gametext: Archery: Spot a [moria] Orc and a [sauron] Orc to wound an archer.
lore: Fueled by Sauron's hatred of living things, Orcs searched for the Ring of Power.

title: Such a Little Thing
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a [moria] minion to wound Boromir 3 times. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 Free Peoples possessions to prevent this.
lore: 'Boromir... give the Ring to Frodo.'

effect.text: Would you like to discard 2 FP possession to prevent wounding Boromir 3 times?

title: Gates of the Dead City
gametext:
To play, spot a Nazgûl. Plays to your support area.
Each time a [wraith] card adds a burden, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion.
lore: '...and they took Minas Ithil and abode in it, and they made it into a place of dread....'

title: News of Mordor
gametext: Skirmish: Spot an [isengard] minion to make a Nazgûl damage +1.
lore: 'Build me an army worthy of Mordor.'

title: The Ring Draws Them
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each time the fellowship moves, add (1) for each burden you can spot.
At the end of each of your Shadow phases, exert a Nazgûl or discard this condition.
lore: 'If I move I shall be seen and hunted!'

title: They Will Never Stop Hunting You
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a Nazgûl to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Exert a companion bearing a ranged weapon X times, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: 'They're looking for Baggins, and if they mean well, then I'm a hobbit.'

title: Too Great and Terrible
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a Nazgûl to wound Gandalf twice. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 [gandalf] cards from hand to prevent this.
lore: 'His eyes flashed and his face was lit as by a fire within. 'Do not tempt me! For I do not wish to become like the Dark Lord himself.'

effect.text: Would you like to discard 2 GANDALF cards from hand to prevent wounding Gandalf twice?

title: Úlairë Otsëa
gametext:
Twilight.
Each time Úlairë Otsëa wins a skirmish, you may exert him to transfer Blade Tip from your support area to the Ring-bearer.
lore: '...at all times they smell the blood of living things, desiring and hating it.'
subtitle: Ringwraith in Twilight

title: The Dark Lord Advances
gametext: Regroup: Exert a [sauron] minion to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. That player must discard X cards from hand, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: 'A power was there that we have not felt before.'

title: Get Off the Road!
gametext:
Search.
Shadow: Spot a [sauron] minion and a Nazgûl to make the Free Peoples player discard a card from the top of his or her deck for each burden you can spot.
lore: 'The Morgul-lord and his Black Riders have come forth. War is preparing!'

title: Gleaming in the Snow
gametext: Regroup: Exert a [sauron] Orc and spot a [gondor] companion to add a burden.
lore: 'A Ring of Power looks after itself... It may slip off treacherously, but its keeper never abandons it.'

title: Hand of Sauron
gametext: Maneuver: Exert a [sauron] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from his or her hand.
lore: 'The power of the Ring could not be undone.'

title: His Cruelty and Malice
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Regroup: Exert a [sauron] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard the top card from his or her draw deck.
lore: 'Into this Ring he poured his cruelty, his malice, and his will to dominate all life.'

title: Massing in the East
gametext: Regroup: Exert a [sauron] minion to discard a card from the top of the Free Peoples player's draw deck for each of these races you can spot in the fellowship: Dwarf, Elf, Man, and Wizard.
lore: 'The power of the Black Land grows....'

title: Morgul Slayer
gametext: Regroup: Exert this minion to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lore: 'Sauron was diminished, but not destroyed. His Ring was lost but not unmade.'

title: Orc Butcher
gametext: For each [sauron] condition you can spot, this minion is strength +1.
lore: 'And yet we see that Sauron can torture and destroy the very hills.'

title: Orc Guard
gametext: Maneuver: Exert this minion and discard your [sauron] condition to discard a Free Peoples condition.
lore: The malice of the Dark Tower thins the hopes of Men.

title: Orc Pillager
gametext: For each Free Peoples card borne by a character this minion is skirmishing, that character is strength -1.
lore: Weapons of the West are often powerless against the threat of Sauron.

title: Orc Slayer
gametext: Regroup: Exert this minion to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lore: For it is a long tale, full of deeds great and terrible....

title: Orc Swordsman
gametext: While this minion bears a weapon, he is strength +2.
lore: 'Many evil things there are that your strong walls and bright swords do not stay.'

title: Orc Trooper
gametext: For each card in your hand, this minion is strength +1.
lore: The Dark Lord's power grows in unseen ways.

title: Orc Veteran
gametext: Skirmish: Discard your [sauron] condition to make a character skirmishing this minion strength -1.
lore: 'There was war, and the land was laid waste....'

title: Orc Warrior
gametext: Maneuver: Exert this minion and discard your [sauron] condition to make the Free Peoples player discard the top 2 cards from his or her draw deck.
lore: Orcs were multiplying again in the mountains.

title: Our List of Allies Grows Thin
gametext:
To play, exert a [sauron] minion. Plays to your support area.
Each time the fellowship moves, add (1) for each ally you can spot.
lore: 'The enemy is moving.... His eye is fixed on Rivendell. And Saruman, you tell me, has betrayed us.'

title: Terrible as the Dawn
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a [sauron] minion to wound Galadriel 3 times. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 Elves to prevent this.
lore: 'In the place of the Dark Lord, you would have a Queen... All shall love me and despair!'

effect.text: Would you like to discard 2 Elves to prevent wounding Galadriel 3 times?

title: Tower of Barad-dûr
gametext:
To play, exert a [sauron] minion. Plays to your support area.
Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must discard a card from hand.
lore: The Dark Tower had been rebuilt, it was said. From there the power was spreading....

title: Why Shouldn't I Keep It?
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a [sauron] minion to discard Bilbo. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 Free Peoples conditions to prevent this.
lore: 'No, wait, it's here in my pocket. Isn't that... isn't that odd now?'

effect.text: Would you like to discard 2 FP conditions to prevent discarding Bilbo?

title: Bill the Pony
gametext:
Bearer must be a Hobbit companion.
The Shadow number of each site is -1.
Discard Bill the Pony when at an underground site.
lore: 'That animal can nearly talk.... He gave me a look as plain as Mr. Pippin could speak....'

title: Frodo's Pipe
gametext:
Bearer must be Frodo.
Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to heal a companion with the Frodo signet X times.
lore: 'All the same, observations that I have made on my own many journeys south have convinced me that the weed itself is not native to our parts of the world.'

title: Frying Pan
gametext:
Bearer must be a Hobbit.
Skirmish: Exert bearer to wound an Orc he or she is skirmishing.
lore: 'I think I'm getting the hang of this!'

title: Meant to Be Alone
gametext: Fellowship: Spot a Hobbit companion (except the Ring-bearer) to reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Remove (X), where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lore: 'You are a Ring-bearer, Frodo... to bear a Ring of Power is to be alone.'

title: Melilot Brandybuck
gametext: Response: If a burden is about to be added by a Shadow card, exert Melilot Brandybuck to prevent that burden.
lore: Master Everard Took and Miss Melilot Brandybuck got on a table and with bells in their hands began to dance the Springle-ring: a pretty dance, but rather 'vigorous.
subtitle: Merry Dancer

title: Old Noakes
gametext: Each time a Shadow card makes you discard a card from hand, you may also discard a minion or Shadow condition.
lore: 'There's been some strange folk crossing the Shire – Dwarves and others of a less than savoury nature.'
subtitle: Purveyor of Wisdoms

title: Seek and Hide
gametext:
Stealth.
Skirmish: Spot 2 [shire] companions to make a minion lose all damage bonuses.
lore: A Hobbit's best friends in Moria are the very pillars that support its structure.

title: The Shire Countryside
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [shire] companions. Plays to your support area.
Each time you remove a burden (except by a Hobbit's game text), you may heal a companion.
lore: 'Life in the wide world goes on... scarcely even aware of the existence of hobbits....'

title: Three Monstrous Trolls
gametext:
Tale. Plays to your support area.
Response: If a Shadow card is about to add any number of twilight tokens, exert a Hobbit ally to prevent this.
lore: 'Great big nasty twenty foot high smelly things – and they're arguing... arguing about how they were going to cook us!'

title: Caras Galadhon
gametext: Forest. Sanctuary. While the fellowship is at Caras Galadhon, no more than one minion may be assigned to each skirmish.

title: Eregion Hills
gametext: When the fellowship moves to Eregion Hills, add a burden.

title: Gates of Argonath
gametext: River. Maneuver events may not be played.

title: The Great River
gametext: River. While the fellowship is at The Great River, cards may not be played from draw decks or discard piles.

title: House of Elrond
gametext: Sanctuary. When the fellowship moves to House of Elrond, the Free Peoples player may spot 2 Elves to remove a burden.

title: Wastes of Emyn Muil
gametext: Maneuver: Spot 4 companions and exert your [isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

title: Legolas
gametext:
Archer.
While Legolas is at a river or forest, add 1 to the fellowship archery total.
lore: 'Praised be the bow of Galadriel, and the hand and eye of Legolas!... That was a mighty shot in the dark, my friend!'
subtitle: Son of Thranduil

title: Boromir
gametext:
Ranger.
Fellowship: Add (2) to heal Boromir.
lore: ...seated a little apart was a tall man with a fair and noble face... proud and stern of glance.
subtitle: Defender of Minas Tirith

title: The One Ring
gametext:
While wearing The One Ring, the Ring-bearer is strength +2, and each time he is about to take a wound in a skirmish, add a burden instead.
Skirmish: Add a burden to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.
lore: '...thought to have perished from the world.'
subtitle: Answer To All Riddles

title: The One Ring
gametext:
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he wears The One Ring until the regroup phase.
While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound during a skirmish, add a burden instead.
lore: One Ring to rule them all....
subtitle: The Ruling Ring

title: Anger
gametext: Skirmish: Spot 3 [dunland] minions or a site you control to make a [dunland] Man fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: Rage filled the hearts of the Dunlending attackers.

title: Band of Wild Men
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may make it fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: 'The Wild Men of Dunland have no love for Théoden of Rohan since he took their land.'

title: Burn Every Village
gametext: Skirmish: Make a [dunland] Man strength +2 (or +4 if you control a site).
lore: 'Take your rabble through the Westemnet; take back the lands they stole from you.'

title: Constantly Threatening
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Shadow: If the fellowship has moved more than once this turn, remove (2) to play a [dunland] Man from your discard pile.
lore: The men of Dunland have hated the Rohirrim for many years.

title: Dark Fury
gametext: Skirmish: Make a [dunland] Man strength +2 (or +4 if at a sanctuary).
lore: Dunland and Dunlendings are the names that the Rohirrim gave to them, because they were swarthy and dark-haired....

title: Death to the Strawheads
gametext: Skirmish: Make a [dunland] Man strength +1 for each companion you spot.
lore: The dark Dunlendings called their fair-haired enemies from Rohan "Strawheads."

title: Dunlending Arsonist
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a [dunland] Man from hand; his twilight cost is -2. That Man is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'They bring fire... and they are burning as they come, rick, cot, and tree.'

title: Dunlending Brigand
lore: 'This was a rich vale and had many homesteads. Alas for my folk!'

title: Dunlending Looter
gametext:
When this minion wins a skirmish, you may stack him on a site you control.
Shadow: If stacked on a site you control, play this minion. His twilight cost is -2.
lore: ...the Dunlendings raided often over the Isen.

title: Dunlending Madman
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may make him strength +2 and fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: 'They hate us, and they are glad; for our doom seems certain to them.'

title: Dunlending Pillager
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may discard a Free Peoples possession (or 2 possessions if you spot 6 companions).
lore: 'Not in half a thousand years have they forgotten their grievance that the lords of Gondor gave the Mark to Eorl the Young and made alliance with him.'

title: Dunlending Ransacker
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may spot another [dunland] Man to take control of a site.
lore: 'Yet there are many that cry in the Dunland tongue.'

title: Dunlending Ravager
gametext:
While skirmishing a [rohan] Man, this minion is strength +2.
Assignment: Spot an ally to make that ally participate in skirmishes and assign this minion to skirmish that ally.
lore: 'They will not give way now for dusk or dawn, until Théoden is taken, or they themselves are slain.'

title: Dunlending Robber
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may make him strength +2 and fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: 'We will fight....'

title: Dunlending Savage
lore: The Dunlendings' fury could only end in the death of the king of Rohan.

title: Dunlending Warrior
gametext: Assignment: Spot an ally to make that ally participate in skirmishes and assign this minion to skirmish that ally.
lore: These were a remnant of the peoples that had dwelt in the vales of the White Mountains in ages past.

title: Hides
gametext:
Plays to your support area. When you play this possession, you may draw a card.
Response: If a [dunland] Man is about to take a wound, remove (2) or discard this possession to prevent that wound.
lore: Only heavy animal skins armored the Dunlendings.

title: Hill Chief
gametext: Shadow: Spot a site you control and exert Hill Chief to draw 3 cards.
lore: '...Saruman has armed the wild hillmen and herdfolk of Dunland beyond the rivers, and these also he loosed upon us.'

title: Hillman Band
gametext: Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot another [dunland] Man to take control of a site.
lore: As in years past, the Dunlendings marched in force to the west.

title: Hillman Horde
gametext:
While you control 2 sites, skip the archery phase.
While you control 3 sites, each of your [dunland] Men is fierce.
While you control 4 sites, each of your [dunland] Men is damage +1.
lore: 'They are fierce folk when roused.'

title: Hillman Mob
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a [dunland] Man from hand; his twilight cost is -2. That Man is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'That old hatred Saruman has inflamed.'

title: Hillman Rabble
gametext:
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may stack it on a site you control.
Shadow: If stacked on a site you control, play this minion. Its twilight cost is -2.
lore: The relentless fury of the Dunlendings consumed one village after another.

title: Hillman Tribe
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may spot another [dunland] minion to take control of a site.
lore: 'They will not quail at the sun... the wild men of the hills.'

title: Iron Axe
gametext: Bearer must be a [dunland] Man.
lore: Saruman armed the Dunlendings with weapons forged by his Orcs in Isengard.

title: Living Off Rock
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each time a [dunland] Man wins a skirmish involving a [rohan] Man, you may make that minion strength +2 and fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: 'The Horsemen took your land; they drove your people into the hills to scratch living off rock.'

title: No Defense
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Shadow: Remove (3) to place a [dunland] token here.
Skirmish: Spot a [dunland] Man and remove a [dunland] token from this card. A character skirmishing that [dunland] Man does not gain strength bonuses from possessions.

cost.text: Choose DUNLAND Man

title: No Refuge
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
While a [dunland] Man is stacked on a site, the Shadow number of each site is +5.
lore: As their homes were ravaged by the wild men, refugees fled to the safety of Helm's Deep.

title: No Retreat
gametext:
Plays on a site you control.
Regroup: Spot 2 [dunland] Men and discard this condition to make the Free Peoples player choose to move again this turn (if the move limit allows).
lore: Hordes from Dunland laid waste to villages as their numbers grew.

title: Over the Isen
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Assignment: Spot a site you control and remove (2) to assign a [dunland] Man to an unbound companion.
lore: Like their ancestors years before, the Dunlendings came down from Isengard.

title: Ravage the Defeated
gametext: Response: If your [dunland] Man wins a skirmish, discard all Free Peoples cards borne by the companion or ally he was skirmishing.
lore: What the Dunlendings cannot steal, they destroy.

title: Saruman
gametext:
Saruman may not be assigned to a skirmish.
Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion for each [dunland] Man you can spot.
Skirmish: Exert Saruman to make a [dunland] Man strength +2.
subtitle: Rabble-rouser

title: Secret Folk
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving a [dunland] Man, you may place a [dunland] token on this card.
Maneuver: Discard a Free Peoples possession for each [dunland] token here (limit 3). Discard this condition.

title: Wake of Destruction
gametext: Maneuver: Spot 2 sites you control to make each of your [dunland] Men fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: The anger of the wild men increased with every home they pillaged.

title: War Club
gametext:
Bearer must be a [dunland] Man.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may discard 2 Free Peoples possessions.
lore: The wooden weapons of the wild men slew scores of unarmed villagers.

title: War Cry of Dunland
gametext: Response: If a [dunland] Man wins a skirmish, make him fierce and strength +4 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'Death to the Forgoil!'

title: Wild Man of Dunland
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a [dunland] Man from hand; his twilight cost is -2. That Man is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'By our blood... we swear to fight for you....'

title: Wild Man Raid
gametext: Maneuver: Spot 3 [dunland] Men to discard a Free Peoples possession or condition.
lore: Not even the smallest of trinkets was safe from the destruction of the Dunlendings.

title: Wulf
gametext:
Fierce.
Response: If another [dunland] Man wins a skirmish, exert Wulf to take control of a site.
lore: 'Do you not hear their voices?'
subtitle: Dunlending Chieftain

title: Axe of Erebor
gametext:
Bearer must be Gimli.
He is damage +1.
Skirmish: Discard a [dwarven] condition or a card stacked on a [dwarven] condition to make Gimli strength +1.
lore: '...wherever thou goest my thought goes with thee. But have a care to lay thine axe to the right tree!'

texts: Discard a card stacked on a DWARVEN condition

title: Best Company
gametext: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +4 if at a battleground).
lore: An axe swung and swept back. Two Orcs fell headless. The rest fled.

title: Come Here Lad
gametext: Fellowship: Stack the top 2 cards from your draw deck on a [dwarven] condition that has a card already stacked on it.
lore: 'You are the canniest, luckiest, most reckless fool I've ever met! Bless you.'

title: Courtesy of My Hall
gametext:
Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, stack a card from your discard pile here.
Fellowship: Discard a Free Peoples card stacked here to heal a Dwarf.
lore: 'Now my guests, come!... Come and take such refreshment as haste allows.'

title: Dwarven Foresight
gametext: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to take a Free Peoples card stacked on a [dwarven] condition into hand.
lore: 'I would guess that the burned bones of the hobbits are now mingled with the Orcs'.'

title: Ever My Heart Rises
gametext:
Tale. Plays to your support area.
When you play this condition, reveal the top 6 cards of your draw deck and stack them here.
Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf and discard the top card of your draw deck to take a Free Peoples card stacked here into hand.

effects.text: Discard 1 card from the top of your draw deck to take a Free Peoples card stacked here into hand.
Discard cards from the top of your deck to no effect.

effect.text: Choose how many times to discard 5 cards from draw deck

title: From the Armory
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf and stack a Free Peoples card from hand here to prevent all wounds to that Dwarf.
lore: 'It's a bit tight around the chest.'

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1.
Gimli is strength +1 for each unbound Hobbit companion you can spot.
lore: 'You speak evil of that which is fair beyond the reach of your thought, and only little wit can excuse you.'
subtitle: Lockbearer

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: Exert Gimli to make an unbound companion strength +1 (or +2 if that companion is Legolas).
lore: But a small dark figure that none had observed sprang out of the shadows and gave a hoarse shout: Baruk Khazâd!
subtitle: Unbidden Guest

title: Here Is Good Rock
gametext:
Tale. Plays to your support area.
Skirmish: Stack a Free Peoples card from hand here to make a Dwarf damage +1.
