effect.text: Would you like to wound the Ring-bearer to prevent adding a burden?

title: Morgul Cur
gametext: While you can spot a Nazgûl, this minion is strength +2.
lore: 'They swarmed across like beetles.'

title: Morgul Destroyer
gametext:
When you play this minion, you may spot a Nazgûl to add 2 threats. The Free Peoples player may wound the Ring-bearer to prevent this.
Skirmish: Remove a threat to make this minion strength +3.

effect.text: Would you like to wound the Ring-bearer to prevent adding 2 threats?

title: Morgul Detachment
gametext: While you can spot a Nazgûl, this minion is fierce and damage +1.
lore: 'His own folk quail at him, and they would slay themselves at his bidding.'

title: Morgul Hound
gametext: While you can spot 2 wounds on the Ring-bearer, this minion is strength +4 and fierce.
lore: All that host was clad in sable, dark as the night.

title: Morgul Lackey
gametext: Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a Nazgûl or [wraith] Orc strength +1.
lore: 'He uses others as his weapons.'

title: Morgul Mongrel
gametext: While you can spot 3 wounds on the Ring-bearer, this minion is fierce and damage +1.
lore: The old wound throbbed with pain and a great chill spread towards Frodo's heart.

title: Morgul on the March
gametext:
To play, spot a Nazgûl.
Each time the Free Peoples player draws a card (except during the regroup phase), add a threat.
Regroup: Discard a Nazgûl and this condition to add a threat.

title: Morgul Predator
gametext: Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a Nazgûl or [wraith] Orc strength +1.
lore: '...driving his slaves in madness on before.'

title: Morgul Regiment
gametext:
For each Nazgûl you can spot, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion to assign this minion to a skirmish.
Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a Nazgûl or [wraith] Orc strength +1.
lore: ...a host had issued from Minas Morgul....

effects.text: Would you like to exert a companion for each Nazgûl you can spot to be able to assign Morgul Regiment to skirmish?

title: Morgul Ruffian
gametext: While you can spot a Nazgûl, this minion may only take wounds during skirmish phases.
lore: ...while the less stout-hearted quailed and wept.

title: Morgul Soldier
gametext: Nazgûl are strength +1.
lore: ...ever and anon, high above the city, a faint cry would come....

title: Morgul Spawn
gametext: While you can spot a Nazgûl, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion to assign this minion to a skirmish.
lore: '...the fear of him has passed before him over the River.'

effects.text: Would you like to exert a companion to be able to assign Morgul Spawn to skirmish?

title: Morgul Spearman
gametext: While you can spot a Nazgûl, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion to assign this minion to a skirmish.
lore: 'And we have learned... that the Black Captain leads them once again....'

effects.text: Would you like to exert a companion to be able to assign Morgul Spearman to skirmish?

title: Morgul Whelp
gametext: While you can spot a wound on the Ring-bearer, this minion is strength +6.

title: Nazgûl Scimitar
gametext:
Bearer must be a [wraith] minion.
While you can spot 5 threats, bearer is damage +1.
lore: ...small black figures in rank upon rank....

title: Out of Sight and Shot
gametext:
To play, spot a Nazgûl.
Each time a companion is played, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion.
Shadow: Spot a Nazgûl and discard this condition to play a Nazgûl from your discard pile.

title: Put Forth His Strength
gametext:
To play, spot a Nazgûl.
Shadow: If you have initiative and there are 3 characters in the dead pile, spot 3 burdens, 3 threats and a Nazgûl to corrupt the Ring-bearer.
lore: ...so their voices, which uttered only his will and malice, were filled with evil and horror.

title: Stronghold of Minas Morgul
gametext:
Response: If your [wraith] minion wins a skirmish, place a [wraith] token here (limit 1 per site).
Regroup: Spot 3 [wraith] tokens here to exhaust the Ring-bearer. Discard this condition.

title: Their Power Is in Terror
gametext: Exert a Nazgûl to wound each ally.

title: There Came a Cry
gametext: Spot a Nazgûl to add a threat (or 3 threats if you have initiative).
lore: Mingled with harsh high voices as of birds of prey....

title: Too Late
gametext:
Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgûl.
Each time bearer exerts, add (1).
lore: At that moment the rock quivered and trembled beneath them.

title: Úlairë Attëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Shadow: If you have initiative, exert Úlairë Attëa and spot another [wraith] minion to add a burden.
lore: ...faint, but heart-quelling, cruel and cold.
subtitle: Wraith on Wings

title: Úlairë Cantëa
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play Úlairë Cantëa, add a threat for each companion over 4.
Maneuver: Remove 2 threats and spot another [wraith] minion to discard a possession.
lore: ...and of the winged terror, the Nazgûl.
subtitle: Faster Than Winds

title: Úlairë Enquëa
gametext:
Fierce.
While you can spot 6 companions, Úlairë Enquëa is damage +1.
Each time a companion is killed, you may exert Úlairë Enquëa to exert the Ring-bearer.
subtitle: Faster Than Winds

title: Úlairë Lemenya
gametext:
Úlairë Lemenya is strength +1 for each other [wraith] minion you can spot.
While you can spot 3 [wraith] minions Úlairë Lemenya is fierce.
While you can spot 4 [wraith] minions Úlairë Lemenya is damage +1.
subtitle: Assailing Minion

title: Úlairë Lemenya
gametext: Regroup: If you have initiative, discard Úlairë Lemenya to discard a possession.
lore: And even at that moment the sun for a second faltered and was obscured, as though a dark wing had passed across it.
subtitle: Wraith on Wings

title: Úlairë Nelya
gametext:
Fierce.
Skirmish: Discard a [wraith] minion to make Úlairë Nelya strength +2.
lore: He shuddered, and hope seemed to wither.
subtitle: Assailing Minion

title: Úlairë Nelya
gametext:
Fierce.
Regroup: If you have initiative, discard Úlairë Nelya to exert each Ring-bound companion.
lore: 'It is the sign of our fall, and the shadow of doom, a Fell Rider of the air.'
subtitle: Black-Mantled Wraith

title: Úlairë Nertëa
gametext: Regroup: If you have initiative, discard Úlairë Nertëa to add a burden.
lore: 'I fear that Minas Tirith shall fall. Night comes. The very warmth of my blood seems stolen away.'
subtitle: Black-Mantled Wraith

title: Úlairë Otsëa
gametext: Regroup: If you have initiative, discard Úlairë Otsëa to make the Free Peoples player exert a Ring-bound companion twice or return an unbound companion to his or her hand.
lore: ...horrible as carrion-fowl yet greater than eagles, cruel as death.

texts: Return an unbound companion to your hand

subtitle: Black-Mantled Wraith

title: Úlairë Toldëa
gametext:
Fierce.
While you have initiative and can spot a Nazgûl, Úlairë Toldëa's twilight cost is -6.
lore: Almost beyond hearing he thought he caught, high and far up in the heavens, a cry....
subtitle: Wraith on Wings

title: War Long Planned
gametext: Make a [wraith] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if you spot 2 wounds on the Ring-bearer).
lore: 'Through many ages Sauron has hated the West....'

title: The Witch-king
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play The Witch-king, you may remove a threat to take a [wraith] card into hand from your discard pile.
The Ring-bearer cannot take threat wounds.
subtitle: Morgul King

title: Déor
gametext:
Villager.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard a card from hand to make a [rohan] Man strength +1.
lore: As the king approached many men sprang up out of the rocks....

title: Death They Cried
gametext: Spot a mounted [rohan] Man to exert a minion. That minion's owner may exert a companion and if he or she does so, you may exert a minion; repeat this until a player does not exert a character.
lore: But the Rohirrim sang no more. Death they cried with one voice....

title: Elfhelm
gametext:
Valiant.
Skirmish: Exert Elfhelm to make him strength +1 for each uncontrolled plains site you can spot.
lore: 'There seemed to be some understanding between Dernhelm and Elfhelm, the Marshal who commanded the éored in which they were riding.'
subtitle: Marshal of Rohan

title: Elite Rider
gametext:
When this companion is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1.
While skirmishing a wounded minion, this companion is strength +2.

title: Enraged Horseman
gametext: While you can spot another [rohan] Man and this companion is skirmishing a wounded minion, this companion is strength +2 and damage +1.
lore: Doom drove them on. Darkness took them, / horse and horseman; hoofbeats afar / sank into silence: so the songs tell us.

title: Éomer
gametext:
Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1.
Fellowship: Play a [rohan] companion to take a [rohan] possession or [rohan] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile.
lore: '...call the heralds, Éomer.... Let the Riders be marshalled!'
subtitle: Skilled Tactician

title: Éowyn
gametext:
Valiant.
While skirmishing a mounted minion, Éowyn is strength +2.
While skirmishing a fierce minion, Éowyn is strength +2.
lore: 'Do you not? Then call me Dernhelm.'
subtitle: Dernhelm

title: Éowyn
gametext: Skirmish: Discard a possession borne by Éowyn to make her strength +2.
lore: He turned and saw her as a glimmer... for she was clad in white; but her eyes were on fire.
subtitle: Restless Maiden

title: Éowyn's Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be Éowyn.
You may play this possession any time you could play a skirmish event.
When you play this possession, you may wound a minion Éowyn is skirmishing.
lore: A swift stroke she dealt, skilled and deadly.
subtitle: Dernhelm's Blade

title: Fey He Seemed
gametext: Make a [rohan] Man strength +2 (or +3 and damage +1 if skirmishing a wounded minion).
lore: ...the battle-fury of his fathers ran like new fire in his veins....

title: Firefoot
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
Regroup: If bearer is Éomer, exert him to discard a condition. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.

effect.text: Would you like to remove (1) to prevent discarding a condition

subtitle: Éomer's Steed

title: Grimbold
gametext:
Valiant.
Skirmish: Replace the fellowship's site with your plains site of the same number to discard a card from hand.
lore: 'And Grimbold shall lead his towards the left.'
subtitle: Marshal of Rohan

title: Guarded Fastness
gametext: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to heal all [rohan] allies.
lore: '...for I will not leave my strongholds all unguarded.'

title: Guthláf
gametext: Skirmish: Discard a [rohan] condition to make Guthláf strength +1.
lore: And straightaway all the horns in the host were lifted up in music....
subtitle: Herald

title: Herugrim
gametext:
Bearer must be Théoden.
He is damage +1.
Response: If Théoden is about to take a wound and you cannot spot 3 threats, add 2 threats to prevent that wound.
lore: Out swept his sword, and he spurred to the standard, hewed staff and bearer....
subtitle: Sword of the Mark

title: His Golden Shield

lore: ...even as Oromë the Great in the battle of the Valar when the world was young.

texts: Place a random card from hand beneath draw deck

title: Knights of His House
gametext: Choose an opponent. For each mounted companion you spot, that opponent must remove (1) or place a random card from hand beneath his or her draw deck.
lore: Éomer rode there, and the white horsetail on his helm floating in his speed....

texts: Place a random card from hand beneath draw deck

title: Léowyn
gametext:
Villager.
Fellowship: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to heal a [rohan] Man.
lore: '...when they saw the king they cried with glad voices: 'Théoden King! Théoden King!'

title: Long Spear
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
You may add a threat to play this possession any time you could play a skirmish event.
lore: ...more skilled was their knighthood with long spears....

title: Merry's Armor
gametext:
Bearer must be Merry.
While you can spot 3 [rohan] Men, Merry cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
lore: 'Rise now, Meriadoc, esquire of Rohan of the household of Meduseld!'

title: Merry's Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be Merry.
Maneuver: Exert Merry twice to exert a minion once for each [rohan] companion you spot.
lore: Merry's sword had stabbed him from behind, shearing through the black mantle....

title: Morning Came
gametext: Make a [rohan] Man strength +4. Any Shadow player may place a random card from hand beneath his or her draw deck to make that Man strength +2 instead.
lore: ...morning and a wind from the sea; and darkness was removed, and the hosts of Mordor wailed....

effect.text: Would you like to place a random card from hand beneath draw deck to reduce the bonus to +2 for {chosenMan}?

title: Mustering for Battle
gametext:
To play, spot 3 [rohan] Men.
Maneuver: Exert a [rohan] companion twice or discard this condition to play a [rohan] possession from your discard pile.
lore: 'For we are already at war, as you may have seen, and you do not find us all unprepared.'

title: Riding Armor
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
Response: If you have initiative and bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, discard 3 cards from hand to prevent that wound.

title: Rohirrim Guard
gametext: Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to exert a minion skirmishing this companion.
lore: ...and strengthened his host by some three score of Riders that came late to the weapontake.

title: Rohirrim Herdsman
gametext:
Villager. To play, spot 2 [rohan] Men.
Regroup: Discard 3 cards from hand to remove a threat.
lore: ...he found the remaining strength of his people already assembled....

title: Rohirrim Javelin
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
Archery: Discard this possession to make the fellowship archery total +1.
lore: ...the Rohirrim went hither and thither at their will.

title: Seeking New Foes
gametext:
Skirmishes are resolved in an order decided by the first Shadow player.
Each time a [rohan] Man wins a skirmish, place a [rohan] token here. Each [rohan] Man is strength +1 for each token here.
Discard this condition during the regroup phase.

title: Snowmane
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
Regroup: If bearer is Théoden, exert him to liberate a site. Any Shadow player may remove (2) to prevent this.

effect.text: Would you like to remove (2) to prevent liberating a site?

title: Stern People
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [rohan] Men.
Regroup: Discard cards from hand equal to the number of cards in an opponent's hand to make the move limit +1 for this turn. Each Shadow player may take up to 4 cards into hand from his or her discard pile. Discard this condition.

title: Strong Arms
gametext:
To play, spot a [rohan] Man. Plays on a site.
This site is a plains.
Each [rohan] Man is strength +1 at this site.
lore: 'But he knows that we are a people who fight rather upon horseback and in the open....'

title: Swift Steed
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
While at a plains site, bearer takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish.
At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.

title: Théoden
gametext:
Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Théoden's twilight cost is -1.
Each time the fellowship moves, you may exert a [rohan] companion to exert a minion.
lore: Forth rode Théoden. Five nights and days / east and onward rode the Eorlingas....
subtitle: Leader of Spears

title: Théoden
gametext:
While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Théoden's twilight cost is -1.
Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, play a [rohan] possession on Théoden and add (2) to heal another [rohan] companion.
subtitle: Rekindled King

title: They Sang as They Slew
gametext: Exert X mounted companions to wound X minions.
lore: ...for the joy of battle was on them, and the sound of their singing that was fair and terrible came even to the City.

title: Veteran Horseman
gametext: Skirmish: Exert this companion to make him strength +1 for each mounted companion you spot.
lore: ...through Folde and Fenmarch and the Firienwood, six thousand spears to Sunlending....

title: White Hot Fury
gametext: Make a mounted [rohan] Man strength +1 for each mounted companion. If that Man is skirmishing a [raider] minion, also make him or her strength +2 and damage +2.
lore: Fewer were they but they clove through the Southrons like a fire-bolt in a forest.

title: Wind in His Face
gametext: Make a [rohan] Man strength +2. If that Man is mounted, choose an opponent who must place a random card from hand beneath his or her draw deck.
lore: Far, far away, in the South the clouds could be dimly seen as remote grey shapes, rolling up, drifting: morning lay beyond them.

title: Windfola
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
Skirmish: If bearer is Éowyn, exert her twice to wound a fierce minion she is skirmishing.

title: With Strength to Fight
gametext:
To play, spot a [rohan] companion.
Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
Regroup: Discard this condition to heal up to 2 [rohan] companions.
lore: '...it is a long road....'

title: Above the Battlement
gametext: Play a besieger stacked on a site you control or remove a burden to play a [sauron] Orc from your discard pile.
lore: ...they began to throw missiles marvellously high....

texts: Play a besieger stacked on a site you control
Remove a burden to play a {SAURON} Orc from discard

title: Anguish
gametext: Remove 3 threats to make a character skirmishing a [sauron] Orc strength -3.
lore: '...the Rammas is breached far and wide....'

title: Army of Udûn
gametext:
Shadow: Discard a [sauron] Orc to add a threat.
Skirmish: Remove a threat to make Army of Udûn strength +1.
Regroup: Discard Army of Udûn and X other [sauron] Orcs to add X threats.

title: Besieging Pike
gametext:
Bearer must be a [sauron] Orc.
If you have initiative, bearer is strength +3.
lore: ...all day more force and gear of war had poured across.

title: Breached
gametext: Remove 4 threats and spot 2 [sauron] Orcs to make the Free Peoples player spot a companion and place that companion in the dead pile.
lore: 'Yet now under the Lord of Barad-dûr the most fell of all his captains is already master of your outer walls....'

title: Din of Arms
gametext: Choose an opponent to discard the top card of his or her draw deck. If the twilight cost of that card is less than the number of besiegers you spot, take control of a site and all besiegers are strength +3 until the regroup phase.

title: Encirclement
gametext:
For each 2 sites you control, the twilight cost of each of your [sauron] cards is -1.
Regroup: Spot a [sauron] minion to draw a card (or draw 2 cards instead if that minion is a besieger). Discard this condition.

title: Fires Raged Unchecked
gametext:
The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -1 for each threat.
While you can spot 3 threats, each [sauron] Orc that is not roaming is strength +1.
lore: And so slowly they passed out of a dim day of fears into the darkness of a desperate night.

title: Gorgoroth Attacker
gametext:
Besieger.
When you play this minion from a site you control, add a burden for each site you control.
lore: ...the weakest point in all that high and impenetrable wall.

title: Gorgoroth Axeman
gametext:
Besieger.
Skirmish: Discard this minion to make a [sauron] minion strength +1 for each site you control (or +2 if you have initiative).
lore: Down from the hills... poured Orcs innumerable.

title: Gorgoroth Engineer
gametext:
Besieger.
When you play this minion from a site you control, add 2 threats.
lore: From behind the battle the River had been swiftly bridged....

title: Gorgoroth Garrison
gametext:
Besieger.
Regroup: Discard 2 cards from hand to stack a [sauron] Orc on a site you control (or discard 1 card from hand if that Orc is a besieger).
lore: ...their purpose was only to test the strength of the defence....

title: Gorgoroth Officer
gametext:
Besieger.
Skirmish: Discard 2 cards from hand to play a [sauron] Orc stacked on a site you control. That Orc is fierce and strength +6 until the regroup phase.
lore: The drums rolled louder. Fires leaped up.

title: Gorgoroth Pillager
gametext:
Besieger.
While this minion is stacked on a site you control, besiegers are fierce.
lore: Great engines crawled across the field....

title: Gorgoroth Ransacker
gametext:
Besieger.
Skirmish: If this minion is stacked on a site you control, discard him to make a [sauron] Orc strength +5 (or +10 if you have initiative).
lore: ...company upon company of the enemy pressed to the walls.

title: Gorgoroth Sapper
gametext:
Besieger.
Shadow: Discard 2 cards from hand to play a [sauron] Orc stacked on a site you control (discard 1 card from hand instead if that Orc is a besieger).
lore: It was against the Gate that he would throw his heaviest weight.

title: Gorgoroth Soldier
gametext:
Besieger.
Response: If a besieger is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent it.
lore: Ever since the middle night the great assault had gone on.

title: Gorgoroth Troop
gametext:
Besieger.
Skirmish: Stack your besieger on a site you control to make Gorgoroth Troop strength +2.
lore: 'They are strong: battalions of Orcs of the Eye....'

title: Great Peril of Fire
gametext:
To play, spot a besieger or a site you control.
Maneuver: Discard an engine to discard a condition from the Free Peoples support area.
lore: ...all who could be spared were busy quelling the flames that sprang up in many places.

title: Great Siege-towers
gametext:
Engine.
Shadow: Play a besieger to place a [sauron] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [sauron] token from a condition to make a [sauron] Orc strength +1 (limit +2).

title: Host of Udûn
gametext: When you play Host of Udûn, you may remove X threats to make its twilight cost -X.
lore: The great doors of the Black Gate swung back wide. Out of it streamed a great host as swiftly as swirling waters when a sluice is lifted.

title: Legions of Morgul
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [sauron] Orcs and add up to 3 threats.
Each time a companion is about to be killed, you may remove a threat to make all minions fierce until the regroup phase.
Discard this condition and remove 3 threats at the start of the regroup phase.

title: Mordor Assassin
gametext: Response: If a companion is overwhelmed during a skirmish involving a [sauron] Orc and threat wounds are about to be placed, remove a threat to assign this minion to the Ring-bearer (even if the Ring-bearer is already assigned).
lore: Drums rolled and fires leaped up.

title: Mordor Defender
gametext: Skirmish: Exert this minion and spot another [sauron] minion to add a threat.
lore: ...towards Mordor where the first bitter assault would come....

title: Mordor Fighter
gametext: While you can spot a threat and another [sauron] Orc, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free People player's hand.
lore: The men of the West were trapped....

title: Mordor Guard
gametext:
Skirmish: Exert 3 [sauron] Orcs to add 3 threats.
When this minion is discarded, remove 3 threats.
lore: ...from the host of Mordor there went up a jeering yell.

title: Mordor Regular
gametext: Skirmish: Exert this minion and spot another [sauron] minion to add a threat.
lore: ...but the sun now climbing towards the South was veiled in the reeks of Mordor....

title: Mordor Savage
gametext: Skirmish: Exert this minion and spot another [sauron] minion to add a threat.
lore: ...he watched the enemy come charging to the assault.

title: Mordor Soldier
gametext: Skirmish: Remove a threat to make this minion strength +4.
lore: ...or the end maybe of all the world of light.

title: Mordor Trooper
gametext: Skirmish: Remove 2 threats to make a [sauron] Orc strength +6.
lore: ...and then all hope was quenched.

title: Mordor Veteran
gametext: Skirmish: Remove 3 threats to make a [sauron] minion strength +8.
lore: ...the first assault crashed into them.

title: Mordor Warrior
gametext: Skirmish: Discard a card from your hand to make a companion skirmishing this minion strength -1 for each other [sauron] Orc you spot (limit -3).
lore: Sauron had taken the proffered bait in jaws of steel.

title: Orc Archer Troop
gametext:
Archer.
If you have initiative, the minion archery total is +1 and Orc Archer Troop is fierce.
lore: The wind blew, and the trumpets sang, and arrows whined....

title: Orc Assault Band
gametext: Skirmish: Spot 6 companions and exert this minion to make another [sauron] Orc strength +6.
lore: The plain was dark with their marching companies....

title: Orc Brood
gametext: Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to make this minion strength +3.
lore: ...the vomit of the maggot-folk of Mordor.

title: Orc Butcher
gametext: For each [sauron] condition you can spot, this minion is strength +1.

title: Orc Chaser
gametext:
Tracker.
The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -1.
While you have initiative, this minion is strength +6.
lore: But still the Enemy made no sign.

title: Orc Destroyer
gametext: Shadow: Remove (3) and spot 3 [sauron] Orcs to draw a card.
lore: ...all the hills and rocks about the Morannon were filled with hidden foes....

title: Orc Fanatic
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this minion to make another [sauron] Orc strength +3.
lore: ...far away he saw fires spring up....

title: Orc Marauder
gametext: While you can spot 3 other [sauron] Orcs, this minion is strength +5.
lore: ...their bodies were cast aside... and others took their place.

title: Orc Officer
gametext: Each time a companion is overwhelmed in a skirmish that involves a [sauron] Orc, add 3 burdens.
lore: ...and the shadowy defile beyond was bored and tunnelled by teeming broods of evil things.

title: Orc Pursuer(2)
gametext:
Tracker.
The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -1.
While you have initiative, this minion is strength +5.
lore: ...and they knew that they were watched.

title: Orc Rager
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this minion to make another [sauron] Orc strength +4.
lore: The drums rolled and rattled.

title: Orc Savage
gametext: While you can spot 6 companions and another [sauron] Orc, this minion is strength +9 and fierce.
lore: North amid the noisome pits lay the first of the great heaps and hills of slag....

title: Orc Seeker
gametext:
Tracker.
The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -1.
If you have initiative when you play this minion, you may spot another [sauron] Orc to draw 2 cards.
lore: ...even before they came to the gate Sauron sprang his trap.

title: Orc Stalker
gametext:
Tracker.
The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -1.
While you have initiative, this minion is strength +8.
lore: ...his soldiers blew their horns in a signal long arranged....

title: Rally the Host
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [sauron] Orcs.
Regroup: Exert a [sauron] Orc and remove a threat to shuffle a [sauron] Orc from play into your draw deck.
lore: And now the fighting waxed furious on the fields of the Pelennor....

title: Rope and Winch
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [sauron] Orcs.
Discard any number of cards from hand. The Free Peoples player then discards any number of cards from hand. For each card you discarded more than the Free Peoples player, make a [sauron] Orc strength +2.

title: Sauron's Hatred
gametext:
To play, spot a [sauron] Orc.
Shadow: Remove a threat to play a [sauron] Orc without paying any roaming penalty.
Regroup: Spot a [sauron] Orc and remove (4) to add a threat.

title: Siege Commander
gametext:
Besieger.
Skirmish: Discard 2 cards from hand to make a besieger fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: 'They have taken the wall!'

title: Siegecraft
gametext: If your [sauron] Orc wins a skirmish, make all your [sauron] Orcs fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: 'They are blasting breaches in it.'

title: Some Secret Art of Flame
gametext:
To play, spot a [sauron] Orc.
Regroup: Play a [sauron] condition to place a [sauron] token on this card.
While there are 3 tokens on this card, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.

title: Stronghold of Cirith Ungol
gametext:
Response: If your [sauron] minion wins a skirmish, place a [sauron] token here (limit 1 per site).
Regroup: Add (2) for each token here. Discard this condition.
lore: In the Land of Mordor where the Shadows lie.

title: Tower Walkway
gametext:
Engine. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc.
Each besieger is strength +1 for each site you control.
Regroup: Discard 3 [sauron] Orcs to take control of a site. Discard this condition.
lore: ...the hidden Captain put forth his strength.

title: Troop Tower
gametext:
Engine. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc.
All [sauron] Orcs are strength +1 for each besieger stacked on a site.
Regroup: Discard a besieger to take control of a site. Discard this condition.
lore: Slowly the great siege-towers built in Osgiliath rolled forward through the dark.

title: Frodo
gametext:
Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Ring-bound.
Each time the fellowship moves, you may add (3) to remove a threat.
lore: 'Aiya Eärendil Elenion Ancalima!'
subtitle: Hope of Free Peoples

title: Frodo
gametext:
Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Ring-bound.
Skirmish: At sites 6[K] to 8[K], add 4 burdens to wound a minion skirmishing Frodo.
lore: 'Wicked masster cheats us; cheats Sméagol, gollum.'
subtitle: Wicked Masster!

title: Hobbit Sword
gametext: Bearer must be a Hobbit.

title: Merry
gametext: Skirmish: If you cannot spot 3 threats, add a threat to make Merry strength +2.
lore: 'I will be ready... even if you bid me ride with you on the Paths of the Dead.'
subtitle: Rohirrim Squire

title: Merry
gametext: Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, return him to your hand to play up to 2 [rohan] possessions from your discard pile.
lore: 'And I would not have it said of me in song only that I was always left behind!'
subtitle: Swordthain

title: Noble Intentions
gametext: Exert a companion (except a Hobbit) to make a Hobbit strength +3.

title: Pippin
gametext: While you cannot spot 4 threats, Pippin is strength +1 for each threat you can spot.
lore: 'I do not know what put it into your head, or your heart, to do that. But it was well done.'
subtitle: Sworn to Service

title: Pippin
gametext: Skirmish: If Pippin is not assigned to a skirmish, return him to your hand to wound a roaming minion twice.
lore: 'And as for orders, I think you have a madman to deal with, not a lord.'
subtitle: Wearer of Black and Silver

title: Pressing On
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Hobbits.
Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
Regroup: Discard this condition and exert a Hobbit companion to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).

title: Sam
gametext:
Ring-bound.
Fellowship: Play a Hobbit companion to remove a burden.
Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
lore: '...but where there's life there's hope, as my Gaffer used to say....'
subtitle: Needer of Vittles

title: Sam
gametext:
Ring-bound.
Fellowship: If you have initiative, discard a card from hand to heal Sam.
Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
lore: The news that his master was still alive roused him....
subtitle: Resolute Halfling

title: Slow-kindled Courage
gametext:
Bearer must be Merry or Pippin.
Each minion gains this ability: "Assignment: Assign this minion to bearer of Slow-kindled Courage."
Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and remove 2 burdens.

modifier.text: Assign this minion to bearer of Reckless Pride.

title: Dunharrow Plateau
gametext: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to play a [dwarven] condition from your draw deck (limit once per turn).

title: Edoras Hall
gametext: The twilight cost of each [rohan] possession is -1.

title: Isengard Ruined
gametext: Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to add (2). Each player may draw a card.

effect.text: Would you like to draw a card?

title: Rohirrim Road
gametext: Fellowship: Exert an Elf to make the twilight cost of each condition and possession +2 until the end of the turn.

title: Sleeping Quarters
gametext: When the fellowship moves from this site, the Free Peoples player may spot 3 Hobbits to remove (2).

title: Steps of Edoras
gametext: Each [gondor] companion is defender +1 until the end of the turn.

title: King's Tent
gametext: Shadow: If the Shadow has initiative, spot your minion to make the move limit for this turn -1.

title: Rohirrim Camp
gametext: Plains. If the Shadow has initiative, minions are not roaming.

title: West Road
gametext: Plains. If the Shadow has initiative, the Shadow number of this site is +3.

title: Beacon of Minas Tirith
gametext: Sanctuary. Fellowship: If you cannot spot 3 threats, add a threat to heal a companion.

title: Hall of the Kings
gametext: Sanctuary. Fellowship: If you cannot spot 3 threats, add a threat to draw a card.

title: Tower of Ecthelion
gametext: Sanctuary. Fellowship: If you cannot spot 3 threats, add 3 threats to make the move limit for this turn +1.

title: Anduin Banks
gametext: River. Skirmish: Spot your minion and remove a burden to make that minion strength +2.

title: Osgiliath Fallen
gametext: Skirmish: Spot your minion and remove 2 burdens to make that minion damage +1.

title: Pelennor Plain
gametext: Plains. Archery: Spot your minion and remove 3 burdens to make the minion archery total +3.

title: City Gates
gametext: When the fellowship moves to this site, add 3 threats. When the fellowship moves from this site, remove 3 threats.

title: Pelennor Flat
gametext: Plains. At the start of the maneuver phase, the Free Peoples player must discard his or her hand or add 2 burdens.

title: Minas Tirith Fifth Circle
gametext: Sanctuary. If the fellowship moves from this site during the regroup phase, heal Gandalf three times.

title: Minas Tirith First Circle
gametext: Sanctuary. If the fellowship moves from this site during the regroup phase, wound each companion.

title: Minas Tirith Fourth Circle
gametext: Sanctuary. If the fellowship moves from this site during the regroup phase, heal each [rohan] companion.

title: Minas Tirith Second Circle
gametext: Sanctuary. If the fellowship moves from this site during the regroup phase, heal each [dwarven] companion.

title: Minas Tirith Seventh Circle
gametext: Sanctuary. If the fellowship moves from this site during the regroup phase, heal each [elven] companion.

title: Minas Tirith Sixth Circle
gametext: Sanctuary. If the fellowship moves from this site during the regroup phase, heal each [gondor] companion.

title: Minas Tirith Third Circle
gametext: Sanctuary. If the fellowship moves from this site during the regroup phase, heal each Hobbit companion.

title: Osgiliath Crossing
gametext: River. Shadow: Exert 2 minions and spot 6 companions to draw 2 cards.

title: Pelennor Grassland
gametext: Plains. Shadow: Exert a minion and spot 6 companions to add (1).

title: Ruined Capitol
gametext: River. Shadow: Spot your minion and 6 companions to make the move limit for this turn -1.

title: Cross Roads
gametext: Shadow: Spot 2 [raider] Men and remove a threat to add (2).

title: Morgul Vale
gametext: Skirmish: Spot your [sauron] minion and remove 2 threats to make your [sauron] minion strength +3.

title: Morgulduin
gametext: Shadow: Remove 2 threats to play a Nazgûl from your discard pile. His twilight cost is -2.

title: Northern Ithilien
gametext: Shadow: Remove 2 threats and play Gollum from your discard pile to add 2 burdens.

title: Dagorlad
gametext: Plains. When the fellowship moves to this site, add 3 threats.

title: Haunted Pass
gametext: Shadow: Remove a threat and spot your minion to draw a card.

title: Narchost
gametext: Shadow: Spot 8 burdens to make the Ring-bearer wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.

title: Slag Mounds
gametext: Each time a companion is killed, add a burden.

title: Aragorn
gametext:
While you cannot spot 4 threats, Aragorn is strength +1 for each threat.
Regroup: Exert Aragorn twice to remove 3 threats.
lore: '...for you will find both toil and great fear, and maybe worse.'
subtitle: Driven by Need

title: Éomer
gametext:
Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard 3 cards from hand to make Éomer strength +1 for each valiant companion you spot.
subtitle: Valiant Warchief

title: Aggression
gametext:
While you have initiative, each Dwarf is damage +1.
Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X to draw X cards. Discard this condition.
lore: 'Certainty of death, small chance of success....'

cost.text: Choose a Dwarf to spot

title: Battle in Earnest
gametext: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X to place X wounds on minions.
lore: '...they laughed when they looked on us, for they were a great army still.'

cost.text: Choose a Dwarf to spot

title: Blood Runs Chill
gametext: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X and exert that Dwarf twice to make an opponent discard X Shadow cards.
lore: ...the Dark Door gaped before them like the mouth of night.

title: Counts But One
gametext: If Gimli is not assigned to a skirmish, add a threat to have him replace an unbound companion in a skirmish.
lore: '...no matter how big.'

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1.
For each wound on Gimli, he is strength +1 and damage +1.
lore: Twenty, twenty-one, twenty-two....
subtitle: Counter of Foes

title: Honed
gametext: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X to make him strength +X.
lore: 'What are we waiting for?'

title: Unheard of
gametext: If a Dwarf who is damage +X wins a skirmish, wound a minion not assigned to a skirmish X times.
lore: '...an Elf will go underground and a Dwarf dare not.'

title: Wish For Our Kinfolk
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf companion and either an [elven] companion or a [gondor] Man to add a [dwarven] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [dwarven] token here to make a companion damage +1.
lore: '...war already marches on their own lands.'

title: A Grey Ship
gametext: Spot an Elf companion and make the fellowship archery total -X (to a minimum of 0) to heal X unbound companions. You cannot use archery special abilities.
lore: '...full of ghosts.'

cost.text: Choose X (reduce fellowship archery total)

title: Legolas
gametext:
Archer.
While you can spot 3 wounded minions, each minion skirmishing Legolas is strength -3.
lore: ...Legolas of the Elves, for whom the ghosts of Men have no terror.
subtitle: Elven Stalwart

title: Life of the Eldar
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
Discard an Elf to draw 3 cards.
lore: 'Your hands are cold....'

title: Reckless We Rode
gametext: Exert an Elf companion and make the fellowship archery total -X (to a minimum of 0) to wound a minion X times. You cannot use archery special abilities.
lore: '...driving them like leaves....'

cost.text: Choose X (reduce fellowship archery total)

title: Shake Off the Shadow
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert an Elf companion and either a [gandalf] companion or a [dwarven] companion to add an [elven] token here.
Archery: Remove an [elven] token here to make the fellowship archery total +1 (limit +2).
lore: 'Speak and be comforted....'

title: A Fool
gametext: At sites 1[K] to 5[K], heal Gandalf. At any other site, prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
lore: '...but an honest fool he remains.'

title: Gandalf
gametext: When Gandalf is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -2.
lore: '...the rule of no realm is mine, neither of Gondor nor any other, great or small.'
subtitle: Leader of Men

title: Let Us Not Tarry
gametext: Exert Gandalf to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -1 for each Gandalf signet you spot.
lore: 'There is much to say and to do, and you are weary.'

title: Mighty Steed
gametext: If Gandalf is not assigned to a skirmish, spot Shadowfax or exert Gandalf to have Gandalf replace an unbound companion in a skirmish.
lore: 'He always turns up when things are darkest. Go on! Go on, White Rider! Gandalf! Gandalf!'

title: Not the First Halfling
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert Gandalf and either an [elven] companion or a [shire] companion to add a [gandalf] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [gandalf] token here to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -2.

title: On Your Doorstep
gametext: Spot Gandalf and exert a companion to place a card of that companion's culture from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.
lore: 'Lord Denethor is a Steward only.'

title: Saved From the Fire
gametext: Spot Gandalf and place a companion (except the Ring-bearer) in the dead pile to take up to 3 cards from that companion's culture into hand from your draw deck. Shuffle your draw deck.
lore: '...we will bear Faramir, Steward of Gondor, to a place where he can sleep in peace....'

title: Shadowfax
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, each minion skirmishing Gandalf must exert.
Skirmish: Add a threat to make Gandalf strength +1.
subtitle: Greatheart

title: Hidden Even From Her
gametext:
Gollum is fierce.
Shadow: Spot 6 companions to play Gollum from your discard pile and exert a companion. Place this condition on top of your draw deck.
lore: ...even when he had come to her again and had bowed low....

title: Larder
gametext:
To play, spot a [gollum] minion.
Regroup: Discard an Orc from hand to add a [gollum] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [gollum] token here to make Shelob strength +3 (limit +6).
lore: 'When she binds with cords, she's after meat.'

title: Promise Keeping
gametext: Each time a companion takes a wound during a skirmish that involves a [gollum] minion, exert a companion.
lore: 'And we'll save the Precious, as we promised.... Then we'll pay everyone back!'

title: Shelob
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play Shelob, you may play a [gollum] possession from your draw deck.
Shelob is strength +3 for each minion stacked on a [gollum] possession.
lore: ...who only desired death for all others....
subtitle: Eater of Light

title: Shelob
gametext:
Enduring. Fierce.
While in a fierce skirmish, Shelob is damage +1.
lore: ...for all living things were her food, and her vomit darkness.
subtitle: Last Child of Ungoliant

title: Sméagol
gametext:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Skirmish: Add threats equal to the total vitality of the minions Sméagol is skirmishing to discard Sméagol.
Regroup: Discard Sméagol to take a [gollum] minion from your discard pile into hand.
subtitle: Slippery Sneak

title: Spider Poison
gametext:
Skirmish: Remove a threat or a burden to transfer this possession to a companion skirmishing Shelob.
Each time bearer is assigned to a skirmish, bearer must exert.
lore: He lay now pale, and heard no voice, and did not move.

title: Still Far Ahead
gametext: Spot Sméagol to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary). The Shadow number of the fellowship's next site is -1 until the end of the turn.
lore: ...the very crown of this bitter road.

title: Web
gametext:
Regroup: If there are fewer than 3 cards stacked here, spot your Orc or [gollum] minion to stack that minion here.
Shadow: Play a [gollum] minion stacked here as if played from hand.
lore: 'Caught in a web. Soon he'll be eaten!'

title: At His Command
gametext: Exert Aragorn to make an unbound companion with the Aragorn signet strength +1 for each threat you spot.
lore: 'Even the shades of Men are obedient to his will....'

title: Catapult
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [gondor] knights.
Maneuver: Discard 2 cards from hand to reveal the top card of an opponent's draw deck. Choose an opponent who must discard a Shadow card that has a twilight cost that is the same as the twilight cost of the revealed card.

title: Elessar's Edict
gametext: If a [gondor] Wraith is about to be killed, discard him and either exhaust another [gondor] Wraith or spot another exhausted [gondor] Wraith to prevent that.
lore: 'Yes, the Dead ride behind. They have been summoned....'

title: Faramir
gametext:
Knight.
When you play Faramir (except in your starting fellowship), you may reveal the top 10 cards of your draw deck. You may play a knight revealed. Shuffle your draw deck.
lore: '...I will go and do what I can in his stead – if you command it.'
subtitle: Defender of Osgiliath

title: Fourth Level
gametext:
Fortification.
Skirmish: Exert 2 [gondor] Men or spot 3 knights to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man. Exhaust that minion.
lore: ...about each was set a wall....

title: Garrison of Gondor
gametext:
Knight. Archer.
To play, spot 3 [gondor] companions.
While you can spot a fortification, Garrison of Gondor is defender +1.
lore: But about the Gate resistance still was stout....

title: Imrahil
gametext:
Knight. To play, spot a knight.
Each time Imrahil wins a skirmish, you may exert 2 minions.
lore: ...he was of high blood, and his folk also, tall men and proud with sea-grey eyes.
subtitle: Prince of Dol Amroth

title: King of the Dead
gametext:
Enduring. To play, spot a [gondor] Wraith and add 2 threats.
Response: If Aragorn is about to take a wound in a skirmish, exert King of the Dead to prevent that wound.
lore: '...crying out that the King of the Dead was upon them.'
subtitle: Oathbreaker

title: Knight of Dol Amroth
gametext:
Knight.
Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion he is skirmishing.
lore: Amroth for Gondor!' they cried.

title: Knight's Mount
gametext:
Bearer must be a knight.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion who is not assigned to a skirmish.
lore: Like thunder they broke upon the enemy....

title: Oathbreaker
gametext:
Enduring. To play, add a threat.
Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to discard a possession borne by a minion skirmishing this companion.
lore: at the Stone of Erech they shall stand again / and hear there a horn in the hills ringing.

title: A Path Appointed
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert a [gondor] Man and either a [dwarven] companion or a [rohan] companion to add a [gondor] token here.
Regroup: Remove a [gondor] token here to discard a minion.
lore: '...those who follow me do so of their free will....'

title: Shadow Host
gametext:
Enduring. To play, spot 2 exhausted [gondor] Wraiths and add 2 threats.
While Shadow Host is exhausted, it is defender +1.
lore: ...fear went on before them, until they came to Calembel upon Ciril, and the sun went down like blood behind Pinnath Gelin....

title: Sixth Level
gametext:
Fortification.
Regroup: Exert a [gondor] Man to play a [gondor] fortification from your discard pile (limit 1).
lore: ...and in each wall was a gate.

title: Sleepless Dead
gametext:
Enduring. To play, add a threat.
Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may exert him to discard a minion he is skirmishing.
lore: '...for the Dead needed no longer any weapon but fear. None would withstand them.'

title: Spectral Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Wraith.
Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to heal bearer.
lore: '...pale banners like shreds of cloud, and spears like winter-thickets on a misty night.'

title: Stronger and More Terrible
gametext:
To play, add a threat.
Each time your [gondor] Wraith wins a skirmish, you may remove a threat.
lore: 'And lo! in the darkness of Mordor my hope rose....'

title: Swept Away
gametext:
Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
While you have initiative, exhausted [gondor] Wraiths cannot take wounds.
lore: 'And suddenly the Shadow Host that had hung back at the last came up like a grey tide, sweeping all away before it.'

title: Black Númenorean
gametext:
Corsair. Fierce.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, remove a [raider] token to discard a possession borne by a character skirmishing this minion.
lore: ...corrupted by Sauron, and who hated above all the followers of Elendil.

title: Black Sails of Umbar
gametext:
When you play this possession, you may add a [raider] token here.
Shadow: Remove X [raider] tokens here to play a corsair from your discard pile; its twilight cost is -X. Discard this possession.

cost.text: Choose how many {raider} tokens to remove

title: Castamir of Umbar
gametext:
Corsair. Enduring. Fierce.
Shadow: Exert Castamir of Umbar and play a corsair to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.
lore: 'They have long ceased to fear the might of Gondor.'

title: Corsair Ballista
gametext:
Bearer must be a corsair.
While you have initiative, bearer is an archer and fierce.
lore: Ranged weapons bristled from the warships and aided the Corsairs' plunder of coastal cities.

title: Corsair Buccaneer
gametext:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, you may remove a threat to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.
lore: '...a great fleet drawing near to the mouths of Anduin....'

title: Corsair Freebooter
gametext:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, you may remove 2 culture tokens to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.
lore: ...the strength of the rebels in Umbar was a great peril to Gondor....

title: Corsair Gunners
gametext:
Corsair.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, remove a [raider] token to make a corsair fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: 'The Corsairs are upon us!'

title: Corsair Lookout
gametext:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, if you have initiative, you may discard an ally to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.
lore: ...watchmen on the walls saw afar a new sight of fear, and their last hope left them.

title: Corsair Marauder
gametext:
Corsair.

title: Elendil
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [gondor] Men.
Fellowship: Play an artifact on Elendil to make the move limit +1 for this turn.
Regroup: Discard a [gondor] artifact to liberate a site.
lore: ...and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor....
subtitle: The Tall

title: Isildur
gametext:
While Isildur is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or exert 3 companions.
While Isildur bears The One Ring or an artifact, each [gondor] knight is strength +1.
lore: But for my part I will risk no hurt to this thing: of all the works of Sauron the only fair.
subtitle: Bearer of Heirlooms

title: Narsil
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
If bearer is Elendil or Isildur, he is strength +1 for each [gondor] artifact you can spot (limit +6).
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, exert 2 [gondor] Men to prevent that.
lore: '...Isildur cut the Ring from his hand....'
subtitle: Blade of the Faithful

title: Sapling of the White Tree
gametext:
To play, spot an unbound [gondor] Man.
Response: If a [gondor] Man is about to take a wound, discard this artifact to prevent that.
lore: Verily this is a sapling of the line of Nimloth the fair; and that was a seedling of Galathilion, and that a fruit of Telperion of many names, Eldest of 'Trees.'

title: Scroll of Isildur
gametext:
Tale. To play, spot a [gondor] Man.
The Ring-bearer is resistance +1 for each [gondor] artifact you can spot (limit +3).
Fellowship: Discard this artifact to play a ring from your discard pile.
lore: What evil it saith I do not know; but I trace here a copy of it, lest it fade beyond recall.

title: Seeing Stone of Minas Anor
gametext:
To play, spot a [gondor] Man with 3 or more vitality (or spot a [gondor] Man and add 2 threats).
Regroup: Exert a [gondor] Man or discard this artifact to discard your hand and draw 3 cards.
lore: 'Didst thou think that the eyes of the White Tower were blind?'

texts: Spot a {GONDOR} Man with 3 or more vitality
Spot a {GONDOR} Man and add 2 threats

title: Seeing Stone of Orthanc
gametext:
To play, spot a [gondor] Man with 3 or more vitality (or spot a [gondor] Man and add 2 threats).
Regroup: Add a threat or discard this artifact to remove (2) or to draw a card.
lore: 'I am the lawful master of the Stone, and I had both the right and the strength to use it, or so I judged.'

texts: Spot a {GONDOR} Man with 3 or more vitality
Spot a {GONDOR} Man and add 2 threats

title: Library of Orthanc
gametext:
Shadow: Play an [isengard] minion to stack the top card of your draw deck on this card.
Skirmish: Remove (1) and discard a Free Peoples card stacked here to make an [isengard] minion strength +1.
Regroup: Remove (1) to take an [isengard] card stacked here into hand.

title: Sack of the Shire
gametext: If an [isengard] minion wins a skirmish, until the regroup phase, make that minion strength +1 for each site you control and fierce.
lore: 'There's some devilry at work in the Shire....'

effect.text: Choose minion to give strength bonus and fierce

title: Host of Moria
gametext: When you play Host of Moria, you may play a [moria] card from your discard pile.
lore: There was a horn-blast and a rush of feet, and orcs one after another leaped into the chamber.
subtitle: Legion of the Underdeeps

title: Ring of Asperity
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
When you play this artifact, you may wound an unwounded companion.
Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.
lore: 'The Nine, the Seven, and the Three... had each their proper gem.'

title: Ring of Ire
gametext:
Bearer must be The Witch-king.
Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to make a [wraith] minion damage +1.
Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.
lore: 'Nine he gave to Mortal Men, proud and great, and so ensnared them.'

title: Ring of Rancor
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Maneuver: Remove a burden to heal each Nazgûl.
Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.
lore: 'So it is now: the Nine he has gathered to himself....'

title: Horn of the Mark
gametext:
Bearer must be Merry or Pippin.
Bearer gains the Théoden signet.
Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, exert him to discard each minion involved in that skirmish.
lore: 'He that blows it at need shall set fear in the hearts of his enemies and joy in the hearts of his friends....'

title: The Red Arrow
gametext: Assignment: Exert a [gondor] Man to play a [rohan] Man. You may exert that [rohan] Man to play a possession on him or her. Discard this artifact.
lore: 'The Red Arrow has not been seen in the Mark in all my years! Has it indeed come to that?'

effect.text: Would you like exert the played {ROHAN} Man to play a possession on him or her?

title: Ithil Stone
gametext:
To play, exert a [wraith] or [sauron] minion.
At the start of each of your Shadow phases, you may draw a card.
Shadow: Discard this artifact to play a [sauron] minion. Its twilight cost is -3.
lore: '...and in it there was a stone like the Moon....'

title: Sauron
gametext:
Damage +2. Enduring. Fierce.
For each burden you spot, threat you spot, and site you control, Sauron's twilight cost is -1.
lore: One for the Dark Lord on his dark throne / In the Land of Mordor where the Shadows lie.
subtitle: The Lord of the Rings

title: Bilbo
gametext:
Ring-bound.
Each time the fellowship moves, if the twilight pool has 2 or fewer twilight tokens, add 2 burdens or add (3).
Regroup: Add a burden to play a [shire] tale.
lore: 'But what has it got in its pocketses, eh?'
subtitle: Bearer of Things Burgled

title: Everyone Knows
gametext:
Tale. Each unbound Hobbit is strength +1 for each vitality over 3 he or she has.
Skirmish: Prevent an unbound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled. Discard this condition.
lore: '...I'm the tall one, you're the short one.'

title: Goldberry
gametext:
Each time the fellowship moves to a river, heal Goldberry and Tom Bombadil.
Skirmish: If the fellowship is at a river, exert Goldberry to make a companion strength +1.
lore: 'Slender as the willow-wand, clearer than the water.'
subtitle: River-daughter

title: Tom Bombadil
gametext:
To play, remove 2 burdens or 2 threats.
Skirmish: Spot 2 [shire] companions and exert Tom Bombadil X times, where X is the fellowship's site number, to cancel a skirmish involving a [shire] companion.
lore: 'Hey! Come derry dol! Can you hear me singing?'
subtitle: The Master

title: Great Day, Great Hour
gametext: If an opponent plays a minion, exert a Dwarf who is damage +X to exert that minion X times.
lore: 'Oft hope is born, when all is forlorn.'

title: Memories of Darkness
gametext:
To play, spot a Dwarf.
Each time you lose initiative (except during the fellowship phase), you may play a [dwarven] condition from hand or from your discard pile.
lore: 'Had I known what was before me, I think that not for any friendship would I have taken the Paths of the Dead.'

title: More Yet to Come
gametext: If a Dwarf kills a minion in a skirmish and that minion did not take all wounds caused by that Dwarf's damage bonus, assign those remaining wounds to minions not assigned to a skirmish.
lore: '...whatever is still to do, I hope to have a part in it, for the honour of the folk of the Lonely Mountain.'

effects.text: Play More Yet to Come for {killedMinion}

title: Aegnor
gametext: Skirmish: Exert Aegnor to make a minion skirmishing an unbound [elven] companion strength -1 for each archer you spot.
lore: Affectionately referred to as 'Figwit' by his contemporaries in Rivendell.
subtitle: Elven Escort

title: Arwen
gametext: Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to discard the bottom card of your draw deck. If the bottom card was an [elven] card, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -3.
lore: '...mine is the choice of Lúthien, and as she so have I chosen, both the sweet and the bitter.'
subtitle: Echo of Lúthien

title: Arwen
gametext: Each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -2 for each wounded minion you can spot.
lore: 'Often is it seen,' said Aragorn, 'that in dangerous days men hide their chief treasure.'
subtitle: Queen of Elves and Men

title: Celeborn
gametext: At the start of each skirmish involving Celeborn, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, you may discard it to wound each minion in that skirmish.
lore: ...with him went the last living memory of the Elder Days in Middle-earth.

true.text: Discard the card to wound each minion in this skirmish?

subtitle: Lord of the Galadhrim

title: Círdan
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
Skirmish: Exert Círdan to make a minion he is skirmishing strength -1 for each [elven] event in your discard pile.
lore: ...he was grey and old, save that his eyes were keen as stars....
subtitle: The Shipwright

title: Elrond
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
At the start of each skirmish involving Elrond, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, you may heal another Elf.
lore: 'To me then even our victory can bring only sorrow and parting – but to you hope of joy for a while.'
subtitle: Venerable Lord

title: Fleet-footed
gametext: Make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -2. Spot a site in a support area to place this event on top of your draw deck.
lore: Not all Elven weapons are carried in sheath or quiver.

title: Galadriel
gametext:
When Galadriel is in your starting fellowship, her twilight cost is -3.
Fellowship or Regroup: Discard an [elven] event from hand to discard a Shadow condition or Shadow possession.
lore: 'I pass the test,' she said. 'I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel.'
subtitle: Lady Redeemed

title: Glimpse of Fate
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
Each time you lose initiative, make a minion strength -4 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'The uttermost choice is before you: to repent and go to the Havens... or else to abide the Doom of Men.'

title: Phial of Galadriel
gametext:
Bearer must be a Hobbit.
Skirmish: Until the regroup phase, remove the game text (except card type and race) from a minion skirmishing bearer and make it unable to gain game text. Discard this artifact.
lore: ...the hand that held it sparkled with white fire.
subtitle: Star-glass

title: Borne Far Away
gametext: Spot your Wizard to exchange a companion in hand with a companion in your dead pile or discard pile.
lore: ...the wanderers were lifted up and borne far away out of the darkness and the fire.

texts: Exchange with card in dead pile

title: Brooding on Tomorrow
gametext: Each time you lose initiative (except during the fellowship phase), you may spot a [gandalf] companion to choose an opponent who must discard one of his or her conditions.
lore: '...tomorrow will be certain to bring worse than today, for many days to come.'

title: Gathering Wind
gametext: Exert your Wizard to choose a number. Make each minion with that twilight cost strength -2 until the regroup phase.
lore: ...the rush of their wide wings as they passed over was like a gale.

effect.text: Choose a minion cost

title: Out of the High Airs
gametext: If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, exert your Wizard to discard each minion.
lore: ...the Nazgûl turned and fled, and vanished into Mordor's shadows....

title: Treebeard
gametext:
To play, spot 3 [gandalf] companions.
Regroup: Exert Treebeard twice to play a [gandalf] condition from your discard pile and make an opponent discard one of his or her conditions.
lore: 'Leave it to the Ents!... Trees are coming back to live here, old trees, wild trees.'
subtitle: Keeper of the Watchwood

title: A Dark Shape Sprang
gametext: If an opponent plays a possession on a companion, play Gollum at twilight cost -2 from your discard pile or hand to suspend the current phase. Begin a skirmish phase involving Gollum and that companion. When it ends, resume the suspended phase.
lore: Something struck Sam violently in the back....

title: Final Strike
gametext:
Any site 9 is a mountain.
Shadow: If the fellowship is at any site 9, play Gollum from your discard pile.
Response: If the Free Peoples player uses a maneuver or archery special ability, exert Gollum to cancel its effect.
lore: The fires below awoke in anger....

title: Gollum
gametext: To assign Gollum to a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must make Gollum strength +3 until the regroup phase or add a burden.
lore: ...swiftly but warily, creeping on behind, a slinking shadow among the stones.
subtitle: Mad Thing

title: Reclaim the Precious
gametext:
Assignment: Assign Gollum to a companion bearing an artifact. The Free Peoples player may add a burden to prevent this and assign Gollum.
Regroup: Exert Gollum twice to discard a possession. Discard this condition.
lore: ...white fangs gleamed, and then snapped as they bit.

effect.preventText: Would you like to add a burden and assign Gollum to prevent assigning {chosenCompanion} to {gollum}?

title: Shelob
gametext:
Enduring. Fierce.
When you play Shelob, if you can spot Gollum, you may spot a companion. That companion cannot be assigned to a skirmish until the end of the turn.
lore: ...she served none but herself, drinking the blood of Elves and Men....
subtitle: Her Ladyship

title: Unabated in Malice
gametext:
While you have initiative, each [gollum] minion is damage +1.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [gollum] minion strength +1 for each culture you can spot.
lore: ...she lusted for sweeter meat. And Gollum had brought it to her.

title: Aragorn
gametext:
When you play Aragorn, you may heal another companion.
At the start of each fellowship phase, you may exert a companion of one culture to heal a companion of another culture.
lore: 'Now come the days of the King, and may they be blessed while the thrones of the Valar endure!'
subtitle: Elessar Telcontar

title: Cursed of Erech
gametext:
Enduring. To play, add a threat.
When you play Cursed of Erech, exert him twice.
At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert another [gondor] Wraith to make Cursed of Erech defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: ...a black dread fell on them....

title: Dead Man of Dunharrow
gametext:
Enduring. To play, add a threat.
When you play this companion, exert him twice.
lore: ...the Shadow Host pressed behind and fear went on before them....

title: Denethor
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [gondor] Men.
Fellowship: If at a sanctuary, exert Denethor to take a [gondor] card into hand from your draw deck, then reshuffle. Choose an opponent who may draw 2 cards.
lore: There Denethor sat in a grey gloom, like an old patient spider....

effect.text: Would you like to draw 2 cards?

subtitle: Lord of Minas Tirith

title: Drawing His Eye
gametext: For each [gondor] companion you spot, reveal 1 card at random from a Shadow player's hand. Choose a revealed Shadow card to be discarded, then its owner draws a card.
lore: 'We cannot achieve victory by arms, but by arms we can give the Ring-bearer his only chance, frail though it be.'

title: End of the Game
gametext: Make an exhausted [gondor] companion strength +2. If that companion wins this skirmish, heal that companion or make him or her damage +1.
lore: ...he drew Andúril and held it up glittering in the sun. 'You shall not be sheathed again until the last battle is fought,' he said.

title: Every Little is a Gain
gametext: Spot a [gondor] Man to discard a stacked Shadow card or to wound a minion bearing a fortification.
lore: And so the companies came and were hailed and cheered and passed through the Gate, men of the Outlands marching to defend the City of Gondor in a dark hour....

title: Fifth Level
gametext:
Fortification. Bearer is strength -1 for each fortification you can spot.
Maneuver: Exert 2 [gondor] Men or spot 3 knights to transfer this condition to a minion.
lore: A strong citadel it was indeed....

title: Hardy Garrison
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [gondor] Men.
Each time you lose initiative, you may wound a minion.
lore: All before the walls on either side of the Gate the ground was choked with wreck and with bodies of the slain....

title: Last Throw
gametext: If no opponent controls a site, spot 2 [gondor] Men to make the move limit +1 for this turn.
lore: 'We must push Sauron... We must march out to meet him at once.'

title: Suffered Much Loss
gametext:
Each site on the adventure path is a battleground.
While you have initiative, each Uruk-hai is strength +1.
lore: 'For we are already at war, as you may have seen....'

title: Cast Unto the Winds
gametext: Regroup: Spot a Southron, remove a threat, and remove (3) to wound an unbound companion.
lore: 'With horns in my mouth / I walk in the South....'

title: Corsair Boatswain
gametext:
Corsair. To play, spot a [raider] Man.
Shadow: Exert this minion to play a [raider] support area possession from your draw deck.
lore: Promise of plunder and of the whip keep in line a lustful Corsair crew.

title: Corsair Brute
gametext:
Corsair.
At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove a [raider] token to wound a companion he is skirmishing.
lore: ...the region of South Gondor became a debatable land between the Corsairs and the Kings.

title: Corsair Ruffian
gametext:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, you may spot another corsair and discard the top card of the Free Peoples player's draw deck to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.
lore: An incarnation of savagery was Ghynóh the Cruel.

title: Easterling Berserker
gametext:
Easterling. To play, spot an Easterling.
While this minion is unwounded, he is damage +2.
Skirmish: Wound 2 other [raider] Men to heal this minion.
lore: ...from nearby there marched up an army of Easterlings that had waited for the signal....

title: Easterling Pillager
gametext:
Easterling. Fierce.
When you play this minion, you may spot another Easterling to add a burden for each companion over 5.
lore: ...for the sack of the City and the rape of Gondor....

title: Far Harad Mercenaries
gametext:
Southron.
At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may spot 6 companions and another [raider] Man to discard an unbound companion this minion is skirmishing.
lore: ...men like half-trolls, with white eyes and red tongues.

title: Field of the Fallen
gametext:
To play, spot a [raider] Man.
While there is a character in the dead pile, each companion of the same culture as that character is strength -1.
Skirmish: Exert your Southron to make him strength +1.

title: High Vantage
gametext: Until the end of the assignment phase, each time a Southron is about to take a wound, prevent that.
lore: Southrons rain arrows down upon their enemies from their defended perch atop their great beasts of war.

title: Mûmak Chieftain
gametext:
Southron.
When you play this minion, you may play a mount on him from your discard pile. Its twilight cost is -2.
lore: The commander of a mûmak never imagines he is in complete control of the beast.

title: Quelled
gametext: Exert a [raider] Man to discard a Free Peoples condition. If you spot a [rohan] Man, discard an additional Free Peoples condition.
lore: Against the great mounts of the Southron army, Rohirrim steeds could not easily prevail.

title: Rallying Call
gametext:
To play, spot a [raider] Man.
Threats cannot be removed by Free Peoples cards.
Shadow: Remove (1) and play a Southron to add a threat.
lore: Horns were blown and trumpets were braying....

title: Seasoned Leader
gametext:
Bearer must be a Southron.
Bearer is enduring.
Skirmish: Remove a threat to play a [raider] condition from your discard pile.
lore: Only by many conquests and hardships does one rise to prominence in the army of the Haradrim.

title: Southron Fanatic
gametext:
Southron.
Each time a Man is assigned to skirmish this minion, wound that Man.
lore: Stirred by the Dark Lord, the fullness of Southron cruelty was leveled at the people of Gondor.

title: Southron Savage
gametext:
Southron.
While the total number of other minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.
lore: The merciless deserts of Haradwaith breed equally merciless fighters.

title: Stampeded
gametext: If a Free Peoples possession is played, spot a [raider] card to discard that possession. If that possession was a [gondor] or [rohan] possession, wound an unbound Man.
lore: ...the Mûmak of Harad was indeed a beast of vast bulk, and the like of him does not walk now in Middle-earth....

title: Under Foot
gametext:
Shadow: If you have initiative, spot a [raider] Man and discard this condition to reconcile your hand.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [raider] Man strength +2.
lore: 'I make the earth shake, / As I tramp through the grass; / Trees crack as I pass.'

title: Black Marshal
gametext: Shadow: Exert a Nazgûl and play a [wraith] minion to add (1) (or (2) if you have initiative).
lore: ...at their head was one greater than all the rest: a Rider, all black....

title: Cirith Ungol Scavenger
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert it to discard a possession borne by a character this minion is skirmishing.
lore: A noise of tramping feet and harsh shouts: Orcs were coming up to the Cleft from the far side....

title: Cirith Ungol Soldier
gametext: Shadow: Spot a possession to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: ...not even the black shadows, lying deep where the red glow could not reach, would shield him long from the night-eyed orcs.

title: Cirith Ungol Warrior
gametext: Shadow: Spot a possession to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: ...deafening, roaring in his ears, the crash of the feet and the rending clamour of the Orcs before him.

title: Cirith Ungol Watchman
gametext: Each companion skirmishing this minion loses all damage and strength bonuses from possessions.
lore: Sam looked up towards the orc-tower, and suddenly from its narrow windows lights stared out like small red eyes.

title: Dark Swooping Shadows
gametext: Heal an enduring [wraith] minion to add a burden or 2 threats.
lore: '...how can he win to the Gate, if these foul hell-hawks have other weapons than fear?'

title: Gorbag
gametext: For each wound on the Ring-bearer, each [wraith] Orc is strength +1.
lore: 'I tell you, it's no game serving down in the city.'
subtitle: Covetous Captain

title: Gorbag's Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be a [wraith] Orc.
When you play this possession, you may discard a possession. Its owner may place it on top of his or her draw deck instead.
If bearer is Gorbag, he is fierce.
lore: 'You touch it and I'll stick this blade in your gut.'

effect.text: Choose card to discard

title: Houses of Lamentation
gametext: Make a [wraith] minion strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a companion of the same culture as a card in the dead pile).
lore: '...thy shrivelled mind be left naked to the Lidless Eye.'

title: Morgul Banner-bearer
gametext: While the total number of other minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, this minion is strength +3 and an archer.
lore: So great an army had never issued from that vale since the days of Isildur's might....

title: Morgul Vanguard
gametext: Assignment: Assign this minion to an unbound companion bearing a hand weapon.
lore: '...soon the host of Morgul will enter in at many points.'

title: Stooping to the Kill
gametext:
While you have initiative, each of your [wraith] minions is damage +1.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [wraith] minion strength +2.
lore: And with a piercing cry out of the dim sky fell the winged shadows....

title: Swarming Like Beetles
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a [wraith] Orc and remove a threat to wound an unwounded companion.
lore: '...in secret they have long been building floats and barges in great number in East Osgiliath.'

title: Ten Times Outnumbered
gametext: Make a [wraith] Orc strength +2 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
lore: The passage of Anduin was won by the Enemy.

title: Úlairë Cantëa
gametext:
Enduring. Fierce.
Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Cantëa during a skirmish phase.
Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Cantëa to discard a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing.
lore: ...the shadows of death fell dark upon the earth.
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Úlairë Enquëa
gametext:
Enduring.
Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Enquëa during a skirmish phase.
Skirmish: If Úlairë Enqueä is skirmishing, heal him to add a burden.
lore: Ever they circled above the City, like vultures that expect their fill of doomed men's flesh.
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Úlairë Lemenya
gametext:
Enduring. Fierce.
Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Lemenya during a skirmish phase.
Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Lemenya to wound up to 3 other [wraith] minions.
lore: It was no brigand or orc-chieftain that ordered the assault upon the Lord of Mordor's greatest foe.
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Úlairë Nelya
gametext:
Enduring. Fierce.
Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Nelya during a skirmish phase.
Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Nelya to add (1) for each burden.
lore: Perching now on the wall beside the ruined gate the Nazgûl sent out its deadly cries. All the cliffs echoed.
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Úlairë Toldëa
gametext:
Enduring.
Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Toldëa during a skirmish phase.
Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Toldëa to make him damage +1.
lore: ...like shadows of untimely night, he saw in the middle airs below him five birdlike forms....
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Éowyn
gametext: Skirmish: Exert Éowyn to choose an opponent. That opponent must wound a minion for each wound on each minion skirmishing Éowyn.
lore: 'Yet now that I have leave to depart, I would remain. For this House has become to me of all dwellings the most blessed.'
subtitle: Lady of Ithilien

title: Fell Deeds Awake
gametext:
To play, spot a [rohan] Man.
Each time you lose initiative, you may liberate a site.
lore: ...he seized a great horn from Guthláf his banner-bearer, and he blew such a blast upon it that it burst asunder.

title: Unyielding
gametext: If your [rohan] Man wins a skirmish, discard a [rohan] possession to wound a minion or to liberate a site.
lore: ...they gathered and rallied and fought until the day wore away.

title: Advance Captain
gametext: Each roaming [sauron] minion is damage +1.
lore: The foe who gave him his scar soon after gave him the adornment for his helm.

title: Advance Marauder
gametext: Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a roaming [sauron] minion strength +3.
lore: The sun gleamed red....

title: Advance Regular
gametext: Each roaming [sauron] minion is fierce.
lore: In vain men shook their fists at the pitiless foes that swarmed before the Gate.

title: Advance Scout
gametext: Shadow: Exert or discard this minion to make each [sauron] minion you spot roaming until the regroup phase.
lore: The lines of fire became flowing torrents, file upon file of Orcs bearing flames....

title: Barren Land
gametext:
To play, spot a [sauron] minion.
Each time the fellowship moves to any site 8 or 9, exert each Ring-bound companion.
Shadow: Discard this condition to play a [sauron] minion. Its twilight cost is -2.
lore: There the last living things gave up their struggle....

title: Beaten Back
gametext: Make a [sauron] minion strength +2 for each site you control. If you have initiative, that minion is fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: The Rammas was broken, and all the Pelennor abandoned to the Enemy.

title: Cirith Ungol Guard
gametext: Damage +1.
lore: ...this stronghold had been built not to keep enemies out of Mordor, but to keep them in.

title: Cirith Ungol Patroller
gametext:
Damage +1.
While you can spot 3 possessions, this minion is fierce.
lore: 'A message came: Nazgûl uneasy. Spies feared on stairs. Double vigilance. Patrol to head of Stairs.'

title: Cirith Ungol Sentinel
gametext:
Damage +1.
If you can spot another [sauron] Uruk-hai, this minion is twilight cost -1 for each possession you can spot.
lore: 'Any trespasser found by the guard is to be held at the tower.'

title: Cirith Ungol Sentry
gametext: Damage +1.
lore: ...treachery had yielded up the Tower to the Lord of the Ringwraiths, and now for long years it had been held by evil things.

title: Flames Within
gametext:
While you have initiative, each of your [sauron] minions is strength +2.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [sauron] minion strength +2 (or +4 if it is roaming).
lore: Soon there was great peril of fire behind the wall....

title: Gorgoroth Keeper
gametext:
Besieger.
While you control a site, this minion's twilight cost is -2.
Regroup: Stack this minion on a site you control.
lore: ...new foes came swirling behind....

title: Gorgoroth Swarm
gametext:
Besieger.
When you play this minion, you may spot 6 companions and another besieger to play a besieger from your discard pile and control a site.
lore: File after file passed....

title: Gothmog
gametext:
Besieger.
When you play Gothmog, the Free Peoples player must wound a companion for each site you control.
While you control a site, Gothmog is fierce.
lore: 'Move into the City. Kill all in your path.'
subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul

title: Gothmog's Warg
gametext:
Bearer must be a [sauron] Orc.
For each site you control, bearer is strength +1 (or +2 if bearer is Gothmog).
lore: 'Form ranks, you maggots! Form ranks!'

title: Mordor Brute
gametext: Each [sauron] Orc bearing a possession cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases).
lore: There came a long rolling of great drums like thunder in the mountains....

title: Mordor Fiend
gametext: Shadow: If you cannot spot another minion and there are 3 or fewer twilight tokens, add (3) (or (5) if this minion is roaming).
lore: The onslaught of Mordor broke like a wave on the beleaguered hills....

title: Mordor Pillager
gametext:
Besieger. Fierce.
Shadow: Exert this minion and spot another [sauron] minion to control a site. If you cannot spot 3 Free Peoples cultures, the Free Peoples player may exert a companion to prevent this.

true.text: Would you like to exert a companion to prevent taking control of site?

title: Mordor Wretch
