lore: Its strength pales next to that of the man wielding it.
subtitle: Sword of Boromir

title: Boromir
gametext:
Ranger.
Fellowship: Add (2) to heal Boromir.
lore: ...seated a little apart was a tall man with a fair and noble face... proud and stern of glance.
subtitle: Defender of Minas Tirith

title: Concealment
gametext: Make a [gondor] Man strength +1. If he or she is skirmishing a roaming minion, your opponents cannot use special abilities.
lore: '...your refuge is so hidden that perhaps he does not know that Men are concealed here.'

title: Confronting the Eye
gametext: Fellowship: Spot a [gondor] Man and add (2) to make each unbound companion strength +1 until the regroup phase (limit +1).
lore: 'To know that I lived and walked the earth was a blow to his heart, I deem; for he knew it not till now.'

title: Elendil's Valor
gametext: Make a [gondor] companion defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'In panoply of ancient kings, / in chainéd rings he armoured him; / his shining shield was scored with runes / to ward all wounds and harm from him....'

title: Faramir
gametext:
Ranger.
Skirmish: Exert Faramir to make him strength +1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
lore: 'We do not want the escapes of Mirkwood in Ithilien.'
subtitle: Dúnadan of Gondor

title: Faramir's Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be Faramir.
He is damage +1.
Each minion skirmishing Faramir at a battleground or forest site is roaming.
lore: 'There will be hard handstrokes nigh at hand ere the day is full.'

title: Gondorian Steed
gametext:
Bearer must be a knight.
Bearer is damage +1.
Each time the fellowship moves from a mountain site, add (2).
lore: A skilled cavalry augments Minas Tirith's mighty defenses.

title: Guardian
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [gondor] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Skirmish: If a [gondor] companion is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this condition to have him or her replace an unbound companion skirmishing a minion.
lore: Boromir wouldn't fail the other Hobbits as he had Frodo.

title: Invigorated
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition to heal a [gondor] Man (or to heal 2 [gondor] Men if you can spot a roaming minion).
lore: He sprang down the steps and away, leaping down the path.

title: Tireless
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [gondor] Man strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he or she is at a battleground site; he or she has resistance 4 or more; he or she is bearing a hand weapon; he or she is skirmishing a roaming minion.
lore: So long as foes were standing, so too would Aragorn.

title: Valorous Leader
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] companion. Limit 1 per bearer.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to discard a possession borne by a minion skirmishing bearer.
lore: Before he ever sat the throne, Aragorn had proven himself a great leader to the people of Gondor.

title: Saruman
gametext:
Damage +1. Fierce. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
When you play Saruman, name a culture. Each companion of the named culture is strength -1.
lore: '"White!" he sneered. "It serves as a beginning."'
subtitle: Of Many Colours

title: Brutal Easterling
gametext: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish an exhausted companion, it is fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: 'Out of some savage land in the wide East they come, we deem.'

title: Castamir of Umbar
gametext:
Fierce. Toil 1. (For each [men] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1.)
Each wounded [men] minion is strength +2.
lore: '...they have allied them with the Enemy, and now make a heavy stroke in his cause.'
subtitle: Corsair Vandal

title: Corrupted Spy
gametext:
This minion is strength +1 for each other character you can spot.
While you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, this minion is damage +1.
While you can spot a companion who has resistance 0, this minion is fierce.

title: Countless Companies
gametext:
Response: If a [men] possession is discarded from play, stack it here.
Shadow: Remove (1) to play a possession stacked here as if from hand.
lore: 'Not tall, but broad and grim... wielding great axes.'

title: Covetous Easterling
gametext: While this minion is skirmishing a Man, it is damage +2.
lore: Long have the Men of Rhûn thirsted for the wealth of Gondor, and many times have they sought to claim it.

title: Crazed Hillman
gametext:
Fierce.
While this minion is in a fierce skirmish, it is strength +7 (or +10 if it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less).
lore: Already given to fierce passions, a warrior of Dunland quickly frenzies in the heat of battle.

title: Crooked Townsman
gametext: This minion is strength +1 for each other character you can spot.
lore: '...the Riders can use men and other creatures as spies, as we found at Bree.'

title: Dunlending Zealot
gametext: While this minion is exhausted, each unbound companion is resistance -1 (or -2 if the fellowship is at a battleground site).
lore: ...unfriendly to the Dúnedain, hating the Rohirrim.

title: Easterling Banner-bearer
gametext: This minion is strength +1 for each wound on each companion he is skirmishing (or +2 for each if that companion has resistance 2 or less).
lore: 'They hold the northward road; and many have passed on into Anórien. The Rohirrim cannot come.'

title: Enraged Southron
gametext:
Ambush (3).
The move limit for this turn is +1.
lore: As with wild animals, fleeing prey seems only to incite the warriors of Harad.

title: Frenzied Dunlending
gametext: While this minion is bearing a possession, it is fierce.
lore: While Dunlendings lack the skills of the trained soldiers they attack, they carry in them a well-honed hatred.

title: Gathering Strength
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [men] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Make a [men] minion strength +6.
lore: 'Always more people coming to Mordor. One day all the peoples will be inside.'

title: Goaded to War
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] minion.
Each time the fellowship moves to a battleground or plains site, add (1).
lore: ...the mûmakil were bellowing....

title: Gríma
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time a companion loses a skirmish involving a [men] minion, you may exert Gríma to exert a companion.
lore: In his eyes was the hunted look of a beast seeking some gap in the ring of his enemies.
subtitle: Betrayer of Rohan

title: Harrying Hillman
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time a companion loses a skirmish involving a [men] minion, add (2).
lore: Though Dunlendings are by no means cowardly, their prowess in battle seems to manifest more as victory grows more assured.

title: Hemmed In
gametext:
While you can spot 6 companions, each companion skirmishing a [men] minion loses all strength bonuses from possessions.
Maneuver: Spot your [men] minion and discard this condition to transfer a Free Peoples possession borne by a companion to another eligible bearer.

title: Last Days
gametext: Each time a [men] minion is killed or discarded from play (except during the regroup phase), you may play a [men] minion. Its twilight cost is -2, and it is fierce and strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'Not long now shall stand the high hall which Brego son of Eorl built. Fire shall devour the high seat.'

title: Messenger's Mount
gametext:
Bearer must be The Mouth of Sauron.
He is fierce.
Response: If a [men] minion is about to take a wound, remove (3) to prevent that.
lore: ...it was huge and hideous, and its face was a frightful mask....

title: The Mouth of Sauron
gametext: Maneuver: Exert The Mouth of Sauron to play a [men] condition or [men] possession from your draw deck.
lore: ...he learned great sorcery, and knew much of the mind of Sauron; and he was more cruel than any orc.
subtitle: Messenger of Mordor

title: Mûmak Rider
gametext:
Archer.
When you play this minion to a battleground or plains site, you may spot another [men] minion to discard a possession from play.
lore: Only the best marksmen can keep their aim true as they are carried along by the great beasts of the Haradrim.

title: Poisonous Words
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [men] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Add (1) for each [men] card you can spot.
lore: 'So fair. So cold. Like a morning of pale spring still clinging to winter's chill.'

title: Trail of Terror
gametext: At the start of the maneuver phase, you may spot 3 [men] minions and remove (1) to make each unbound companion resistance -1 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'Now the Wild Men are moving through the Westfold, burning as they go.'

title: War Trident
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] minion.
While bearer is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 5 or less, bearer is strength +2.
While bearer is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 3 or less, bearer is strength +2.

title: Wrathful Hillman
gametext: Each time this minion is assigned to a skirmish, if it is not at a plains site, remove (2) or discard this minion.
lore: 'For behold! the storm comes, and now all friends should gather together, lest each singly be destroyed.'

title: The Balrog
gametext:
Damage +1.
While The Balrog is at an underground site, it is fierce and cannot take wounds or be exerted.
lore: The fire in it seemed to die, but the darkness grew.
subtitle: The Terror of Khazad-dûm

title: Whip of Many Thongs
gametext:
Bearer must be The Balrog.
It is fierce.
When you play this artifact, the Free Peoples player reveals his or her hand and discards all Free Peoples cards from hand that have a twilight cost of 1 or less.
lore: ...it swung its whip, and the thongs lashed....
subtitle: Weapon of Flame and Shadow

title: Abiding Evil
gametext: Spot X burdens to make a character skirmishing an [orc] Orc strength -X.
lore: 'The Dark Tower was broken, but its foundations were not removed; for they were made with the power of the Ring, and while it remains they will endure.'

title: Barrage
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [orc] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Make each of your [orc] minions strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lore: Fires now raged unchecked in the first circle of the City....

title: The Beckoning Shadow
gametext:
To play, exert an [orc] minion.
If you can spot 5 burdens, and the Free Peoples player has no cards in his or her draw deck, the Ring-bearer is corrupted.
lore: Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo; but this time it was stronger than before.

title: Bloodstained Field
gametext: Spot an [orc] lurker to wound an Elf.
lore: Orcs will eagerly spill any blood, but Elven is the sweetest of all.

title: Cave Troll of Moria
gametext:
Damage +1. Fierce. Toil 2. (For each [orc] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Each time an [orc] lurker wins a skirmish, you may make the Free Peoples player discard the top 2 cards of his or her draw deck.
lore: 'There is no hope of escape that way.'
subtitle: Savage Menace

title: Cave Troll's Hammer
gametext:
Bearer must be an [orc] Troll.
When you play this possession, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion for each lurker you spot.
lore: Its weight is greater than any foe it has felled.
subtitle: Unwieldy Cudgel

title: Goblin Aggressor
gametext: While this minion is bearing a possession, each [orc] minion is strength +1.
lore: 'The road may lead to Moria, but how can we hope that it will lead through Moria....'

title: Great Cost
gametext:
At the start of each skirmish involving an [orc] minion, you may spot 6 companions to exert a companion in that skirmish.
Shadow: Discard this condition and spot an [orc] minion to make the Free Peoples player place a card from his or her hand on top of his or her draw deck.

title: Mordor Aggressor
gametext: While this minion is bearing a possession, each [orc] minion is strength +2.
lore: 'The enemy,' men murmured. 'The dike is down. Here they come pouring through the breaches!'

title: Morgul Tormentor
gametext: Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to skirmish an unwounded companion, he or she must add a burden or discard a card from hand.
lore: Some Orcs go beyond savagery, taking pleasure in the suffering of their enemies.

title: Orc Artisan
gametext: Each time you play an [orc] possession on an [orc] Orc, you may add (1) (or (2) if that Orc is at a battleground or underground site).
lore: Much Orc weaponry is scavenged from fallen foes, but they still have ample need for smiths to outfit their troops.

title: Orc Dreg
gametext: Each time this minion is assigned to a skirmish, if it is not at an underground site, remove (2) or discard this minion.
lore: ...their Captain cared not greatly what they did or how many might be slain....

title: Orc Footman
gametext: When this minion is discarded from play, you may spot a companion who has resistance 4 or less to shuffle this minion into your draw deck.
lore: On they came, reckless of their loss as they approached....

title: Orc Sapper
gametext: When you play this minion, you may spot a companion who has resistance 4 or less to prevent that companion from being assigned to this minion until the regroup phase.
lore: ...their purpose was only to test the strength of the defence and to keep the men of Gondor busy in many places.

cost.text: Choose companion who won't be able to assign to Orc Sapper

title: Orc Skulker
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each skirmish event you play is twilight cost -1.
lore: 'I have never heard before of Orcs upon Amon Hen. Yet who knows what may happen in these evil days....'

title: Orc Spear
gametext:
Bearer must be an [orc] minion.
When you play this possession on a minion that has a twilight cost of 4 or more, add (2).
lore: The flared backs of Orkish spearheads are crafted to inflict more damage as they are pulled out of a victim.

title: Orc Strategist
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Maneuver: Make an [orc] lurker minion lose lurker until the regroup phase.
lore: It takes a strong will indeed to command an unruly band of Orcs.

title: Orc Tormentor
gametext: Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to skirmish an unwounded companion, he or she must add a burden or discard a card from hand.
lore: ...orc-speech sounded at all times full of hate and anger....

title: Pitiless Orc
gametext: When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each companion over 4.
lore: Curses they heeded not, nor understood the tongues of western men....

title: Rallying Orc
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time you play another [orc] lurker at a battleground or underground site, you may make the Free Peoples player exert a companion.
lore: Orcs can spring from the shadows in surprising numbers.

title: Retribution
gametext:
Each time an [orc] minion bearing a weapon wins a skirmish, add a burden.
Shadow: Discard this condition to play an [orc] weapon from your discard pile.
lore: With his mighty army, the Dark Lord exacted a high price for resisting his will.

title: Scavenging Goblins
gametext: When you play this minion, you may play an [orc] weapon from your discard pile on your [orc] Orc.
lore: 'The Orcs have often plundered Moria; there is nothing left in the upper halls.'

title: Storming the Ramparts
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [orc] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Spot an [orc] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard one of his or her conditions from play.
lore: The defenses of Minas Tirith were daunting, but the siegecraft of the Orcs was equal to the challenge.

title: Taunt
gametext: Reveal the top 5 cards of your draw deck (or, if the fellowship is at a battleground site, the top 7 cards) to make an [orc] minion strength +1 for each [orc] card revealed.
lore: 'Go on. Call for help. Squeal! No one's gonna save you now.'

title: Troll's Keyward
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Shadow: Exert Troll's Keyward and reveal your hand to add (1) for each [orc] Troll revealed.
lore: Tending the Cave Troll is a task neither envied or respected within the tribes of Moria.
subtitle: Keeper of the Beast

title: Vile Goblin
gametext: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a Dwarf, this minion is fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: The Orcs infesting Khazad-dûm despoiled and defiled the ancient Dwarven mansion.

title: Aldred
gametext: At the start of each skirmish involving Aldred, you may discard a possession borne by a minion he is skirmishing.
lore: 'We counted all the slain and despoiled them....'
subtitle: Éored Soldier

title: Cast Out
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [rohan] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Maneuver: Spot a [rohan] Man and discard this condition to exert a minion.
Maneuver: Spot a mounted [rohan] Man and discard this condition to return an exhausted minion to its owner's hand.

title: Challenging the Orc-host
gametext: Make a [rohan] companion strength +2 (or +1 for each minion you can spot if that companion has resistance 5 or more).
lore: '...we overtook the Orcs at nightfall two days ago, near to the borders of the Entwood. There we surrounded them, and gave battle....'

title: Cleaving a Path
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [rohan] companion strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he or she is at a plains site; he or she has resistance 4 or more; he or she is bearing armor; he or she is skirmishing a wounded minion.
lore: Captains and champions fell or fled before them.

title: Coif
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
Each time a Shadow card adds any number of twilight tokens, you may exert bearer to prevent that.
Each time the fellowship moves from a forest site, exert a companion.
lore: ...the Hornburg still held fast, like an island in a sea.

title: Éomer
gametext:
While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1.
Maneuver: If you can spot more minions than companions, exert Éomer to play a [rohan] companion from your draw deck.
lore: ...the front of the first éored roared like a breaker foaming to the shore....
subtitle: Éored Leader

title: Éored Warrior
gametext: While this companion is at a battleground or plains site, he is strength +3.
lore: '...suspecting what I most fear, a league between Orthanc and the Dark Tower, I led forth my éored, men of my own household....'

title: For the Mark
gametext:
Spot a [rohan] Man to discard a possession from play.
You may exert a [rohan] Man who has resistance 3 or more to play this event during the maneuver phase.
lore: South strode Éomer and men fled before his face, and they were caught between the hammer and the anvil.

title: Golden Glimmer
gametext: Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, spot a [rohan] companion and add 2 burdens to prevent that.
lore: 'Dark is the hour, yet maybe we shall return to the Golden Hall.'

title: Haethen
gametext:
Haethen cannot take wounds during fierce skirmishes.
Skirmish: Exert Haethen to make him strength +1.
lore: His years as a Rider of Rohan were long behind him, but the threat to Helm's Deep demanded this old warrior again take up arms.
subtitle: Veteran Fighter

title: Léofric
gametext: Skirmish: If Léofric is in a skirmish, exert him to play a [rohan] skirmish event from your draw deck.
lore: 'There is trouble now on all our borders, and we are threatened....'
subtitle: Defender of the Mark

title: The Mouth of Sauron
gametext: Assignment: Assign The Mouth of Sauron to the companion who has the highest strength. (If two or more are tied for highest, choose one.)
lore: 'Is there anyone in this rout with authority to treat with me?' he asked. 'Or indeed with wit to understand me?'
subtitle: Lieutenant of Barad-dûr

title: Bilbo
gametext:
Ring-bound.
At the start of each skirmish involving Bilbo, you may exert him to take a [shire] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile.
lore: 'I want to see the wild country again before I die, and the Mountains....'
subtitle: Melancholy Hobbit

title: Diversion
gametext:
Discard a Hobbit not assigned to a skirmish from play to discard a minion from play.
If the fellowship is at a battleground site, you may add 2 burdens to play this event during a skirmish involving a Hobbit.
lore: Each member of the fellowship was willing to make any sacrifice to safeguard the Quest.

title: Flotsam and Jetsam
gametext: If a companion (except a Hobbit) wins a skirmish, heal a Hobbit.
lore: 'Welcome, my lords, to Isengard!' he said. 'We are the doorwardens.'

title: Home and Hearth
gametext: Each time you play a Hobbit, you may remove a burden. Then, if the fellowship is at dwelling site, heal the Ring-bearer.
lore: He drew a deep breath. 'Well, I'm back,' he said.

title: Hope is Kindled
gametext: Make a Hobbit strength +2. If that Hobbit wins this skirmish, you may remove a burden.
lore: 'Soft as butter they can be, and yet sometimes as tough as old tree-roots.'

title: Long Live the Halflings
gametext:
To play, spot a Hobbit.
Skirmish: If your Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, discard this condition to make each companion who has resistance 7 or more strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'My friends, you bow to no one.'

title: Measure of Comfort
gametext: While you can spot a Hobbit, each unbound companion is resistance +1.
lore: Though fate had it that the fellowship would not accompany Frodo to his final goal, some reassurance came in knowing he did not have to make the journey alone.

title: No Worse for Wear
gametext: Prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled. Then, if the fellowship is at a dwelling site, you may discard 2 cards from hand to return this event to your hand.
lore:
'That was good.'"
"'Let's get another one!'

true.text: Would you like to discard 2 cards to return {self} to your hand?

title: Pippin
gametext: When you play Pippin, remove a burden or heal a companion.
lore: 'Anyway, you need people of intelligence on this sort of mission... quest... thing.'
subtitle: Hobbit of Some Intelligence

title: A Promise
gametext: While you can spot Frodo and Sam and neither is exhausted, each is strength +1.
lore: 'But I'm glad, Sam. I cannot tell you how glad. Come along! It is plain that we were meant to go together.'

title: Rosie Cotton
gametext:
Sam cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
Each time the Free Peoples player assigns Rosie Cotton to a skirmish, add 2 burdens.
lore: 'It seems she didn't like my going abroad at all....'
subtitle: Barmaid

title: Simple Living
gametext: Response: If you play a [shire] event, discard this condition to heal each Hobbit.
lore: They do not and did not understand or like machines more complicated than a forge-bellows, a water-mill, or a hand-loom....

title: Stand Together
gametext: Each time a Hobbit wins a skirmish, he or she gains muster until the end of the turn. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lore: 'For a breathless time they sat there, silent and alert....'

title: Sudden Fury
gametext:
Each time a [shire] companion loses a skirmish, add a [shire] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [shire] token from here to make a [shire] companion strength +1.
lore: It raised a whip a second time, but the blow never fell.

title: Tolman Cotton
gametext: Response: If a burden is about to be added by a Shadow card, spot another Hobbit and exert Tolman Cotton to prevent that.
lore: The land was rich and kindly, and though it had been long deserted when they entered it, it had before been well tilled....
subtitle: Farmer of Bywater

title: Advancing Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
When you cannot spot another [uruk-hai] minion, discard this minion.
lore: 'Already they are scaling the bank at many points, thick as marching ants.'

title: Barbaric Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
Assignment: Make the Free Peoples player assign this minion to an unwounded companion.
lore: Their lust for Man-flesh allowed Saruman to bend the Uruk-hai to his will.

title: Berserker Torch
gametext:
Toil 1. (For each [uruk-hai] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1.)
Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] Uruk-hai.
Bearer is strength +2 for each wound on each character in its skirmish.
lore: '...the Orcs have brought a devilry from Orthanc....'

title: Breeding Pit Conscript
gametext:
Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
When you play this minion, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.
lore: A select few of Saruman's Uruk-hai were charged with harvesting his war-machine.

title: Broken Heirloom
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [uruk-hai] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Spot an [uruk-hai] minion to discard a possession borne by a companion who has resistance 4 or less.
lore: '...he blew the horn. But no help came. Only more orcs.'

title: Broken in Defeat
gametext: Make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +2. Then you may spot 6 companions to return this event to your hand.
lore: 'The world of Men will fall and all will come to darkness, and my city to ruin.'

true.text: Would you like to return this event to hand?

title: Crushing Uruk
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Response: If a companion loses a skirmish involving an [uruk-hai] minion, exert this minion to discard a possession borne by that companion.
lore: Uruks strike with crippling force.

title: Dark Alliance
gametext: Response: If an ally or companion uses a special ability, discard this condition and exert an [uruk-hai] lurker to prevent that.
lore: The power of Isengard is at your command, Sauron, Lord of the Earth.

title: Merciless Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may spot a companion who has resistance 4 or less to place this minion on the bottom of your draw deck.
lore: They reached the summit of the rock; they drove towards the gates.

title: Quelling Force
gametext: Make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +1 for each other [uruk-hai] minion you can spot.
lore: They gained the gates. The trees, swung by strong arms, smote the timbers with a rending boom.

title: Saruman
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Skirmish: Exert Saruman to make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +2.
Each time a companion is killed, you may heal Saruman.
lore: 'There will be no dawn for Men.'
subtitle: Agent of the Dark Lord

title: Shingle in a Storm
gametext:
While you can spot 6 companions, each [uruk-hai] minion is damage +1.
Assignment: Discard this condition to assign an [uruk-hai] minion to a companion who has resistance 2 or less.
lore: Against the Deeping Wall the hosts of Isengard roared like a sea.

title: Strange Device
gametext: Spot an [uruk-hai] minion to draw 3 cards. Then discard 2 cards from hand or discard an [uruk-hai] minion from hand.
lore: ...a small white hand in the centre of a black field.

title: Suppressing Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
While there is a companion in the dead pile, each unbound companion is resistance -4.
lore: Few fighters are skilled enough to outstrip the natural instincts of the Uruk-hai.

title: Tempest of War
gametext:
While you can spot an [uruk-hai] minion, each unbound companion is resistance -1 for each condition he or she bears.
Skirmish: Spot an [uruk-hai] minion and a companion who has resistance 2 or less to discard from play all conditions in all players' support areas.

title: Uruk Common
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each time this minion is assigned to a skirmish, if it is not at a battleground site, remove (2) or discard this minion.
lore: Casualties of war were neither honored nor remembered by the White Hand.

title: Uruk Decimator
gametext:
While this minion is at a battleground site, it is strength +2.
While this minion is bearing a possession, it is damage +1.
lore: The barricade was scattered as if by a thunderbolt.

title: Uruk Desecrator
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each unbound companion is resistance -2 for each wound he or she has.
lore: Madness is seldom considered a liability, but a requisite in the ranks of the Uruk-hai.

title: Uruk Dominator
gametext:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: Exert this minion to make it strength +1 for each [uruk-hai] Uruk-hai you spot (or +2 for each if you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less).
lore: The Great Orc race revels in its ability to overwhelm an enemy.

title: Uruk Pikeman
gametext:
Damage +1.
While this minion is skirmishing an exhausted companion, this minion is strength +3 (or +5 if that companion has resistance 4 or less).
lore: The dark tide flowed up to the walls from cliff to cliff.

title: Uruk Slaughterer
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each time a companion is killed in a skirmish involving an [uruk-hai] minion, you may discard any number of cards from hand to draw the same number of cards.
lore: Captives of the Uruk-hai are treated with brutality and malice, but only if they survive their capture.

title: Uruk Zealot
gametext:
Damage +1. To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion.
Each companion who has resistance 0 is strength -3.
Each time Uruk Zealot wins a skirmish, you may draw 3 cards.
lore: The Uruk-hai do not question the authority of the White Hand. They know its cause is righteous.

title: Uruk-hai Guard
gametext:
Damage +1.
Assignment: Exert this minion and spot a companion to prevent the Free Peoples player from assigning that companion to this minion.
lore: 'Wolves and orcs were housed in Isengard, for Saruman was mustering a great force....'

title: Uruk-hai Troop
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each character skirmishing this minion loses all strength bonuses from weapons.
lore: Attacking in swarming hordes, the Uruk-hai close with the enemy rapidly to make weapons useless.

title: Vicious Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may draw a card for each wound on a character it is skirmishing.
lore: ...the sweet grass of Rohan had been bruised and blackened as they passed.

title: Weapon of Opportunity
gametext:
Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] minion.
When you play this possession on a minion that has a twilight cost of 4 or more, draw a card.
lore: The fighting Uruk-hai will use any resource available to carry out the will of Saruman.

title: Worthy of Mordor
gametext: At the start of the regroup phase, you may remove (1) to make an [uruk-hai] minion gain muster until the end of the regroup phase. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lore: Tasked by Sauron, Saruman moved swiftly to build the army demanded of him.

title: Black Rider
gametext:
Fierce.
This minion is strength +1 for each companion you can spot.
lore: 'The Nine are abroad again. They have crossed the River secretly and are moving westward. They have taken the guise of riders in black.'

title: Dark Approach
gametext: Play a Nazgûl. His twilight cost is -1 for each forest site you can spot (limit -4).
lore: Frodo hesitated for a second: curiosity or some other feeling was struggling with his desire to hide.

title: Dark Temptation
gametext: Each time you play a Nazgûl, you may heal the Ring-bearer twice to add a burden.
lore: He felt that he had only to slip it on, and then he would be safe.

title: Echo of Hooves
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Spot your Nazgûl at a battleground or forest site to play a mount on him from your draw deck.
lore: ...the black horses leaped down the hill in pursuit, and from the Riders came a terrible cry....

title: In the Ringwraith's Wake
gametext: If a Nazgûl wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player chooses to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.
lore: 'He is fading.... We must get him to my father.'

title: Lingering Shadow
gametext:
Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgûl.
Each time a wound is removed from bearer, add a burden.
lore: 'I am wounded... wounded; it will never really heal.'

title: Minas Morgul Answers
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Spot a Nazgûl to discard a Free Peoples condition from play.
lore: There was a flare of livid lightnings: forks of blue flame springing up from the tower and from the encircling hills into the sullen clouds.

title: Nazgûl Blade
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
While bearer is at a battleground or forest site, he is strength +1.
lore: Fear and terror may be the greatest weapons the Nazgûl wield, but their steel is just as perilous.

title: Sauron's Gaze
gametext:
Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgûl.
The Free Peoples player cannot use bearer's special abilities.
lore: 'Then suddenly he seemed to see me, and he laughed at me. It was cruel. It was like being stabbed with knives.'

title: Sense of Obligation
gametext:
To play, spot a [wraith] minion. Bearer must be an unbound companion. Limit 1 per bearer.
At the end of each assignment phase, if bearer is not assigned to a skirmish and a companion who does not bear a [wraith] condition is, add a burden.

title: Shadowy Mount
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
While bearer is at a battleground or forest site, he is fierce.
Assignment: Make the Free Peoples player assign bearer to an unbound companion bearing a [wraith] condition.
lore: '...why do these black horses endure such riders?'

title: Steed of Mordor
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Bearer gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may draw 2 cards.
lore: ... the Black Riders rode like a gale....

title: Úlairë Attëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Skirmish: Remove (2) and discard a [wraith] card from hand to make Úlairë Attëa strength +3.
lore: Frodo thought that he heard a faint hiss as of venomous breath and felt a thin piercing chill.
subtitle: Black Predator

title: Úlairë Cantëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Assignment: Assign Úlairë Cantëa to a companion who has resistance 0.
Skirmish: Spot 6 companions and another [wraith] card to kill a companion Úlairë Cantëa is skirmishing.
lore: 'Flee them! Speak no words to them! They are deadly.'
subtitle: Black Assassin

title: Úlairë Enquëa
gametext:
Fierce. Toil 1. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1.)
Response: If you are playing a [wraith] event that has toil X, exert Úlairë Enquëa to reduce that event's twilight cost by X.
lore: '...the Shire is no longer any protection to you.'
subtitle: Black Threat

title: Úlairë Lemenya
gametext: When you play Úlairë Lemenya, you may play a [wraith] mount from your discard pile.
lore: Out of the gate in the trees that they had just left rode a Black Rider.
subtitle: Black Enemy

title: Úlairë Nelya
gametext:
Fierce.
Each time Úlairë Nelya wins a skirmish, you may draw a card.
lore: '...peril is now both before you and behind you, and upon either side.'
subtitle: Black Hunter

title: Úlairë Nertëa
gametext:
The twilight cost of each mount is -1.
While Úlairë Nertëa is mounted, each Nazgûl is strength +1 and has muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lore: 'Watch every shadow! ...Black horsemen have passed through Bree.'
subtitle: Black Horseman

title: Úlairë Otsëa
gametext: Shadow: Exert Úlairë Otsëa and discard a [wraith] condition from hand to discard a Free Peoples condition from play.
lore: 'We can feel their presence – it troubled our hearts, as soon as we came here, and before we saw them; they feel ours more keenly.'
subtitle: Black Specter

title: Úlairë Toldëa
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play Úlairë Toldëa, you may exert him to take a [wraith] event from your discard pile into hand.
lore: So black were they that they seemed like black holes in the deep shade behind them.
subtitle: Black Shadow

title: Unending Life
gametext:
While you can spot 6 companions, each Nazgûl is strength +3.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to heal a Nazgûl.
lore: 'The power of their master is in them, and they stand or fall by him.'

title: Unimpeded
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a Nazgûl strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he is at a battleground or forest site; he is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less; he is bearing a possession; he is in a fierce skirmish.
lore: 'Who goes there?'

title: The Witch-king
gametext:
Fierce.
The Witch-king is twilight cost -1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
Each time a companion is played, you may reveal this card from hand to exert the Ring-bearer.
lore: He sprang forward and bore down on Frodo.
subtitle: Black Lord

title: The Witch-king's Beast
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
If bearer is The Witch-king, after all skirmishes and fierce skirmishes have been resolved, you may exert him twice to make him participate in one additional assignment and skirmish phase.
lore: The great shadow descended like a falling cloud.
subtitle: Fell Creature

title: The Angle
gametext: Forest. Shadow: Play a Nazgûl (or spot 6 companions and discard 2 cards from hand) to draw a card.

effects.text: Play a Nazgul to draw a card
Discard 2 cards from hand to draw a card

title: The Bridge of Khazad-dûm
gametext: Battleground. Underground. The Balrog is twilight cost -3.

title: Emyn Muil
gametext: Mountain. Maneuver: Remove (2) and exert your minion that is not fierce to make that minion fierce until the regroup phase.

title: Hill of Sight
gametext: Battleground. Forest. While you can spot 3 minions (or 6 companions), each unbound companion is resistance -2.

title: Hobbiton Market
gametext: Dwelling. When the fellowship moves from this site, wound each minion that is not a lurker.

title: Northern Pelennor
gametext: Battleground. Plains. Shadow: Make your lurker minion lose lurker until the regroup phase.

title: Shores of Nen Hithoel
gametext: River. Shadow: Spot 5 [orc] Orcs to prevent the fellowship from moving again this turn.

title: Slopes of Orodruin
gametext: Mountain. Shadow: Remove (2) and discard 2 Free Peoples cards from hand to draw a card.

title: Starkhorn
gametext: Mountain. Each time your Dwarf wins a skirmish, you may draw a card.

title: Wold Battlefield
gametext: Plains. Skirmish: Exert your Man (except an enduring Man) to make him or her damage +1.

title: Arod
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
When you play Arod, you may reinforce a [dwarven] token.
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound during a skirmish, remove 2 [dwarven] tokens to prevent that.
lore: A smaller and lighter horse, but restive and fiery....
subtitle: Rohirrim Steed

title: Awkward Moment
gametext: Make a Dwarf strength +3 (or +4 and damage +1 if you can spot a [dwarven] token).
lore: It's a long way.

title: Deep Hatred
gametext:
Each time the fellowship moves, add (2).
Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf who is not assigned to a skirmish to wound 2 Orcs (or to wound 1 Orc twice).
Discard this from play if the fellowship is ahead on the adventure path.
lore: ...the War of the Dwarves and the Orcs....

title: Dwarf-lords
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [dwarven] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make your Dwarf bearing a hand weapon strength +3.
lore: ...Seven for the Dwarf-lords in their halls of stone....

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1.
Gimli is strength +1 for each minion assigned to a skirmish.
Assignment: Exert Gimli and spot a lurker minion to make that minion lose lurker until the regroup phase.
lore: 'He and his people did great works in Gondor and Rohan.'
subtitle: Lord of the Glittering Caves

title: Honoring His Kinfolk
gametext: If a Dwarf wins a fierce skirmish, play a [dwarven] possession from your discard pile and you may reinforce a [dwarven] token.
lore: ...but Gimli had to be dragged away by Legolas....

effect.text: Would you like to reinforce {dwarven} token

title: Sorrow Shared
gametext: Remove a [dwarven] token to heal a Dwarf.
lore: Gimli was saddened by Éowyn's despair.

title: Subterranean Homestead
gametext:
To play, exert 2 Dwarves.
When you play this, add a [dwarven] token here for each mountain site and each underground site on the adventure path.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a Shadow player discard the top card of his or her draw deck.

title: Arwen
gametext:
While the fellowship is at a forest site, each of your other [elven] companions is resistance +1.
Skirmish: Exert Arwen to make a minion she is skirmishing strength -1 for each other companion assigned to a skirmish.
lore: 'Arwen vanimelda, namarië!'
subtitle: Reflection of Lúthien

title: Asfaloth
gametext:
Bearer must be an Elf.
When you play Asfaloth, you may reinforce an [elven] token.
Skirmish: Remove 2 [elven] tokens to heal bearer (or heal bearer and heal another Elf if bearer is in a fierce skirmish).
lore: '...my horse will not let any rider fall....'
subtitle: Swift Blossom

title: Celeborn
gametext:
While the fellowship is at a forest site, each Elf who has resistance 7 or more gains muster.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may take an [elven] event into hand from your discard pile.
lore: 'I did not know that your plight was so evil.'
subtitle: The Wise

title: City of the Trees
gametext:
At the end of your turn, discard this from play if the fellowship did not move more than once this turn.
At the start of each skirmish involving an Elf and a wounded minion, you may draw a card.
lore: Many stairs they climbed to meet the Galadhrim.

title: Crashing Cavalry
gametext: Assignment: Discard this from play and assign a minion to an [elven] companion. Those characters cannot use skirmish special abilities until the start of the regroup phase.
lore: At that moment there came a roaring and a rushing: a noise of loud waters rolling many stones.

title: Final Shot
gametext: Make an [elven] companion strength +2 (or +5 if the fellowship has moved more than once this turn).
lore: Redoubling their efforts, the Company at last felled the Cave Troll.

title: Galadriel
gametext:
To play, spot 3 Elves.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may reveal a card from the top of your draw deck for each forest on the adventure path to heal an Elf for each [elven] card revealed.
lore: 'Do not let your hearts be troubled....'
subtitle: Sorceress of the Hidden Land

title: Inside a Song
gametext: Exert an Elf to take an [elven] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile and you may reinforce an [elven] token.
lore: 'I thought that Elves were all for moon and stars; but this is more elvish than anything I ever heard tell of.'

effect.text: Would you like to reinforce {elven} token?

title: Kindreds Estranged
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [elven] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make a minion skirmishing your Elf at a forest or river site strength -3.
lore: 'Men multiply and the Firstborn decrease....'

title: Legolas
gametext:
Archer.
At the start of each archery phase, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, wound a minion.
lore: 'My heart bids me go on... but we must hold together. I will follow your counsel.'
subtitle: Of the Grey Company

title: Let Fly
gametext: Spot 3 Elves, spot a Shadow race, and choose a Shadow player to wound each of that player's minions which is not of that race.
lore: 'Yet I make my tale twenty at the least. But that is only a few leaves in a forest.'

cost.text: Choose a minion with a race that will be spared

title: Lórien Protector
gametext: While another companion is assigned to a skirmish, during each skirmish, prevent all wounds to this companion after the first wound.
lore: There was a sound of soft laughter over their heads, and then another clear voice spoke in an elven-tongue.

title: Many Miles
gametext: Spot 2 Elf archers to make the fellowship archery total +1 (or +2 if a Shadow player has replaced the fellowship's current site this turn).
lore: 'I can see a darkness. There are shapes moving in it, great shapes far away upon the bank of the river; but what they are I cannot tell.'

title: Secluded Homestead
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
When you play this, add an [elven] token here for each forest site and each river site on the adventure path.
Regroup: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to reconcile your hand.

title: Shrouded Elf
gametext: Response: If you play an event during a skirmish involving this companion, exert this companion to place that event on top of your draw deck.
lore: Cloaked by Elven garments and by darkness, warriors led by Haldir reinforced Helm's Deep.

title: Spring Forth Nimbly
gametext: Make an Elf strength +1 for each card that has an [elven] token on it.
lore: ...the Elf had no boots, but wore only light shoes, as he always did....

title: Standing Tall
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -1 for each of the following that is true: it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or more; it is wounded; you can spot an Elf archer; the fellowship is at a forest site.
lore: Yrch,' said Legolas, falling into his own tongue.

title: Take Up the Bow
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [elven] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Archery: Discard this from play and spot 3 Elf archers to discard a minion from play. Each of those archers loses archer and cannot gain archer.
lore: Stringing the bow and fitting an arrow....

title: Wells of Deep Memory
gametext:
At the end of your turn, discard this from play if the fellowship did not move more than once this turn.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may draw a card for each of the following you can spot: Arwen, Celeborn, or Galadriel.

title: Alatar
gametext:
Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may reinforce a [gandalf] token.
While you can spot a [gandalf] companion, each minion skirmishing bearer is strength -1.
lore: Third of the Istari to be named, he was clad in sea-blue.
subtitle: Final Envoy

title: Dasron
gametext: At the start of the fellowship phase, you may remove 2 Free Peoples culture tokens to take a [gandalf] event into hand from your discard pile.
lore: ...its inhabitants, traditional trading partners of Esgaroth and Dale, now look to their northern allies for protection against the wild Easterlings....
subtitle: Merchant From Dorwinion

title: Fear and Great Wonder
gametext:
When you play this, add a [gandalf] token here.
Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to spot a [gandalf] companion. That companion gains muster until end of turn.
lore: The Hosts of Isengard roared, swaying this way and that, turning from fear to fear.

title: The Flame of Anor
gametext:
Spell.
Spot 3 [gandalf] companions to make a minion skirmishing a companion strength -3.
lore: The power of the flame is like that of the Sun – beautiful yet blinding.

title: For a While Less Dark
gametext:
Spell.
Make a [gandalf] companion strength +2 (or +4 if that companion bears a follower).
lore: The Nazgûl gave a long wailing cry and swerved away; and with that the four others waivered....

title: Gandalf
gametext: While Gandalf is the Ring-bearer, each time the fellowship moves, add 3 burdens unless you spot 2 other companions and discard 2 [gandalf] cards from hand.
lore: 'But all worthy things that are in peril as the world now stands, those are my care.'
subtitle: Bearer of Obligation

title: Look to My Coming
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [gandalf] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Spot Gandalf to make your [gandalf] companion strength +3.
lore: '...at dawn on the fifth day.'

title: No Colour Now
gametext: Discard your [gandalf] condition from play to discard a condition from play and draw a card.
lore: 'He raised his hand, and spoke slowly in a clear cold voice. 'Saruman, your staff is broken.'

title: The Palantír of Orthanc
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf. To play this, if you can spot The Palantír of Orthanc, discard it.
At the start of the fellowship phase, you may add a burden to reveal a Shadow player's hand. He or she must choose a revealed minion and discard it from hand.
lore: ...a heavy shining thing came hurtling down from above.
subtitle: Recovered Seeing Stone

title: Pallando
gametext:
Aid – (2).
Each time you transfer this to a companion, except a [gandalf] companion, exert bearer twice.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may discard a condition from play.
lore: Brought as a companion by Alatar, he traveled the South and East to aid the Free Peoples.
subtitle: Far-travelling One

title: Radagast
gametext:
Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.)
While you can spot 2 [gandalf] companions, minions skirmishing bearer do not gain strength bonuses from possessions.
lore: 'It would have been useless in any case to try and win over the honest Radagast to treachery.'
subtitle: Tender of Beasts

title: Return to Us
gametext: Discard 2 Shadow cards from hand to take a [gandalf] event into hand from your discard pile.
lore: 'Yes, that was the name. I was Gandalf.'

title: Shadowfax
gametext:
Bearer must be a Wizard.
When you play Shadowfax, you may reinforce a [gandalf] token.
Skirmish: Remove 2 [gandalf] tokens to wound a minion skirmishing bearer.
lore: Then Shadowfax gathered himself together and sprang away, and the night flowed over him....
subtitle: Roaring Wind

title: Strange Meeting
gametext: Each companion bearing a follower gains muster (and is strength +1 if that companion is a [gandalf] companion).
lore: 'Gandalf obviously expected to find Treebeard here; and Treebeard might almost have been loitering about near the gates on purpose to meet him.'

title: Traveler's Homestead
gametext:
To play, spot a Wizard.
When you play this, add X [gandalf] tokens here, where X is the current region number.
Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to discard a Shadow condition from play.
lore: Of the Wizards, it was Gandalf that chose no home.

title: Vapour and Steam
gametext: Skirmish: Exert your [gandalf] companion and add a burden to make that companion damage +1.
lore: 'There was none to see, or perhaps in after ages songs would still be sung of the Battle of the Peak.'

title: Chasm's Edge
gametext: Gollum is strength +1 for each Ring-bound companion you can spot.
lore: ...Gollum, dancing like a mad thing, held aloft the ring... It shown now as if verily it was wrought of living fire.

title: Cunningly Hidden
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 [gollum] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card.
Spot Gollum to make a minion strength +2.
lore: 'No one ever found out what had become of Déagol....'

title: Déagol
gametext:
To play, spot Sméagol.
Aid – Add a burden.
Skirmish: If bearer is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this from play to play an artifact or possession from your draw deck on bearer.
lore: '...there in his hand lay a beautiful golden ring.'
subtitle: Fateful Finder

title: Duality
gametext: Spot Sméagol to choose a Shadow player who must discard a Shadow card from hand or remove (2).
lore: Gollum had two loyalties: The Ring and The Ring.

texts: Discard a Shadow card from hand

title: Fishing Boat
gametext:
Bearer must be Sméagol.
When you play Fishing Boat, you may reinforce a [gollum] token.
Each time Sméagol is about to be overwhelmed in a skirmish, you may remove 2 [gollum] tokens to make him strength +2 until the end of that skirmish.

title: Gladden Homestead
gametext:
To play, spot Sméagol.
When you play this, add a [gollum] token here for each [gollum] card you can spot.
Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to spot a Shadow condition and place that condition on top of its owner's draw deck.

title: Gollum
gametext:
While a card titled Déagol is removed from the game, Gollum is strength +2 and fierce.
Shadow: Remove a card titled Déagol in your discard pile from the game to play this minion from your discard pile.
lore: Of that deadly gleam and of the dark eyeholes Frodo and Sam were always conscious.
subtitle: Her Sneak

title: It's My Birthday
gametext: Make Gollum strength +2 (or +4 if you can spot Sméagol or Déagol).
lore: 'Give us that, Déagol, my love....'

title: Little Snuffler
gametext:
If the fellowship is in region 1, spot Gollum to wound a companion.
If the fellowship is in region 2, spot Gollum to exert a companion.
If the fellowship is in region 3, play a [gollum] minion from your discard pile.

title: Naked Waste
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [gollum] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Spot Sméagol to make a Ring-bound companion strength +3.
lore: 'Nothing can hide from them. Curse the White Face!'

title: Out of All Knowledge
gametext: Spot Sméagol or exert Gollum to make Sméagol strength +2 and you may reinforce a [gollum] token.
lore: And he thought suddenly: "It would be cool and shady under those mountains. The Sun could not watch me there."'

effect.text: Would you like to reinforce a {gollum} token?

title: Sméagol
gametext:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
For each card titled Déagol in your discard pile, Sméagol is strength +2 and resistance -1.
Each time Sméagol wins a skirmish, you may take a [gollum] card from your draw deck and place it in your discard pile.
lore: '...his head and his eyes were downward.'
subtitle: Simple Stoor

title: Softly Up Behind
gametext:
Spot Sméagol and discard 2 [gollum] cards from hand to return a minion with strength 6 or less to its owner's hand.
While this is in your discard pile, Sméagol gains muster.
lore: 'The Ring went into the shadows with him, and even the maker... could learn nothing of it.'

title: Trap Is Sprung
gametext:
To play, discard Gollum from play.
Heal the Ring-bearer to add a burden. If the fellowship is not in region 1, you may repeat this for each other wound on the Ring-bearer.
lore: 'Crumbs on his jacket. He took it. He took it!'

effect.text: Would you like to heal the Ring-beaer to add a burden?

title: Wild Light of Madness
gametext: Spot Gollum to make the Free Peoples player choose to either add a burden or exert a companion.
lore: ...for at that moment many things happened.

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Aragorn is strength +1 for each [gondor] card that has a culture token on it.
At the start of each assignment phase, you may exert Aragorn to make an unbound companion that has resistance 7 or more defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: Thus came Aragorn, son of Arathorn, Elessar....
subtitle: Isildur's Heir

title: Away on the Wind
gametext: Response: If Faramir is about to take a wound, discard this condition from play and place Boromir or Denethor in the dead pile from play to prevent that and heal Faramir twice.
lore: '...then I will have naught: neither life diminished, nor love halved, nor honour abated.'

title: Banners Blowing
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [gondor] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make your [gondor] Man strength +3.
lore: And so... with less than six thousands... the Captains of the West came at last to challenge the Black Gate....

title: Boromir
gametext:
Boromir is resistance -1 for each lurker minion you can spot.
Skirmish: Exert Boromir to make him strength +1 for each possession he bears.
lore: 'I shall go to Minas Tirith, alone if need be, for it is my duty.'
subtitle: Doomed Heir

title: Brego
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] companion.
When you play Brego, you may reinforce a [gondor] token.
Maneuver: Exert bearer and remove 2 [gondor] tokens to wound a minion.
lore: 'Turn this fellow free. He has seen enough of war.'
subtitle: Loyal Steed

title: Denethor
gametext:
Denethor is resistance +1 for each [gondor] possession in your discard pile.
Maneuver: Spot a [gondor] possession borne by a companion and remove that possession from the game to exert a minion twice.
lore: ...he took up the staff of his Stewardship that lay at his feet and broke it on his knee.
subtitle: Last Ruling Steward

title: Elendil
gametext:
Knight. To play, spot 2 [gondor] knights or exert 2 [gondor] Men.
Each of your [gondor] companions is resistance +1.
Maneuver: Remove a [gondor] token to make an unbound companion resistance +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: '...and Elendil of Westernesse who overthrew Sauron....'
subtitle: High-king of Gondor

title: Faramir
gametext:
While you can spot Boromir, Faramir is twilight cost -1.
While you can spot Denethor, Faramir is twilight cost -1.
While Faramir bears a [gondor] possession, he is defender +1.
lore: 'Do you wish then... that our places had been exchanged?'
subtitle: Prince of Ithilien

title: Guard of the White Tree
gametext:
Knight.
Skirmish: Discard a [gondor] condition from your support area to make this companion strength +2.
lore: This was the livery of the heirs of Elendil, and none wore it now in all Gondor, save the Guards of the Citadel....

title: Guarded City
gametext: Spot a [gondor] companion to reinforce a [gondor] token for each possession borne by that companion.
lore: ...so strong and old that it seemed to have been not builded but carven by giants out of the bones of the earth.

title: Heirs of Gondor
gametext:
When you play this, add a [gondor] token here.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to make a [gondor] companion bearing a hand weapon strength +2.
lore: 'And Eldarion our son is a man full-ripe for kingship.'

title: Hope Renewed
gametext: Discard a [gondor] possession from play to discard a possession from play and you may reinforce a [gondor] token.
lore: '...Frodo saw the old king's head: it was lying rolled away by the roadside... 'Look! The king has got a crown again!'

effect.text: Would you like to reinforce a {gondor} token

title: Isildur
gametext:
Knight.
Isildur is resistance +1 for each card in your hand.
At the end of any phase, if Isildur has resistance 0, place him in your dead pile.
Each time you reconcile, you may draw a card.
lore: '...Elendil's son cut the Ring from Sauron's hand....'
subtitle: Heir of Elendil

title: Kings' Legacy
gametext:
Each time Elendil wins a skirmish, make a [gondor] or [elven] companion strength +2 until the start of the regroup phase.
Each time Isildur wins a skirmish, heal a Man.
Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, make a [gondor] Man damage +1 until the start of the regroup phase.

title: Kingsfoil
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
Fellowship: Discard this possession from play to heal a companion and, if that companion is a [shire] companion, you may discard a condition he or she bears.
lore: 'Life to the dying / In the king's hand lying!'

title: Rally the Company
gametext: Make a [gondor] companion strength +2 (or +4 if that companion has resistance 6 or more).
lore: Aragorn was able to keep the way open for escape from the Chamber of Mazarbul.

title: Stewards' Legacy
gametext:
Each time Denethor exerts, he gains muster until the end of the regroup phase.
Each time Boromir exerts, you may exert a minion.
Each time Faramir exerts, you may spot a minion to prevent it from using special abilities until the regroup phase.

title: Storied Homestead
gametext:
When you play this, add a [gondor] token here for each [gondor] companion who has resistance 7 or more.
Response: If a minion's special ability is used, discard this condition or remove 2 [gondor] tokens from here to cancel its effect.
lore: ...a silent company of tall images graven in cold stone.

title: Tradesman From Lebennin
gametext: At the start of each fellowship phase, you may add (2) to reinforce a [gondor] token.
lore: Fearful of the spreading Shadow, many from southern Gondor sought refuge behind the walls of Minas Tirith.

title: Alatar Deceived
gametext: Each time a Wizard wins a skirmish, this condition becomes a fierce, damage +1 Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 11 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.
lore: '...the world of Men, which We must rule.'

title: Pallando Deceived
gametext: At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert a Wizard to make this condition a fierce Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 10 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.
lore: 'We may join with that Power.'

title: Radagast Deceived
gametext: Each time a Wizard heals, this condition becomes a fierce Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 12 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.
lore: 'Radagast the Simple! Radagast the Fool!'

title: Staff of Saruman
gametext:
Bearer must be a Wizard.
Regroup: If Saruman is the only minion you can spot, discard this artifact from play to return him to your hand.
lore: He raised his staff and it engulfed Gandalf in flames.
subtitle: Fallen Istar's Stave

title: Bring Down the Wall
gametext: Spot a companion to make a [men] minion strength +1 for each wound on that companion.
lore: 'Helm's Deep has one weakness. Its outer wall is solid rock but for a small culvert at its base, which is little more than a drain.'

title: Caravan From the South
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] minion.
When you play this, if you spot a plains site on the adventure path, reinforce 3 [men] tokens.
Each time the Free Peoples player plays the fellowship's next site, you may discard a possession from play.

title: Corsair Champion
gametext:
Each time a Free Peoples possession is played, you may spot a [men] card and reveal this minion from hand to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion.
While each companion is wounded, this minion is fierce.
lore: Rumor of his approach strikes terror.

title: Cruel Dunlending
gametext: Skirmish: If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert him to make another [men] minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: Burning with a rage stoked by Saruman, the Wild Hillmen made the Rohirrim villagers suffer.

title: Desert Wind
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] minion.
While you can spot 5 or more culture tokens, the minion archery total is +2.
lore: Silent Haradrim assassins strike as if from nowhere.

title: Driven From the Plains
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make a [men] minion damage +1 for each of the following that is true: it is at a plains site; it is bearing a possession; it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less.
lore: The Hillmen sent the villagers before them like lambs to the slaughter.

title: Dunlending Patriarch
gametext:
When you play this, you may spot another [men] minion to make this minion twilight cost -1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
While each companion is wounded, this minion is fierce.
lore: The wisdom of Dunland is passed from elder to youth.

title: Dunlending Trapper
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
To play, spot a [men] minion.
Assignment: Discard a [men] card from your hand to assign this minion to an unbound companion.
lore: His traps catch men as well as beasts.

title: Easterling Runner
gametext: Shadow: Exert this minion, spot another [men] minion, and remove a culture token to reinforce a [men] token.
lore: The key to coordinating the columns of the Easterling army is their use of swift couriers.

title: Fires Brightly Burning
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 [men] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card.
Make your [men] minion strength +2.
lore: The torches of hate carried by the Dunlendings were kindled by the voice of Saruman.

title: Gríma
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time a Free Peoples character is killed, you may spot another [men] minion to exert each companion.
lore: 'He was crafty: dulling men's wariness, or working on their fears, as served the occasion.'
subtitle: Footman of Saruman

title: Harmless
gametext:
Response: If a companion loses a skirmish involving a [men] minion, transfer this condition from your support area to that companion. Limit 1 per companion.
Minions cannot take wounds during skirmishes involving bearer.
lore: The Dunlendings prey on weak village folk.

title: Howdah
gametext:
When you play this, add a [men] token here for each [men] archer you spot.
At the start of the archery phase, you may discard this condition from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make the minion archery total +1.
lore: Wooden towers perched on the backs of the Mûmakil.

title: Lying in Wait
gametext:
Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to your [men] minion. Limit 1 per bearer.
Bearer is strength +1 for each other [men] minion you can spot.
Each time a [men] minion wins a skirmish, make bearer strength +1 until the regroup phase.

title: Merciless Dunlending
gametext: While you can spot another [men] minion, this minion is strength +2 for each companion assigned to a skirmish.
lore: Victims of the Dunlendings receive no quarter.

title: Pirate Cutthroat
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] card in your support area.
Shadow: Exert this minion and spot a Free Peoples condition to reinforce a [men] token for each card you spot that has the same card title as that condition.
lore: Prisoners are never taken by the Corsairs of Umbar.

title: Southron Murderer
gametext:
Archer.
While you can spot 4 or more culture tokens, this minion cannot take wounds except during skirmishes.
lore: In Harad, death is often swift, but seldom painless.

title: Stragglers
gametext:
When you play this, add a [men] token here.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to make a [men] minion strength +2 for each [men] minion not assigned to a skirmish.
lore: When finished ransacking a homestead, Dunlendings slaughtered fleeing villagers.

title: Vicious Dunlending
gametext: Skirmish: If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert him to make another [men] minion damage +1.
lore: A swath of terror cut across the fields of Rohan.

title: Voice of the Desert
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] minion.
While the fellowship is in region 1, each [men] minion cannot take wounds.
While the fellowship is in region 2, each [men] minion is an archer.
While the fellowship is in region 3, each [men] minion is fierce.
subtitle: Southron Troop

title: Worn Battleaxe
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] minion.
While you can spot a culture token, bearer is strength +1 for each companion assigned to a skirmish.
lore: Arms of the Hillmen of Dunland are crude but effective.

title: Always Threatening
gametext:
When you play this, you may add an [orc] token here for each [orc] condition you can spot.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a lurker minion strength +2.

title: Chamber Patrol
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] minion.
While the fellowship is in region 1, [orc] Orcs cannot take wounds.
While the fellowship is in region 2, the current site gains underground.
While the fellowship is in region 3, each [orc] Orc is strength +2.

title: Defiled
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 [orc] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card.
Make your [orc] lurker minion strength +2.
lore: ...transmogrified to trophies by the advancing hordes.

title: Enemy Upon Enemy
gametext:
Regroup: Spot an [orc] lurker minion to stack that minion here.
Shadow: Remove a burden to play a lurker minion stacked here as if from hand. That minion is twilight cost -3.
lore: On they came, reckless of their loss as they approached.

title: Expendable Servants
gametext: If you can spot more [orc] conditions than [orc] minions, you may discard your [orc] condition from play to play an [orc] minion from your discard pile.
lore: Sauron's minions were loyal to his rule. Their loyalty was repaid in blood: the enemy's or their own.

title: Forced March
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [orc] minions.
Regroup: Make the Free Peoples player spot another [orc] condition, discard it from play, and remove (3) to make the Free Peoples player choose to move again this turn (if the move limit allows). Discard this condition.
lore: Orcs do not rest.

title: Howling Orc
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time an [orc] minion is killed in a skirmish, you may make this minion strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lore: Losses served only to enrage the besiegers.

title: Isengard Informant
gametext: Regroup: Exert this minion to play an [orc] Troll from your discard pile.
lore: Some remained in Isengard to propel the war machine.

title: Massing Strength
gametext: Discard any number of your [orc] minions from play to make an [orc] minion strength +3 for each one discarded.
lore: ...the Dark Power, moving its armies like pieces on the board, was gathering them together.

title: Orc Crusher
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] Orc.
This minion is twilight cost -1 for each burden.
Each time a Ring-bound companion loses a skirmish involving an [orc] minion, you may reveal this card from hand to add a burden.
lore: 'Hit me now, Sam. Hit me!'

title: Orc Line-breaker
gametext: At the end of each skirmish involving this minion, if you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, this minion is fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: Fell captains moved Sauron's forces from the Gorgoroth plains.

title: Orc Plains Runner
gametext: Regroup: Discard this minion from play (or exert this minion if the fellowship's next site is an underground site) and spot another [orc] minion to return that minion to your hand.
lore: Saruman unleashed the remaining minions to ravage the countryside of Rohan.

title: Orc Raid Commander
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] card in your support area.
When you play this, spot a Free Peoples condition to discard from play each other card that has the same card title as that condition.
lore: Once inside the walls of the City, the besiegers were ordered to kill on sight.

title: Orc Reaper
gametext: While you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, each minion that has the title Orc Reaper is strength +2.
lore: As they overrun the lands of the Free Peoples, the forces of the Shadow destroy all available resources.

title: Ordnance Grunt
gametext:
Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot an [orc] minion.
Shadow: Discard an [orc] condition from play to play this minion from your discard pile.
lore: Only Trolls had the strength to man the siege catapults.

title: Picket Denizen
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Response: If another [orc] minion is about to take a wound, exert this minion to prevent that.
lore: Frontline minions drew the fire of parapet archers.

title: Underdeeps Denizen
gametext: While this minion is at an underground site, it cannot take wounds.
lore: There was a crash on the door, followed by crash after crash.... How many there were the Company could not count.

title: Unforgiving Depths
gametext:
While you can spot 3 underground sites, each [orc] Orc gains muster.
Shadow: Discard this condition from play and spot an [orc] minion to replace the fellowship's current site with an underground site from your adventure deck.

title: Whatever Means
gametext: Make an [orc] Orc strength +2 (or +6 if you remove 2 burdens).
lore: The besiegers believed not that the flames would burn the city walls, but the souls of those behind them.

effect.text: Would you like to remove 2 burdens to add +4 more strength?

title: Bitter Tidings
gametext:
If Théoden is about to take a wound in a skirmish, you may discard from play Éomer or Théodred to prevent that.
If Théodred is about to take a wound in a skirmish, you may discard from play Éomer or Éowyn to prevent that.
lore: Théodred my son is slain.'

effects.text: Discard Éomer or Théodred to prevent wound to Théoden
Discard Éomer or Éowyn to prevent wound to Théodred

title: Éomer
gametext:
While Éomer bears a mount, he is damage +1.
While no other companion is assigned to a skirmish, Éomer is strength +1 for each other [rohan] companion you can spot.
lore: 'I have no child. Théodred my son is slain. I name Éomer my sister-son to be my heir.'
subtitle: Heir to Meduseld

title: Éowyn
gametext:
Each possession you play on Éowyn during the fellowship phase is twilight cost -1.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may reinforce a [rohan] token (or reinforce 2 [rohan] tokens if you can spot Éomer or Théoden).
lore: 'Let her be as lord to the Eorlingas, while we are gone.'
subtitle: Restless Warrior

title: Ferthu Théoden Hal
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [rohan] Men.
Unless you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, discard a possession from play.
lore: 'Receive now this cup and drink in happy hour.'

title: Firefoot
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
When you play Firefoot, you may reinforce a [rohan] token.
At the start of the maneuver phase, if bearer is Éomer, you may remove 2 [rohan] tokens to make him defender +1 and strength +1 until the regroup phase.
subtitle: Mearas of The Mark

title: Freely Across Our Land
gametext:
When you play this, add a [rohan] token here.
Regroup: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to play a [rohan] possession from your discard pile on your [rohan] companion.
lore: Unchecked, unchallenged, killing at will!

title: Háma
gametext:
Háma is strength +1 for each Shadow possession you can spot.
Each time Háma wins a skirmish, you may discard a possession from play.
lore: 'Do not hope too much! These are dark days.'
subtitle: Captain of the King's Guard

title: Hamstrung
gametext: Make a [rohan] companion strength +2 (or +5 if the fellowship has moved twice this turn).
lore: Spears and arrows from Rohan brought down the mighty Mûmakil.

title: Hurried Barrows
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [rohan] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make your mounted [rohan] companion strength +3.
lore: The fallen sleep with honor.

title: King's Board
gametext:
Skirmish: Exert Éomer to make Éowyn or Théoden strength +2.
Skirmish: Exert Éowyn to make Éomer or Théoden strength +2.
Skirmish: Exert Théoden to make Éomer or Éowyn strength +2.
lore: Also wakened in Edoras was hospitality.

effects.text: Exert Éomer to make Éowyn or Théoden strength +2
Exert Éowyn to make Éomer or Théoden strength +2
Exert Théoden to make Éomer or Éowyn strength +2

title: Merchant of Westfold
gametext: Each time the fellowship moves, you may add (1) and remove a Free Peoples culture token to reinforce a [rohan] token.
lore: Villagers from the surrounding farmlands fled to Helm's Deep seeking safety.

title: Riddermark Tactician
gametext:
When you play this, you may reinforce a [rohan] token.
Each time a Shadow player replaces the fellowship's current site, you may spot another [rohan] Man to make, until the regroup phase, the fellowship archery total +2 and the minion archery total -2.

title: Ride With Me
gametext: Make your [rohan] companion strength +2 (or exert Théoden to make that companion strength +5 and damage +1 instead).
lore: Maybe we shall cleave a road, or make such an end as will be worth a song – if any be left to sing of us hereafter.'

true.text: Would you like to exert Théoden to add +3 strength and damage +1?

title: Rider's Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
If bearer is mounted, he or she is strength +1.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may choose a Shadow player who must wound one of his or her minions.
lore: Riders of the Mark carried short bows easily fired from horseback.

title: Snowmane
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
When you play Snowmane, you may reinforce a [rohan] token.
Skirmish: If bearer is Théoden, you may remove 2 [rohan] tokens to exhaust a minion he is skirmishing.
lore: 'Where now the horse and the rider?'
subtitle: Noble Mearas

title: Théoden
gametext:
While you can spot Éowyn, Théoden is defender +1.
While you can spot Éomer, Théoden is damage +1.
While you can spot Théodred, the move limit is +1.
lore: 'Let horse be bridled, horn be sounded!'
subtitle: The Renowned

title: Théodred
gametext:
While you can spot a [rohan] Man who has resistance of 7 or more, Théodred is twilight cost -1.
At the start of each skirmish involving Théodred, you may exert each minion he is skirmishing.
lore: The son of Théoden defended Rohan at the Fords of Isen.
subtitle: Second Marshal of the Mark

title: Wind-swept Homestead
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [rohan] companions.
When you play this, add a [rohan] token here for each plains site and each battleground site on the adventure path.
At the start of each regroup phase, add a [rohan] token here for each of your companions that has muster.

title: Sauron
gametext:
Damage +1. Fierce.
When you play Sauron, you may exert any number of minions. For each minion you exert, Sauron is twilight cost -X, where X is the current region number.
lore: '...the Shadow grows once more....'
subtitle: Dark Lord of Mordor

title: Sceptre of the Dark Lord
gametext:
Bearer must be Sauron.
He is damage +1.
Each time Sauron wins a skirmish and the companion he is skirmishing is not killed, you may assign X wounds to other companions, where X is the current region number.

title: Bilbo
gametext:
Ring-bound.
While Bilbo is not assigned to a skirmish, each Ring-bound Hobbit is strength +1.
At the start of each skirmish involving Bilbo, you may remove a burden for each other Ring-bound Hobbit you can spot.
lore: '...I am quite ready to go on another journey....'
subtitle: Aged Ring-bearer

title: Bill the Pony
gametext:
Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit.
When you play Bill the Pony, you may reinforce a [shire] token.
Regroup: Spot 2 minions and remove 2 [shire] tokens to make a Shadow player discard a minion from play.
lore: Sam would not go to bed until he had visited Bill....
subtitle: Dearly-loved

title: Daddy Twofoot
gametext:
Aid – Add a burden. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a burden to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may take a [shire] event into hand from your discard pile.
lore: 'That's a dark bad place, if half the tales be true.'
subtitle: Next-door Neighbor

title: Don't Let Go
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a Hobbit strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he or she is participating in a fierce skirmish; he or she has resistance 7 or more; he or she is at a dwelling site; you can spot an unwounded Hobbit.
lore: 'Don't you give up on me Mr. Frodo!'

title: Everything but My Bones
gametext:
