gametext: Play a [men] minion stacked on a [men] possession as if from hand.
lore: Few could escape the oncoming pillage of the Dunlending's savage stampede.

title: Primitive Brand
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] minion.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this possession to another [men] minion. If you do, stack a [men] minion from play on a [men] possession in your support area.
lore: The men of Dunland took even the most basic of tools to be weapons against Rohan.

title: Saruman
gametext:
Each [men] minion bearing a possession is strength +2.
Skirmish: Exert Saruman to play a [men] possession from your discard pile.
lore: Take back the lands they stole from you!
subtitle: Coldly Still

title: Stampeding Chief
gametext:
Damage +1. Fierce.
If you play Stampeding Chief from your hand, remove (3) and spot another [men] minion or discard Stampeding Chief.
lore: But no more would Rohan stand against his kind.

title: Stampeding Hillsman
gametext: Regroup: Spot a [men] minion in your discard pile and discard this minion to place that minion on your [men] support area possession.
lore: Argh!!

title: Stampeding Madman
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [men] Men.
When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each site you control.
lore: Death to the robbers of the North!

title: Stampeding Ransacker
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [men] Men.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish and you can spot a site you control, exhaust an unbound companion.
lore: Death to the Forgoil!

title: Stampeding Savage
gametext: Maneuver: Discard this minion and X minions stacked on a [men] possession to play a [men] minion from your discard pile. That minion is twilight cost -X.
lore: We will fight for you!

title: Stampeding Shepherd
gametext:
Fierce.
Maneuver: Discard this minion and a [men] minion with a twilight cost 2 or less from play to play Stampeding Chief from your draw deck. It is twilight cost -8.
lore: We will die... for Saruman!

title: Sunland Guard
gametext: Maneuver: Exert this minion to play a [men] minion (or 2 if you spot 6 companions) from a [men] possession as if from hand.
lore: They prepare for the last war.

title: Sunland Scout
gametext:
This minion is strength +1 for each [men] possession with a [men] minion stacked on it.
Maneuver: Spot a [men] possession and discard this minion from play to discard a condition.
lore: The Southrons did not march into war blindly.

title: Sunland Skirmisher
gametext:
This minion is strength +1 for each [men] minion stacked on each [men] possession.
At the start of your maneuver phase, you may play a minion stacked on a [men] possession as if from hand.
lore: Vile servants of Sauron marched to their master.

title: Sunland Sneak
gametext: This minion is twilight cost -1 for each [men] minion stacked on a [men] possession.
lore: Southron men were always ready for war.

title: Sunland Trooper
gametext:
This minion is strength +2 for each [men] possession with a [men] minion stacked on it.
Maneuver: Spot X [men] minions stacked on a [men] possession and discard this minion to add (X).
lore: ...legions of Haradrim from the South....

cost.text: Choose how many {men} minions to spot

title: Sunland Warrior
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a [men] possession and discard this minion from play to make each [men] minion you spot strength +2 until the start of the regroup phase.
lore: They were wicked men.

title: Sunland Weaponmaster
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [men] Men.
While this minion bears a possession, he is strength +2 for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.
lore: War will make corpses of us all.

title: Vengeful Savage
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may stack a [men] minion from your discard pile on a [men] possession in your support area.
lore: We will take their king.

title: Vengeful Wild Man
gametext: At the start of the maneuver phase, spot another [men] Man and exert this minion to add a threat. Then add an additional threat for each companion you spot over 4.
lore: The pawns of Saruman are relentless in their tasks.

title: Vengeful Pillager
gametext: When you play this minion from your draw deck or from your [men] possession, it is fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: Murderers!

title: Vengeful Primitive
gametext: You may play this minion any time you could play a maneuver event. When you play this minion in the maneuver phase, you may discard X [men] minions from play to add (X).
lore: Incited by Saruman, they created pandemonium in the land of Rohan.

title: Wildman's Oath
gametext:
Each time a [men] minion is discarded during the maneuver phase, you may stack it here.
Skirmish: Discard this possession to make a [men] Man strength +2.
lore: Take back the lands they stole from you!

title: A Defiled Charge
gametext:
To play, exert your mounted [orc] Orc.
Each time the Free Peoples player assigns a mounted [orc] Orc to a companion, he or she must choose to either exert that companion or add (2).
lore: The wolf snarled and sprang towards them with a great leap.

title: Chaotic Clash
gametext:
To play, spot no minions.
Each time you play a minion, it is twilight cost +1.
While you can spot an [orc] minion, each companion is strength -1.
lore: An Orc often was spurred into battle as if death was preferable to the torment of its orkish life.

title: Cry and Panic
gametext: Each time a mounted [orc] Orc wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must reveal his or her hand and place two Free Peoples cards revealed on the bottom of his or her draw deck.
lore: Wargs! We are under attack!

title: Feral Ride
gametext: Make an [orc] minion strength +2 (or +4 if it is mounted).
lore: It was hard at times to tell who was truly the master, the warg or the Orc.

title: Grishnákh
gametext:
Hunter 2.
While you can spot an [uruk-hai] minion, each [orc] Orc gains hunter 1 (if that [uruk-hai] minion is Uglúk, each [orc] Orc gains an additional hunter 1).
Shadow: Exert Grishnákh twice to play an [uruk-hai] hunter minion from your draw deck.
subtitle: Treacherous Captain

title: Orkish Assassin
gametext: While you can spot a follower attached to a companion, each [orc] minion is strength +2.
lore: Vile villain of all that opposed his master.

title: Orkish Berserker
gametext: When this minion wins a skirmish, discard an [orc] minion from play.
lore: These Orcs were fearsome warriors.

title: Orkish Cavalry
gametext:
Each time you play an [orc] mount, you may draw a card.
Assignment: If this minion is mounted, exert it twice to assign it to a companion of strength 9 or more.
lore: With speed and numbers, these feared riders were not easily avoided.

title: Orkish Dreg
gametext: Each time you play this minion, you may spot another [orc] minion to exert a companion for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.
lore: Under the cover of darkness the Orcs came.

title: Orkish Fiend
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] Orc.
While at an underground site, this minion is fierce and the Free Peoples player may not replace sites or play a site from his or her adventure deck.
lore: Dwellers of foul pits and tunnels.

title: Orkish Flanker
gametext:
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, if it is mounted, exert a companion.
Shadow: Exert 3 [orc] minions and spot an [orc] mount to discard a condition.
lore: Quick to contain their fleeing victims, the Orkish riders were always feared.

title: Orkish Footman
gametext: This minion is strength +1 for each twilight token you can spot.
lore: They feared their master more than any enemy.

title: Orkish Invader
gametext: At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may reveal an [orc] condition from hand to wound the companion this minion is skirmishing twice and then discard this minion.
lore: Spawned from terrible acts, the Orcs emerged as ruined and terrible forms of life.

title: Orkish Lackey
gametext: Maneuver: Spot 2 [orc] conditions and discard this minion from play to wound an unbound companion.
lore: They came from dark and evil places.

title: Orkish Maurader
gametext: This minion is strength +1 for each [orc] condition in your discard pile.
lore: As the Orcs silently approached, the fear they brought multiplied.

title: Orkish Rider
gametext:
Each mounted [orc] Orc is strength +1.
Shadow: Discard an [orc] card from your hand to play an [orc] mount from your discard pile.
lore: They formed the cavalry of the Orc legions.

title: Orkish Runner
gametext: Shadow: Exert this minion and spot another [orc] minion to add (X), where X is the number of the current region.
lore: Orcs were kept in check by the light of the sun.

title: Orkish Scout
gametext: Shadow: Exert this minion to add (X), where X is the current site's Shadow number.
lore: Bred in dark sorcery.

title: Orkish Traveler
gametext:
Each [orc] mount is twilight cost -1.
Skirmish: Remove (3) to make a mounted [orc] Orc strength +2.
lore: There is not much that is fouler than Orcs.

title: Orkish Veteran
gametext:
Each time you play an [orc] mount, you may reinforce an [orc] token.
Regroup: Exert Orkish Veteran to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lore: Skin as dark as wood that has been charred by flame.

title: Orkish Warg-master
gametext:
Each time a mounted [orc] minion wins a skirmish, you may make the Free Peoples player place a card from his or her hand on top of his or her draw deck.
Shadow: Exert Orkish Warg-master to play an [orc] mount from your discard pile.
lore: Argh!!

title: Orkish Warrior
gametext: While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +4. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, discard this minion.
lore: These Orcs were loathsome as Elves were fair.

title: Relentless Warg
gametext:
Bearer must be an [orc] Orc with strength 10 or less. Bearer is fierce.
When you play this possession, spot a race. While bearer is skirmishing a companion of that race, bearer is strength +3 and damage +1.
lore: The wolves of Isengard will return.

effect.text: Spot a race

title: Rider's Gear
gametext:
Bearer must be an [orc] Orc.
While bearer is mounted, it cannot take wounds except during the skirmish phase.
lore: Foul of smell but light to bear, a warg would often allow its rider little leeway.

title: Threatening Warg
gametext:
Bearer must be an [orc] Orc with strength 10 or less. Bearer is fierce.
When you play this, you may spot 2 [orc] Orcs that are not bearing mounts to play an [orc] mount from your draw deck.
lore: 'The wolf that one hears is worse than the orc that one fears.'

title: Vicious Warg
gametext: Bearer must be an [orc] Orc with strength 9 or less. Bearer is fierce.
lore: '...where the warg howls, there also the orc prowls.'

title: Aragorn
gametext: Valiant. While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each [rohan] companion gains hunter 1.
lore: 'No enemy has yet taken the Hornburg. Depart, or not one of you will be spared.'
subtitle: Defender of Rohan

title: Dispatched With Haste
gametext:
While at a plains site, each mounted companion is strength +1.
Regroup: Spot 2 [rohan] Men and discard a [rohan] possession to discard a possession.
lore: Assemble the army at Dunharrow, as many men as can be found.

title: Éomer
gametext:
Damage +1.
While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, Éomer is strength +3.
Maneuver: If Éomer is mounted, exert him to make him defender +1 until the end of turn.
lore: We cannot achieve victory through strength of arms.
subtitle: Northman

title: Éowyn
gametext:
While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, Éowyn cannot take wounds while skirmishing.
Assignment: Exert Éowyn and assign a minion to the Ring-bearer to make that minion lose all game text keywords and unable to gain game text keywords until the regroup phase.
subtitle: Northwoman

title: For Death and Glory
gametext:
While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each minion skirmishing a [rohan] companion loses hunter and is unable to gain hunter.
Skirmish: Exert a [rohan] companion to make that companion gain hunter 1 until the start of the regroup phase.

title: Throne of the Golden Hall
gametext:
To play, spot Théoden (or 2 [rohan] companions).
Saruman and Gríma cannot be assigned to skirmishes.
Response: If a [rohan] Man is about to take a wound, exert another [rohan] Man and add (2) to prevent that.

title: Háma
gametext: While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each minion skirmishing Háma loses strength bonuses and damage bonuses from possessions.
lore: Hail, Théoden King!
subtitle: Northman

title: Into the Caves
gametext:
To play, spot 3 [rohan] companions.
Assignment: Assign a minion to Frodo to make that minion lose all game text keywords of your choice and unable to gain game text keywords until the regroup phase.
lore: Saruman's arm will have grown long indeed if he thinks he can reach us here.

effect.text: Would you like to choose more keywords?

title: Soldier of Rohan
gametext: While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, this companion is strength +2.
lore: For ages, the people of Rohan have been allied to Gondor.

title: Théoden
gametext:
While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each [rohan] companion is strength +1.
Regroup: Spot 2 [rohan] followers and exert Théoden to liberate a site.
lore: When last I looked, Théoden, was King of Rohan.
subtitle: Northman, King of Rohan

title: Where Now The Horse
gametext: Spot a [rohan] companion to make Frodo strength +5. If Frodo loses the skirmish, discard that [rohan] companion.
lore: 'They have passed like rain in the mountains, like the wind in the meadow.'

title: Warrior of Rohan
gametext:
Possessions cannot be transferred from this companion to another character.
Fellowship: Play a possession on this companion to liberate a site.
lore: Rohirrim territories are not easily taken.

title: Throne of the Dark Lord
gametext:
To play, spot 2 minions.
While you can spot Sauron, each other minion is damage +1.
While the fellowship is in the same region as Mount Doom, each companion is resistance -2.
lore: One for the Dark Lord on his dark throne.

title: Halfling Leaf
gametext:
Pipeweed. To play, spot a Hobbit.
Skirmish: Discard a pipeweed from play to cancel a skirmish involving an unbound Hobbit.
lore: 'It feels good, and it smells good.'

title: Merry
gametext:
Add 1 to the number of Ents you can spot.
Regroup: Exert Merry to place a pipeweed from your discard pile beneath your draw deck.
lore: 'I think we may have made a mistake leaving the Shire, Pippin.'
subtitle: In the Bloom of Health

title: Hornblower Leaf
gametext:
Pipeweed. To play, spot an unbound Hobbit.
Regroup: Discard a pipeweed from play to remove a threat.
Regroup: Discard a pipeweed from play to discard a minion.
lore: 'These are the Hornblower brandmarks....'

title: Pippin
gametext:
Add 1 to the number of Ents you can spot.
Maneuver: Discard 2 pipeweed cards from play to remove a burden.
lore: Ents are – well Ents are all different for one thing.
subtitle: In the Bloom of Health

title: Southfarthing Leaf
gametext:
Pipeweed. To play, spot an unbound Hobbit.
Skirmish: Discard a pipeweed from play to make an unbound Hobbit strength +2.
Regroup: Discard this pipeweed from play to play a pipeweed from your draw deck. Reshuffle your draw deck.

title: Southlinch Leaf
gametext:
Pipeweed. To play, spot a Hobbit.
Skirmish: Discard a pipeweed from play to prevent an unbound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless that Hobbit's strength is tripled.
lore: 'How it came here, I can't imagine. For Saruman's private use, I fancy.'

title: Blade of the White Hand
gametext:
Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] Uruk-hai.
While you can spot 2 controlled sites, this minion is damage +1.
While you can spot 4 controlled sites, this minion is damage +3.
lore: The servants of the White Hand laid waste to the pride of Gondor.

title: Deathly Roar
gametext:
Each time the Free Peoples player plays a possession or artifact, place an [uruk-hai] token here.
Each time an [uruk-hai] minion wins a skirmish, you may remove an [uruk-hai] token to exert a companion.
lore: The Uruk-hai assault on Helm's Deep was relentless.

title: Land Had Changed
gametext: Make an Uruk-hai strength +2 (or spot a site you control to make that Uruk- hai strength +3 instead). You may then liberate a site to make that Uruk-hai strength +2 and damage +1.
lore: 'The Deeping Wall is taken, lord, and all the defense swept away....'

effect.text: Would you like to liberate a site to make {chosenUrukHai} strength +2 and damage +1?

title: Saruman
gametext:
Each time an [uruk-hai] hunter wins a skirmish, heal a different [uruk-hai] minion.
Skirmish: Exert Saruman twice to make a companion lose the hunter keyword until the start of the regroup phase.
lore: 'He has claimed lordship over all this land....'
subtitle: Curunír

title: Saruman
gametext:
Each companion is resistance -1.
Skirmish: Exert Saruman to discard a condition borne by a companion skirmishing an [uruk-hai] minion.
lore: A new power is rising. Its victory is at hand.
subtitle: Master of the White Hand

title: Spear of the White Hand
gametext: Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] Uruk-hai.
lore: We will drive the machine of war with the sword and the spear....

title: Vile Pit
gametext:
To play, spot an [uruk-hai] hunter.
At the start of each Shadow phase, you may discard 2 [uruk-hai] cards from hand to play an [uruk-hai] hunter from your discard pile.
Regroup: Discard this possession to return an [uruk-hai] hunter from play to your hand.
lore: Saruman gazed on his creations with great pride.

title: White Hand Aggressor
gametext:
Damage +1.
While you control a site, this minion cannot take wounds, except during the skirmish phase.
lore: It's Saruman's army! The war has started.

title: White Hand Attacker
gametext:
Damage +1.
While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each site on the adventure path gains each terrain keyword from each site you control.
lore: You will taste Man-flesh.

title: White Hand Berserker
gametext:
Damage +1.
At the start of the archery phase, if you control a site, you may add 2 to the minion archery total for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.
lore: ...there was a crash and a flash of flame and smoke.

title: White Hand Butcher
gametext: Hunter 6. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +6.)
lore: 'Bring out your skulking king!'

title: White Hand Captain
gametext:
Fierce.
While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each hunter character is strength +1.
lore: They wore black armor and mail that was marked with the white hand of Saruman.

title: White Hand Destroyer
gametext:
Fierce.
This minion gains hunter 3 for each site you control.
lore: 'This is no parley. You have nothing to say.'

title: White Hand Enforcer
gametext:
Damage +1.
When you play this minion, you may liberate a site to add (X), where X is the Shadow number of the liberated site.
lore: The Uruks were tireless in the pursuit of their prey.

title: White Hand Guard
gametext:
Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Skirmish: Exert this minion to make an [uruk-hai] hunter minion strength +2.
lore: Under the banner of the white hand, they came in great numbers.

title: White Hand Intruder
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, if you do not control a site, you may take control of a site.
lore: March to Helm's Deep!

title: White Hand Invader
gametext:
Damage +1.
When you play this minion, exert a companion for each site you control.
lore: There will be no dawn for men.

title: White Hand Legion
gametext:
Damage +1.
To play, remove 2 threats.
lore: The Orcs yelled and jeered.

title: White Hand Scout
gametext:
Damage +1. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.)
The roaming penalty for each [uruk-hai] minion you play is -1.
lore: 'You've got no guts outside your own sties.'

title: White Hand Slayer
gametext:
Fierce.
Each time a player plays an event in a skirmish involving this minion, that player may exert a non-hunter character.
lore: '...and there has been war between us for many months.'

title: White Hand Taskmaster
gametext:
Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
When you play this minion, you may spot another [uruk-hai] minion to add a threat for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.
lore: White Hand warriors fell to evil deeds with a passion.

title: White Hand Trooper
gametext:
Fierce.
While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each hunter companion loses its special abilities and skirmish events can not be played in those companions skirmishes.
lore: ...the West is no longer safe.

title: White Hand Vanquisher
gametext:
Fierce.
This minion is damage +1 for each [uruk-hai] hunter assigned to a skirmish.
lore: 'They have a blasting fire, and with it they took the Wall.'

title: White Hand Veteran
gametext:
Damage +1.
When you play this minion, if you control a site, you may take an [uruk-hai] event into hand from your discard pile.
lore: To War!

title: White Hand Warrior
gametext:
Fierce. Hunter 4. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +4.)
Each time this minion is assigned to a non-hunter companion, you may heal a hunter.
lore: Leave none alive!

title: You Do Not Know Fear
gametext: Discard a condition for each [uruk-hai] minion you can spot.
lore: Endangering and entangling all those that stood before them, the Uruk-hai shrunk before none.

title: You Do Not Know Pain
gametext:
Each time you take control of a site, you may spot 3 [uruk-hai] minions to exert an unbound companion.
Skirmish: Liberate a site to make an [uruk-hai] minion damage +1.
lore: If the wall is breached, Helm's Deep will fall.

title: Úlairë Cantëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Each unbound companion is resistance -1 for each card he or she bears.
Skirmish: Exert Úlairë Cantëa to exert a companion with resistance 2 or less.
lore: Drawn to the power of the one. They will never stop hunting you.
subtitle: Duplicitous Assassin

title: Úlairë Enquëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Each time the Free Peoples player heals a companion, you may add a burden.
Maneuver: Exert Úlairë Enquëa twice to discard a condition (or two conditions if you can spot 5 Free Peoples player's conditions).
lore: At all times they feel the presence of the ring.
subtitle: Duplicitous Lieutenant

title: Úlairë Otsëa
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play Úlairë Otsëa, you may spot another Nazgûl to draw a card for each wounded companion you can spot.
Regroup: Exert Úlairë Otsëa and discard a [wraith] card from hand to add a burden.
lore: Blinded by their greed, they took them without question.
subtitle: Duplicitous Specter

title: Ring of Savagery
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must either add a burden or exert a companion.
Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

title: Ring of Terror
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl. Bearer is damage +1.
When you play this artifact, you may remove two threats to take a [wraith] card into hand from your discard pile.
Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

title: The Witch-king
gametext:
Fierce.
Each time the Witch-king wins a fierce skirmish, you may exert a companion for each companion you can spot over 4.
subtitle: Conqueror of Arthedain

title: Dol Guldur
gametext: Regroup: Exert your minion and remove a threat to make the Free Peoples player discard one of his or her conditions.

title: Falls of Rauros
gametext: River. When the Fellowship moves to this site in region 2, the Free Peoples player places a card from the dead pile out of play.

title: Imladris
gametext: River. When the fellowship moves to this site, if it is a sanctuary, remove 2 burdens.

title: Nurn
gametext: Plains. While you control this site, each of your hunter minions is strength +1.

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may add a threat to wound a minion (or wound a hunter minion twice).
subtitle: Sprinter

title: Run Until Found
gametext:
When you play this condition, place a [dwarven] token here.
Skirmish: Discard this condition from play or remove a [dwarven] token from here to make a [dwarven] companion gain hunter 1.
lore: Let us hunt some Orc!

title: Thorin's Harp
gametext:
Tale.
Maneuver: Exert a [dwarven] companion to make the fellowship's current site gain mountain until the regroup phase.

title: Arwen's Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be an [elven] companion.
Archery: If bearer is Arwen, discard 2 [elven] cards from hand to wound a minion.
lore: Arwen had skill with a bow matched only by her beauty.

title: Arwen's Dagger
gametext:
Bearer must be an [elven] companion.
Bearer may bear this hand weapon in addition to 1 other hand weapon.
Maneuver: If bearer is Arwen, exert her to draw 2 cards.
lore: Woe be to any against whom she wielded it.

title: Back to the Light
gametext: To play, exert an [elven] companion or spot Arwen. Examine the top 5 cards of your draw deck and place any number of them aside. Shuffle the remaining cards into your draw deck and place those cards set aside on top of your draw deck in any order.

effect.text: Choose cards to set aside

title: Celebring
gametext:
Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.)
To play, spot 2 [elven] companions.
When you play Celebring, you may play an [elven] artifact from your deck.
lore: ...renewed shall be the blade that was broken.
subtitle: Elven-smith

title: Elven Armaments
gametext:
To play, bearer must not be bearing any possessions. Bearer must be an [elven] companion.
Bearer cannot bear any other possessions.
While a unique companion bears this possession, the Free Peoples player may not use archery special abilities and the minion archery total is -1.
lore: Tangado haid!

title: Elven Defender
gametext: While you can spot an [elven] token, this companion is strength +2.
lore: While they may prefer to avoid conflict, the elves can be ferocious warriors in defense of their ideals.

title: Elven Supplies
gametext:
Fellowship: Remove a culture token from a Free Peoples card to add an [elven] token here.
Skirmish: Remove 2 [elven] tokens from here to make a minion skirmishing an [elven] companion strength -1.
lore: By river you have the chance of outrunning the enemy....

title: Galadriel's Silver Ewer
gametext:
To play, spot Galadriel or Celeborn.
While Galadriel is the Ring-bearer, she is strength +2 and resistance +2.
Each time you play an [elven] skirmish event, you may reinforce an [elven] token.
lore: Will you look into the mirror?

title: Gil-galad
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [elven] companions.
Maneuver: Add a threat to take an [elven] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile.
Regroup: Remove an [elven] token to play an [elven] condition from your discard pile.
lore: '...the power of Gil-galad has increased in his absence.'
subtitle: High King of the Noldor

title: Glorfindel
gametext:
Ranger.
To play, spot 2 [elven] companions.
Minions skirmishing Glorfindel cannot gain strength bonuses from possessions.
Each time Glorfindel wins a skirmish, you may remove a threat.
lore: 'Yet oft in lies truth is hidden....'
subtitle: Eldarin Lord

title: Haldir
gametext: Skirmish: Exert Haldir or discard an [elven] card from hand to make a minion skirmishing Haldir strength -2.
lore: I bring word from Elrond of Rivendell.
subtitle: Warrior Messenger

title: Lembas Bread
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [elven] companions. Bearer must be a companion.
Regroup: Discard this possession from play to reconcile your hand.
lore: Sam thought that it tasted far better, somehow, than it had for a good while....

title: Miruvóre
gametext: Add 2 threats to heal an [elven] companion.
lore: The long years have passed like swift draughts of sweet mead in lofty halls beyond the West....

title: Woodhall Elf
gametext:
Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.)
When you transfer this to an [elven] companion, you may draw 3 cards.
lore: 'Go not to the Elves for counsel, for they will say both no and yes.'
subtitle: Exile

title: Beorning Axe
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gandalf] Man.
While Grimbeorn is bearing this possession, each time he wins a skirmish, you may take a [gandalf] card from your discard pile into hand.
lore: No Orc or wolf dared enter the land of the Beornings.

title: Drawn to Full Height
gametext:
Spell.
Spot a [gandalf] Wizard to make a minion lose all strength bonuses from possessions.
lore: I am not trying to rob you. I'm trying to help you.

effect.text: Choose minion to lose all strength bonuses from possessions

title: Ents Marching
gametext:
If the fellowship is in region 1 or region 2, exert 2 Ents to make an Ent defender +1 until the regroup phase.
If the fellowship is in region 3, spot a [gandalf] companion to draw a card.
lore: The old that is strong does not wither; Deep roots are not reached by the frost.

title: Last Stand
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert a [gandalf] Man to add 2 [gandalf] tokens here.
Skirmish: Remove 3 [gandalf] tokens from here to make a companion strength +3.
lore: To give his people time to escape, Brand stood against the Mordor army until he was slain. His friend, the dwarf Dáin Ironfoot, stood over him until he too was 'slain.

title: Librarian
gametext:
While you can spot 2 [gandalf] tokens, each of your [gandalf] Men is strength +2.
Regroup: Discard a follower from play to choose one: draw a card; or take a [gandalf] skirmish event from your discard pile into hand.
lore: A guide through books and scrolls from floor to ceiling.

texts: Take a {gandalf} skirmish event from discard to hand

subtitle: Keeper of Ancient Texts

title: One-Upsmanship
gametext:
Spell.
Spot 2 pipeweed cards to remove a burden for each [gandalf] Wizard you can spot.
lore: Gandalf regarded the smoke ring for a moment, sucked his cheeks in, and blew out a majestic, full-rigged ship that sailed right through the ring.

title: Our Time
gametext:
Spell. To play, exert Gandalf.
When you play this condition, remove (3).
At the start of the maneuver phase, add (4) and remove this condition from the game.
lore: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given to us.

title: Perspective
gametext: Maneuver: Add 2 threats and spot a Wizard to spot a minion in play. That minion cannot use special abilities until the regroup phase.
lore: Hobbits really are amazing creatures! You can learn all that there is to know about their ways in a month, and yet after a hundred years, they can still 'surprise you.

title: Radagast's Herb Bag
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gandalf] Wizard.
Each time you play a [gandalf] spell, you may exert bearer to wound a minion.
lore: The tools of a master of herb and beast-lore were often confined to the simplest of places.

title: Ship of Smoke
gametext:
Pipeweed.
Each time you play a pipeweed card, you may spot Gandalf to reveal the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Take all Free Peoples cards revealed into hand and discard the remaining cards.
lore: Old Toby. The finest weed in the Southfarthing.

title: Countless Cords
gametext: Spot Shelob to make a minion strength +1 for each threat you can spot.
lore: 'But don't go on, master! Don't go down to that den! Now's our only chance. Now let's get out of this foul hole!'

title: Deceit
gametext: Response: If a Free Peoples player's card is about to discard your other [gollum] condition, remove (1) to prevent that.
lore: Presently they were under the shadow, and there in the midst of it they saw the opening of a cave. 'This is the way in,' said Gollum softly.

title: Enemy in Your Midst
gametext: Heal a Ring-bound companion to reinforce a [gollum] token.
lore: Earning pity and trust was the first step of Gollum's plan to reclaim his precious.

title: It Draws Him
gametext: Spot a [gollum] card to play a minion. Its twilight cost -1 (or -3 if it is roaming).
lore: He will never be rid of his need for it. He hates and loves the Ring, as he hates and loves himself.

title: Not Easily Avoided
gametext:
Shadow: Remove (3) to take a [gollum] card into hand from your draw deck, then randomly discard a card from your hand.
Skirmish: Discard a [gollum] card from hand to make a [gollum] minion strength +2.
lore: 'But I still feel that they are looking at me, or thinking about me: making some other plan, perhaps.'

title: Set Up
gametext: Spot Gollum or Sméagol to return a follower to its owner's hand.
lore: He took it!! I've seen him. He is always stuffing his face when Master is not looking.

title: Shelob
gametext:
Fierce.
Each time Shelob wins a skirmish, you may add threats up to the number of burdens you can spot.
Each time Shelob wins a skirmish, you may play Gollum from your discard pile; he is strength +3 and fierce until the end of turn.

effects.text: Add threats up to the number of burdens
Play Gollum from your discard pile

subtitle: Menace

title: Sting of Shelob
gametext:
To play, spot Shelob.
The Free Peoples player must choose two companions in play (except the Ring- bearer). He or she then chooses to place one of those companions in the dead pile and return the other to his or her hand.
lore: Poison frothed and bubbled....

title: Time for Food
gametext: If a skirmish event is played, spot Sméagol to cancel that event.
lore: Oh yes we could! Spoil nice fish. Give it to usss rrraw... and wrrriggling! You keep nasty chips.

title: Trusted Promise
gametext: Reinforce a [gollum] token. Each Shadow player may draw a card.
lore: We swears to serve the master of the preciousss. We will swear on... on the precious.

effect.text: Would you like to draw a card?

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Hunter 2.
While you can spot 3 Free Peoples cultures, Aragorn is defender +1.
While you can spot 2 Shadow cultures, Aragorn is defender +1.
subtitle: Heir to the Throne of Gondor

title: Armor of the White City
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
Bearer is a knight.
lore: Surely this is the greatest jest in all the history of Gondor: that we should ride with seven thousand, scarce as many as the vanguard of its army in the days 'of its power, to assail the mountains and the impenetrable gate of the Black Land!'

title: Boromir
gametext:
Ranger.
When you play Boromir (except in your starting fellowship), you may play a possession with a twilight cost of 1 or less on him from your draw deck. Reshuffle your draw deck.
lore: Yes, there is weakness. There is frailty. But there is courage also, and honor to be found in Men.
subtitle: Proud and Noble Man

title: Crown of Gondor
gametext:
To play, spot Aragorn, Elendil, or Isildur.
Skirmish: Spot a [gondor] Man with 3 or more vitality and discard a [gondor] card from hand to make that Man strength +2.
lore: Et Eärello Endorenna utúlien. Sinome maruvan ar Hildinyar tenn' Ambar-metta!

title: Denethor
gametext:
Each time the fellowship moves from a site, add a burden.
Skirmish: Exert another [gondor] Man to make him or her strength +1 and damage +1.
lore: No tomb for Denethor and Faramir. No long, slow sleep of death embalmed.
subtitle: On the Edge of Madness

title: Denethor's Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
While bearer is Denethor, his game text does not apply.
lore: But if doom denies this to me, then I will have naught: neither life diminished, nor love halved, nor honour abated.

title: Defenses Long Held
gametext: Make a ranger strength +2 and you may reinforce a [gondor] token.
lore: Let the armies of Mordor know this: Never again will the land of my people fall into enemy hands!

effect.text: Would you like to reinforce {gondor} token?

title: Dúnadan's Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] ranger.
Archery: Discard 2 [gondor] cards from hand to make the fellowship archery total +1.
lore: Well trained and deadly accurate, a ranger's bow was more an extension of himself than a weapon of wood.

title: Disarmed
gametext:
Bearer cannot bear any Shadow cards.
When this condition is transferred to bearer, discard all Shadow cards it bears.
Maneuver: Exert a [gondor] Man or spot a ranger to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion.
lore: In a flurry of swordplay, Aragorn sliced his arm off.

title: Elendil's Army
gametext: Aid – Exert a [gondor] companion. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert a [gondor] companion to transfer this to a companion.)
lore: ...and on the slopes of Mount Doom they fought for the freedom of Middle-earth.

title: Faramir
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 2.
If Faramir is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1.
Maneuver: Exert Faramir to heal another companion with resistance 5 or more.
lore: There are no travelers in this land. Only servants of the Dark Tower.
subtitle: Captain of Ithilien

title: Faramir's Company
gametext:
Aid – Add a threat. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a threat to transfer this to a companion.)
When you attach this card to a companion, spot a [gondor] possession to heal that companion.
lore: Cloaked rangers armed with deadly arrows and swords.

title: The Faithful Stone
gametext:
Tale. Each time a non-[wraith] minion is played, you may spot a Man to add a [gondor] token here.
Maneuver: Remove 3 [gondor] tokens from here to spot a minion. That minion cannot be assigned to a skirmish until the regroup phase. Any Shadow player may remove (2) to prevent this.
lore: Each turn was guarded by Púkel-men stones with their huge, clumsy arms folded across their round bellies.

effect.text: Would you like to remove 2 twilight to prevent effect of The Faithful Stone?

title: For Gondor!
gametext: Exert a knight to make him or her strength +3.
lore: This city was once the jewel of our kingdom. A place of light and beauty and music. And so it shall be once more!

title: Gondorian Servant
gametext:
Aid – (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (1) to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you attach this to a companion, except a [gondor] Man, add (4).
lore: If the personal servants of Denethor were aware of his madness, they were wise to conceal it.
subtitle: Denethor's Handman

title: Horn of Boromir
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
Maneuver: Exert bearer and discard a follower from play to make bearer strength +4 until the regroup phase (if bearer is Boromir, he is also defender +1 and cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled).
subtitle: The Great Horn

title: Isildur
gametext:
Knight.
Each time Isildur loses a skirmish, exert a companion.
Each time Isildur wins a skirmish, heal a companion.
lore: It was in this moment, when all hope had faded, that Isildur, son of the king, took up his father's sword.
subtitle: Sword-bearer

title: Ranger of the North
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
Maneuver: If the fellowship is in region 1 or region 2, you may exert bearer to make him or her defender +1 until the regroup phase.
Regroup: Discard this to heal a companion.
lore: This is no mere ranger. He is Aragorn, son of Arathorn. You owe him your allegiance.

title: Ranger of the South
gametext:
Ranger.
While you can spot a [gondor] token, this companion is strength +2.
lore: All had swords at their sides, and were clad in green and brown of varied hues, as if the better to walk unseen in the glades of Ithilien.

title: Shield of the White Tree
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
The minion archery total is -1.
Regroup: Discard this possession from play to make each opponent shuffle his or her hand into his or her draw deck and draw 8 cards.
lore: Tipped with silver, and adorned with the White Tree.

title: Soldier's Cache
gametext:
Fortification.
At the start of your maneuver phase, you may spot 3 rangers or exert a [gondor] Man to transfer this condition to a minion. Wound that minion.
Regroup: Exert a ranger to reinforce a [gondor] token.

title: Watcher at Sarn Ford
gametext:
Ranger.
Skirmish: Exert a [gondor] Man with a resistance 6 or more to make that Man strength +3.
lore: 'Little do they know of our long labour for the safekeeping of their borders, and yet I grudge it not.'
subtitle: Ranger of the North

title: Corsair Boarding Axe
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] minion.
Skirmish: Remove (3) to reinforce a [men] token and make bearer fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: Small and light, the boarding axe is ideal for close- quarters fighting aboard ships or in confined spaces.

title: Corsair Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] minion.
Bearer is an archer.
Each time a companion is killed during the archery phase, you may control a site.
lore: Not nearly as ornate or as accurate as the Gondorian bows, the short-bows of the Corsairs killed just as well.

title: Corsair Grappling Hook
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] minion.
When you play this possession you may reinforce a [men] token twice.
Each time a companion is killed during a skirmish phase, you may control a site.
lore: A tool equally useful in times of peace and in times of war.

title: Corsair Halberd
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] minion.
Bearer is damage +1.
Shadow: Remove a companion in the dead pile from the game to control a site.
lore: Long handled and heavy, a single powerful swing of this weapon could cleave through even some of the thickest armor.

title: Corsair Scimitar
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] minion.
Bearer is strength +1 for each [men] token you can spot (limit +5).
lore: A largely stylistic weapon, scimitars are favored for their light weight yet powerful strikes.

title: Declined Business
gametext: If the Free Peoples player plays a companion, discard a [men] card from hand to return that companion to its owner's hand.
lore: During the War of the Ring, the streets of Bree were filled mainly with Southern ruffians and thieves, and Bree-folk were afraid to leave their homes.

title: Fleet of Corsair Ships
gametext:
When you play this possession, you may add a [men] token here.
Regroup: Remove 4 [men] tokens from here to place a [men] card from your discard pile on the top of your draw deck.
lore: They'll be in the city in two days. You're outnumbered, Aragorn.

title: Gríma
gametext:
Regroup: Exert Gríma to add (2).
Regroup: Remove a [men] token to add (2).
Regroup: Remove (4) to exert an unbound companion.
lore: 'You are held wise, my friend Wormtongue, and are doubtless a great support to your master.'

effects.text: Remove 4 to exert an unbound companion

subtitle: Witless Worm

title: Harry Goatleaf
gametext:
While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4.
While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.
lore: What do you want?

title: Henchman's Dagger
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] minion.
Bearer may bear this hand weapon in addition to 1 other hand weapon.
lore: Carved from bone or forged from iron, no warrior would enter the fields of battle without a trusty, simple blade.

title: Ill News is an Ill Guest
gametext: Exert a [men] minion to discard a follower from play (if you can spot Gríma, also draw a card).
lore: Late is the hour in which this conjurer chooses to appear.

title: Mûmakil Commander
gametext:
While at a battleground, this minion is strength +2.
Each mounted Man is strength +1.
Regroup: Shuffle any number of your [men] mounts in play into your draw deck.
lore: With a sound of his horn, a line of Mûmakil appeared and the Pelennor field was filled with chaos.
subtitle: Bold and Grim

title: Ruffian
gametext:
While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4.
While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.
lore: It works for him!

title: Rough Man of the South
gametext:
While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4.
While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.
lore: Making money and making mischief was often inspiration enough for these louts. The taking of Bree and the Shire was easy work.

title: Squint-eyed Southerner
gametext:
While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4.
While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.
lore: A man of Dunland, this outlaw was a prized agent of Saruman and a spy for the Witch-king.

title: Ted Sandyman
gametext:
Maneuver: Liberate a site you control to make each [men] minion strength +2 until the regroup phase.
Regroup: Exert Ted Sandyman to stack a [men] Man in play on a possession.
lore: 'You can't touch me. I'm a friend o' Boss's. But he'll touch you all right, if I have any more of your mouth.'
subtitle: Chief's Men's Ally

title: Treachery
gametext: Spot Gríma to exert an unbound companion. That companion cannot use his or her game text until the regroup phase.
lore: This order does not come from me. It comes from the king. He signed it this morning.

title: Whisper in the Dark
gametext:
Bearer must be a follower.
At the start of the maneuver phase, if you can spot a [men] Man, the Free Peoples player must exert an unbound companion.
lore: My lord, Gandalf the Grey is coming. He's a herald of woe.

title: Destroyers and Usurpers
gametext:
While you can spot an [orc] minion and fewer minions than companions, each companion loses all defender bonuses and cannot gain defender bonuses.
Maneuver: Spot 2 [orc] minions to make the fellowship's current site gain battleground until the regroup phase.
lore: They come with fire, they come with axes.

title: Frenzy of Arrows
gametext: Spot an [orc] archer minion to add 2 to the minion archery total. If you do, you may add an additional 2 to the minion archery total for each follower you can spot.
lore: The black fletched arrows of Sauron's armies found many targets.

effect.text: Would you like to add 2 to minion archery total for each follower you can spot?

title: Gothmog
gametext:
Each of the fellowship and minion archery totals is +3.
Regroup: Remove (2) to play an [orc] minion from your discard pile. That minion comes into play exhausted.
lore: Fear. The city is rank with it.
subtitle: Morgul Leader

title: Gothmog's Warg
gametext:
Bearer must be an [orc] Orc with strength 9 or less (or bearer must be Gothmog).
Bearer is fierce.
While bearer is Gothmog, he is damage +1 in fierce skirmishes.
subtitle: Leader's Mount

title: Grond
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] minion.
Each time the fellowship moves in the regroup phase, you may discard this possession to search the Free Peoples player's draw deck and choose 2 Free Peoples cards found there. Remove those cards from the game.
lore: Grond! Grond! Grond! Grond! Grond! Grond!
subtitle: Forged With Black Steel

title: Gruesome Meal
gametext: Make a companion skirmishing an [orc] minion strength -2 (or -3 if he or she is an archer).
lore: They dined on the flesh of all that lived and breathed in Middle-earth.

title: Orkish Ax
gametext:
Bearer must be an [orc] Orc.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may add a threat.
lore: Crude blood rusted steel axes were dragged by Orcs from battle to battle.

title: Orkish Aggressor
gametext: While at a battleground, this minion is strength +2.
lore: Enraged by Sauron, the frenzied Orcs streamed to the battlefields.

title: Orkish Archer Troop
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] card.
The minion archery total is +1 for each hunter companion you can spot.
lore: ...the enemy is moving. Sauron's forces are massing in the east....

title: Orkish Breeder
gametext:
Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Shadow: Exert this minion to play an [uruk-hai] hunter at twilight cost -2.
lore: Deep in the Isengard pits, Orcs tended the mud from which the Uruk-hai were pulled from.

title: Orkish Defender
gametext: While the fellowship is at a battleground or underground site, this minion cannot take wounds in the archery phase.
lore: 'Many Elves and many mighty Men, and many of their friends, had perished in the war.'

title: Orkish Headsman
gametext:
Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
This minion is strength +3 for each companion in the dead pile (limit +6).
lore: As the free people of Middle-earth fell, Mordor's strength grew.

title: Orkish Skirmisher
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert him twice to wound a companion.
lore: Pain. Pain was part of each Orc's life.

title: Orkish Sneak
gametext: Assignment: Spot another [orc] Orc to assign this minion to skirmish a non-[shire] Ring-bearer. The Free Peoples player may add a burden or exert the Ring-bearer twice to discard this minion.
lore: The Orcs attacked the Alliance, rushing across the field that separated the armies.

effect.text: Would you like to add a burden or exert the Ring-bearer twice to discard Orkish Sneak?

title: War Preparations
gametext: Remove a threat to reinforce an [orc] token.
lore: The old world will burn in the fires of industry. The forests will fall. A new order will rise. We will drive the machine of war with the sword and the spear 'and the iron fists of the Orc. We have only to remove those who oppose us.

title: Wary Orc
gametext: This minion is strength +1 for each hunter companion you can spot.
lore: War is brewing. The mountains are fair teeming with goblins.

title: Cast from the Hall
gametext:
Each time you play a [rohan] possession from hand, add a [rohan] token here.
Skirmish: Remove 3 [rohan] tokens from here to make a [rohan] companion strength +1 and damage +1.
lore: Your leechcraft would have had me crawling on all fours like a beast!

title: Éomer's Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
If bearer is mounted, he or she is strength +1.
Archery: If bearer is Éomer, exert him to choose a Shadow player who must exert one of his or her minions.
lore: The short bows of Rohan brought down many a foe on the fields of battle.

title: Erkenbrand's Horn
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
Fellowship: Exert bearer to play a follower from your draw deck. Reshuffle your draw deck.
Skirmish: Discard a follower from play to make bearer strength +4 (if bearer is Erkenbrand, he is strength +5 instead).

effects.text: Play follower from your draw deck
Discard a follower from player to enhance bearer

title: Erkenbrand's Shield
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
The minion archery total is -1.
Skirmish: If bearer is Erkenbrand, you may add (2) to cancel a fierce skirmish involving him.
Response: If a [rohan] Man is about to take a wound, spot Gandalf and exert bearer to prevent that wound.

title: Fall Back to Helm's Deep
gametext: If the fellowship is at a plains site, exert a [rohan] companion to return a minion to its owner's hand.
lore: This is not a defeat. We will return.

title: Gamling
gametext:
Valiant.
Skirmish: Transfer a [rohan] possession that Gamling can bear to him.
lore: Summon every able-bodied man to Dunharrow.
subtitle: Dutiful Marshal

title: Gamling's Horn
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man or Merry.
Skirmish: Discard a follower from play to make bearer strength +4. If bearer is Gamling, you may also spot another companion to make him or her strength +4 until the regroup phase.
lore: Sound the charge! Take them head-on!

title: Precise Attack
gametext: Discard a [rohan] possession from play to choose one: wound an unwounded minion; exert a minion; or discard a Shadow card the Ring-bearer is bearing.
lore: Éomer's spear, now thrown, brought down the Haradrim leader.

texts: Discard a Shadow card the Ring-bearer is bearing

title: Rohirrim Diadem
gametext:
To play, spot Théoden.
Skirmish: Spot a [rohan] Man bearing a possession and discard a [rohan] possession from hand to make that Man strength +2.
lore: With Gríma's treacherous whispers removed and Saruman's grasp released, none doubted the might and lordship of Théoden, the King of Rohan.

title: Rohirrim Recruit
gametext:
Valiant.
While you can spot a [rohan] token, this companion is strength +2.
lore: Even the older men of Rohan had talents in the arts of war.

title: Surrendered Weapons
gametext:
Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot a [rohan] companion to discard a possession a character is bearing from play.
Skirmish: Add (1) to transfer a [rohan] possession borne by a companion to another eligible bearer.
lore: I cannot allow you before Théoden-King so armed.

title: Théoden
gametext:
While you can spot Gandalf, Théoden is resistance +2.
While you can spot Éomer, Théoden is damage +1.
While you can spot 3 mounted [rohan] companions, Théoden is strength +2.
lore: Now for wrath! Now for ruin! And a red dawn!
subtitle: Ednew

title: A Dragon's Tale
gametext:
Tale. To play, spot a Hobbit.
Maneuver: Discard a tale from play to choose a Shadow player who must exert one of his or her minions.
lore: If you're referring to the incident with the dragon, I was barely involved. All I did was give your uncle a little nudge out of the door.

title: Fredegar Bolger
gametext: While the fellowship is in region 1 and you can spot 2 other [shire] companions, Fredegar Bolger is strength +3.
lore: 'You'll wish you were back here with me before this time tomorrow.'
subtitle: Fatty

title: Golden Perch Ale
gametext:
Each time a [shire] companion wins a skirmish, you may add a [shire] token here.
Fellowship: Remove a [shire] token here to remove a burden.
lore: 'The best beer in the Eastfarthing, or used to be: it is a long time since I tasted it.'

title: Make a Run For It
gametext: Remove 2 [shire] tokens to cancel a skirmish involving an unbound Hobbit.
lore: As soon as he saw the dark shapes creep from the garden he knew that he must run for it, or perish. And run he did, out of the back door, through the garden, 'and over the fields.

title: Prized Lagan
gametext:
At the start of each turn, you may add (2) to heal a [shire] companion.
Maneuver: Add a threat to spot a minion. That minion loses fierce and cannot gain fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: We are sitting on the field of victory, enjoying a few well-earned comforts.

title: Robin Smallburrow
gametext:
Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you attach this follower to a [shire] companion, you may discard X cards from hand to draw X cards.
subtitle: Shirriff Cock-Robin

title: Scouring of the Shire
gametext:
Tale.
When there are 4 [shire] tokens here, discard this condition from play.
Response: If a [shire] condition or [shire] possession is about to be discarded from play by a Shadow card, add a [shire] token here to prevent that.

title: Sting
gametext:
Bearer must be Bilbo or Frodo.
Regroup: Exert bearer to remove a threat.
lore: My old sword, Sting! Here! Take it, take it!
subtitle: Elven Long Knife

title: Cleaved
gametext:
Regroup: Exert an [uruk-hai] hunter twice to transfer this condition from your support area to an unbound companion.
Archery: Spot an [uruk-hai] minion to transfer this condition from your support area to a Free Peoples archer.

title: Final Triumph
gametext: Spot your Uruk-hai skirmishing a companion to use vitality to resolve that skirmish instead of strength.
lore: Now left alone, it stopped before its foe. With a snarl it pulled back the bow, ready to deliver the last blow.

title: Fury of the Evil Army
gametext:
Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] minion.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may choose one: discard a follower from play; heal an [uruk-hai] minion; or control a site.
lore: What can men do against such reckless hate?

title: Ghastly Wound
gametext: Make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +2 and damage +1.
lore: That force of ten-thousand Uruk-hai was designed for the downfall of Man – and all those that allied with them.

title: Lurtz
gametext:
Archer. Damage +1.
Maneuver: Spot 6 companions to make Lurtz fierce until the regroup phase.
Assignment: Exert Lurtz twice to assign it to an unbound companion. The Free Peoples player may exert that companion or add a burden to prevent this.

effect.preventText: Would you like to exert {chosenCompanion} or add a burden to prevent assigning it to {self}?

subtitle: Halfling Hunter

title: Lurtz's Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be an Uruk-hai.
When you play this possession on Lurtz, you may draw a card.
Archery: If bearer is Lurtz, discard 2 [uruk-hai] cards from hand to exert an unbound companion.
lore: The bow of the Uruk captain dealt a powerful blow.
subtitle: Black-fletch Bow

title: New Forges Built
gametext: Exert an [uruk-hai] minion to reinforce an [uruk-hai] token.
lore: 'I looked on it and saw that, whereas it had once been green and fair, it was now filled with pits and forges.'

title: Pikes Upon Pikes
gametext:
Each [uruk-hai] minion bearing a hand weapon cannot take wounds during the archery phase.
Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make an [uruk-hai] minion bearing a possession strength +2.
lore: Many a crude weapon was forged for his forces.

title: Shagrat
gametext:
Damage +1. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
While you can spot 7 possessions, Shagrat is fierce and cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases).
lore: I don't take orders from stinking Morgul rats!
subtitle: Tower Captain

title: Tracking the Prize
gametext: While you can spot 3 [uruk-hai] hunters, at the start of each skirmish involving an [uruk-hai] hunter, each companion skirmishing that minion must exert.
lore: Though bred for battle, the Uruks could track prey like the best of hunters.

title: White Hand Attacker(2)
gametext:
Damage +1.
While at a battleground, this minion is strength +2.
lore: The Uruk-hai army stopped and growled in anticipation of the upcoming battle.

title: White Hand Exorciser
gametext:
Damage +1.
When you play this minion, you may heal an [uruk-hai] minion.
lore: March to Helm's Deep! Leave none alive!

title: White Hand Marchers
gametext:
Damage +1.
This minion is strength +1 for each other [uruk-hai] minion you can spot.
lore: The enormous Uruk-hai armies marched with great speed.

title: White Hand Marshal
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may control a site.
lore: The Men and Elves looked out into the darkness, and through the rain they saw, lit by the thousands of torches, the huge advancing Uruk-hai army.

title: White Hand Mystic
gametext:
Damage +1.
Response: If an [uruk-hai] minion is about to take a wound, exert this minion to prevent that wound.
lore: The Uruk-hai... resilient... imposing....

title: White Hand Sieger
gametext:
Damage +1.
To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion and you must control a site.
lore: The flood of Uruk-hai storming the Deeping Wall seemed to be unstoppable.

title: White Hand Traveler
gametext:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: Spot 2 other [uruk-hai] minions and remove (2) to make this minion strength +1 and damage +1.
lore: The Uruk-hai troop snuck along through the forest following the three boats carrying the Fellowship.

title: White Hand Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion.

title: All Life Flees
gametext:
To play, spot a Nazgûl.
Remove (X) to choose one: discard a follower from play that has a twilight cost of X; or play from deck a [wraith] minion that has a twilight cost of X.
lore: A sudden unreasoning fear of discovery laid hold of Frodo, and he thought of his Ring.

texts: Discard a follower from play with a twilight cost of {X}
Play a {wraith} minion from your draw deck with a twilight cost of {X}

title: Pull of the Ring
gametext: Remove a burden to choose one: assign a [wraith] minion to a companion who has resistance 0; or have a [wraith] minion lose fierce and gain hunter 2 until the regroup phase.
lore: I'm naked in the dark. There's nothing, no veil between me and the Wheel of Fire. I can see him with my waking eyes!

texts: Assign a {wraith} minion to a companion who has resistance 0
Have a {wraith} minion lose fierce and gain huner 2 until the regroup phase

title: Doorway to Doom
gametext: Mountain. When the fellowship moves to this site, each player wounds two of his or her characters.

title: Foot of Mount Doom
gametext: Mountain. Each card that is about to be placed into the discard pile is removed from the game instead.

title: Mithlond
gametext: River. When the fellowship moves to this site, each player heals each of his or her characters.

title: Morannon Plains
gametext: Battleground. Plains. When the fellowship moves to this site, each player may reinforce a culture token.

effect.text: Would you like to reinforce a culture token

title: Sirannon Ruins
gametext: River.

title: Steward's Tomb
gametext: Wounds cannot be prevented or healed. Burdens cannot be removed.

title: Streets of Bree
gametext: Dwelling. While the fellowship is at this site, followers cannot be transferred to a character.

title: The One Ring
gametext:
While wearing The One Ring, each time bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead.
Maneuver: Wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.
Skirmish: Add a burden to make the Ring-bearer strength +3.
subtitle: The Great Ring

title: Gimli
gametext:
Fellowship. Damage +1.
Each time you play a [dwarven] possession, you may draw a card.
lore: If anyone was to ask for my opinion, which I note they're not, I'd say we were taking the long way round.
subtitle: Opinionated Guide

title: Still Twitching
gametext:
Bearer must be a [dwarven] companion.
Bearer gains hunter 2. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [dwarven] companion.
At the end of each turn, if bearer did not win a skirmish this turn, discard this condition from play.

title: That's Two!
gametext: Spot Gimli and exert a fellowship companion to have each Shadow player discard one of his or her Shadow cards from play.
lore: Legolas, two already!

title: Army Long Trained
gametext:
Bearer must be an [elven] companion.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [elven] companion.
At the start of the archery phase, you must exert bearer or return this condition to hand.

title: Arwen
gametext:
Ranger.
While you can spot 2 [elven] followers, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -2.
Maneuver: Add 3 threats to reconcile your hand.
lore: I would rather share one lifetime with you than face all the ages of this world alone.
subtitle: Royal Maiden

title: Legolas
gametext:
Fellowship. Archer.
Archery: Add two threats to wound a minion; Legolas does not add to the fellowship archery total.
lore: Have you heard nothing Lord Elrond has said? The Ring must be destroyed!
subtitle: Skeptical Guide

title: Gandalf
gametext:
Fellowship.
Response: If an event is played, exert Gandalf twice to cancel that event.
lore: The Ring yearns above all else to return to the hand of its master. They are one, the Ring and the Dark Lord. Frodo, he must never find it.
subtitle: Wise Guide

title: Stern Words
gametext:
To play, spot a [gandalf] Wizard.
Bearer must be a companion.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another companion.
At the end of each turn, return this condition to hand.

title: Gollum
gametext:
Gollum is strength +1 for each threat you can spot.
Each time Gollum wins a skirmish, you may add a threat.
lore: 'But if we was master, then we could help ourselfs, yes....'
subtitle: Threatening Guide

title: Sméagol
gametext:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Each time Sméagol wins a skirmish, you may shuffle up to 2 [gollum] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck.
Skirmish: Exert a Ring-bound companion to make Sméagol strength +2.
lore: ...now that I see him, I do pity him.
subtitle: Pitiable Guide

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Fellowship. Ranger.
While the Ring-bearer is the only other companion you can spot, Aragorn is an archer, defender +1, and can take no more than 1 wound each skirmish.
lore: The skill of the Elves can reforge the sword of Kings, but only you have the power to wield it.
subtitle: Well-traveled Guide

title: Boromir
gametext:
Fellowship. Ranger.
While you can spot two unbound Hobbits, Boromir's twilight cost is -1.
Each time Boromir wins a skirmish, you may exert an unbound Hobbit to discard each minion he is skirmishing from play.
lore: In a dream, I saw the eastern sky grow dark.
subtitle: Destined Guide

title: Not Bound to His Fate
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [gondor] Man.
At the end of each turn, if bearer is not Aragorn, return this condition to hand.
lore: Your time will come. You will face the same evil....

title: Strength in My Blood
gametext:
Bearer must be a fellowship companion.
While bearer is a [gondor] companion, he or she is damage +1.
lore: I would have followed you my Brother... my Captain... my King!

title: Gríma
gametext:
When you play Gríma, you may remove (4) to exert an unbound companion. That companion cannot use special abilities until the regroup phase.
Assignment: Exert Gríma to assign him to an unbound companion. That companion may exert to prevent this.

effect.preventText: Would you like to exert {chosenCompanion} to prevent {self} assigning to it?

subtitle: Servant of Another Master

title: Urgency
gametext:
Weather.
Each time the fellowship moves, add (2) for each Ent you can spot.
Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make a non-[wraith] minion strength +1.
lore: If the mountain defeats you, will you risk a more dangerous road?

title: The Balrog
gametext:
Damage +2. Fierce.
While at an underground site, skip the archery phase, the maneuver phase, and The Balrog cannot be assigned to skirmish companions of strength 6 or less.
lore: The flames roared up to greet it, and wreathed about it....
subtitle: Demon of Might

title: Reaching Tentacle
gametext:
Tentacle.
This minion cannot bear possessions.
Discard this minion from play if not at a marsh.
This minion is strength +1 for each tentacle you can spot.
lore: Frodo felt something seize him by the ankle....

title: Strong Tentacle
gametext:
Tentacle.
This minion cannot bear possessions.
Discard this minion from play if not at a marsh.
This minion is strength +1 for each tentacle you can spot.
lore: One came wriggling over the threshold....

title: Watcher in the Water
gametext:
Discard all other minions (except tentacles).
Watcher in the Water cannot bear possessions.
The fellowship's current site gains marsh.
Shadow: Play a tentacle from your discard pile.
lore: ...as if a host of snakes were swimming up....
subtitle: Many-tentacled Creature

title: Pit Troll
gametext:
Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.)
To play, spot an [orc] Orc.
When you play this minion, add 2 threats. The Free Peoples player may exert the Ring-bearer to prevent this.
lore: Black blood. Flat feet. Scaly skin.

effect.text: Would you like to exert the Ring-bearer to prevent adding 2 threats?

title: Troll of the Deep
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] Orc.
Skirmish: Remove a threat to make an [orc] minion strength +2.
lore: Stones to move. Bridges to be rebuilt.
subtitle: Cave Troll

title: Brought Down from Inside
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
At the start of each skirmish you may transfer this condition to a [rohan] Man.
At the end of each turn, if bearer did not win a skirmish this turn, return this condition to hand.
lore: Bring it down! Bring it down! Bring it down!

title: Éomer
gametext:
Valiant.
Éomer is strength +2 for each wound on each minion he is skirmishing.
lore: Now is the hour, Riders of Rohan, oaths you have taken! Now, fulfill them all! To Lord and Land!
subtitle: Éored Captain

title: Éowyn
gametext:
Valiant.
Fellowship: Play a [rohan] companion with a twilight cost of 3 or more; his or her twilight cost is -1.
lore: It's tradition for the women of the court to farewell the men.
subtitle: Lady of the Mark

title: Sauron's Might
gametext: Remove a Free Peoples culture token to add a threat. When you play this event, you may remove (1) to place this on the bottom of your draw deck instead of in your discard pile.
lore: One by one, the free lands of Middle-earth fell to the power of the Ring.

effect.text: Would you like to remove (1) to place {self} on the bottom of your draw deck?

title: Frodo
gametext:
Ring-bearer. Ring-bound. Fellowship.
While you cannot spot 4 threats, Shadow cards cannot discard cards from your hand or from the top of your draw deck.
lore: We're friends of Gandalf the Grey.
subtitle: Little Master

title: Merry
gametext:
Fellowship.
Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, take 2 [shire] cards from your discard pile and remove them from the game to make a companion strength +2.
lore: 'You can trust us to stick to you through thick and thin – to the bitter end.'
subtitle: Resolute Friend

title: Pippin
gametext:
Fellowship.
Pippin is strength +1 for each tale you can spot.
lore: 'You must go – and therefore we must, too. Merry and I are coming with you.'
subtitle: Steadfast Friend

title: Rabbit Stew
gametext:
Bearer must be a [shire] companion.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to a fellowship companion.
Each time this condition is transferred to a companion, heal that companion.

title: Sam
gametext:
Ring-bound. Fellowship.
While Sam bears The One Ring, he is resistance -4.
While you can spot 3 [shire] companions, Sam is strength +2.
Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer.
subtitle: Loyal Friend

title: Lurtz
gametext:
Archer. Damage +1.
Response: If Lurtz is about to take a wound or be exerted, remove (2) (or exert another Uruk-hai) to prevent that wound or exertion.
lore: The Uruk-hai leader walked into view on the misty hilltop beneath the dark trees. Hungry for blood.
subtitle: Resilient Captain

title: In Twilight
gametext:
Bearer must be a [wraith] minion.
When you play this, you may draw a card.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [wraith] minion.
lore: The Nazgûl's true forms were revealed to him, shining like ghostly Kings.

title: Úlairë Attëa
gametext:
Fierce.
While you can spot 5 twilight tokens in the twilight pool and another [wraith] card, Úlairë Attëa is strength +3.
lore: Those that knew the most power as kings were placed in particular ways for the will of Sauron.
subtitle: Dark Predator

title: Úlairë Enquëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Maneuver: Spot 6 companions and discard a Nazgûl from hand to wound an unbound companion.
lore: The Nine Riders were embodiments of Sauron's will, searching all of Middle-earth for his prize.
subtitle: Dark Threat

title: Úlairë Lemenya
gametext:
Fierce.
Úlairë Lemenya is strength +1 for each [wraith] possession in your discard pile.
lore: 'Do you wish them to find you? They are terrible!'
subtitle: Dark Enemy

title: Úlairë Nertëa
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play Úlairë Nertëa, name a race. The Free Peoples player cannot assign Úlairë Nertëa to skirmish a companion of the named race.
lore: Some accepted Sauron's gift for glory and a notion of great deeds.
subtitle: Dark Horseman

title: Úlairë Toldëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Úlairë Toldëa cannot be assigned to skirmish the same companion in a fierce skirmish that he has already been assigned to this turn.
lore: Open, in the name of Mordor!' said a voice thin and menacing.
subtitle: Dark Shadow

title: The Witch-king
gametext:
Fierce.
Skirmish: Discard a Nazgûl from hand to make The Witch-king strength +1 (or strength +2 if you can spot that discarded Nazgûl).
lore: 'A great king and sorcerer he was of old, and now he wields a deadly fear.'
subtitle: Dark Lord
